entry.summary: Introduces SPUR, a benchmark of 4,264 QA pairs from 1,084 expert-curated scientific experimental images, evaluating MLLMs on panel-level perception, cross-panel understanding, and expert-level reasoning. Even GPT-5.1 achieves only 48.80% overall.

entry.title: Generalizable Sparse-View 3D Reconstruction from Unconstrained Images

author.name: Vinayak Gupta, Chih-Hao Lin, Shenlong Wang, Anand Bhattad, Jia-Bin Huang

entry.summary: GenWildSplat is a feed-forward framework for sparse-view outdoor 3D reconstruction from unposed internet images with no per-scene optimization. Handles varying illumination and transient occlusions using an appearance adapter and learned geometric priors.

entry.title: Robot Learning from Human Videos: A Survey

author.name: Junyi Ma, Erhang Zhang, Haoran Yang, Ditao Li, Chenyang Xu, Guangming Wang, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of learning robot manipulation skills from human video data, covering human-robot skill transfer and world model learning. Reviews how advances in computer vision enable scaling robot learning from abundant human activity videos.

entry.title: Function-based Parametric Co-Design Optimization of Dexterous Hands

author.name: Mohammad Amin Mirzaee, Harsh Gupta, Wenzhen Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces a comprehensive parametric framework for robotic hand co-design that unifies palm structure, finger kinematics, fingertip geometry, and surface curvatures in a single optimization space. Validates through grasp stability tasks in simulation and real-world scenarios.

entry.title: The Bernstein-von Mises theorem for Bayesian one-pass online learning

author.name: Jeyong Lee, Junhyeok Choi, Dongguen Kim, Minwoo Chae

entry.summary: Establishes a Bernstein-von Mises theorem for Bayesian one-pass online learning, providing theoretical guarantees for valid uncertainty quantification without requiring diverging mini-batch sizes. Introduces a warm-start phase to ensure stable sequential updates.

entry.title: The Two Boundaries: Why Behavioral AI Governance Fails Structurally

author.name: Alan L. McCann

entry.summary: Argues that behavioral AI governance fails structurally because system expressiveness and governance coverage are defined independently, creating three regions: governed capabilities, ungoverned capabilities (risk), and governance over non-existent capabilities (theater).

entry.title: Differentiable latent structure discovery for interpretable forecasting in clinical time series

author.name: Ivan Lerner, Jean Feydy, Alexandre Kalimouttou, Anita Burgun, Francis Bach

entry.summary: Introduces StructGP and LP-StructGP, continuous-time Gaussian processes with differentiable structure learning for clinical time series forecasting, discovering sparse DAGs of variable dependencies while maintaining uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Efficient Multivector Retrieval with Token-Aware Clustering and Hierarchical Indexing

author.name: Silvio Martinico, Franco Maria Nardini, Cosimo Rulli, Rossano Venturini

entry.summary: Introduces TACHIOM, a multivector retrieval system that exploits token-level structure to accelerate clustering and retrieval, addressing standard k-means' poor scaling and bias toward frequent tokens in ColBERT-style systems.

entry.title: 3D-ReGen: A Unified 3D Geometry Regeneration Framework

author.name: Geon Yeong Park, Roman Shapovalov, Rakesh Ranjan, Jong Chul Ye, Andrea Vedaldi, Thu Nguyen-Phuoc

entry.summary: 3D-ReGen introduces a 3D regenerator conditioned on initial 3D shapes using VecSet-based conditioning, supporting enhancement, reconstruction, and editing through self-supervised pretext tasks and augmentations from off-the-shelf datasets.

entry.title: HERMES++: Toward a Unified Driving World Model for 3D Scene Understanding and Generation

author.name: Xin Zhou, Dingkang Liang, Xiwu Chen, Feiyang Tan, Dingyuan Zhang, Hengshuang Zhao, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: HERMES++ proposes a unified driving world model that integrates 3D scene understanding and future geometry prediction within a single framework, bridging the gap between LLM semantic reasoning and physical simulation for autonomous driving.

entry.title: AesRM: Improving Video Aesthetics with Expert-Level Feedback

author.name: Yujin Han, Yujie Wei, Yefei He, Xinyu Liu, Tianle Li, Zichao Yu, Andi Han, Shiwei Zhang, Tingyu Weng, Difan Zou

entry.summary: AesRM proposes a hierarchical rubric decomposing video aesthetics into Visual Aesthetics, Visual Fidelity, and Visual Plausibility with 15 fine-grained criteria, plus an expert-annotated preference dataset and AesVideo-Bench for evaluation.

entry.title: Binary Spiking Neural Networks as Causal Models

author.name: Aditya Kar (CNRS, IRIT), Emiliano Lorini (CNRS, IRIT), Timoth\'ee Masquelier (CNRS, CERCO UMR5549)

entry.summary: Provides a causal analysis of Binary Spiking Neural Networks by representing spiking activity as a binary causal model. Uses SAT/SMT solvers to compute abductive explanations, comparing against SHAP on MNIST classifications.

entry.title: Investigating More Explainable and Partition-Free Compositionality Estimation for LLMs: A Rule-Generation Perspective

author.name: Ziyao Xu, Cong Wang, Houfeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a rule-generation perspective for evaluating LLM compositionality, requiring models to generate programs as rules for dataset mapping, addressing explainability and data leakage issues in traditional compositional generalization tests.

entry.title: When Agents Evolve, Institutions Follow

author.name: Chao Fei, Hongcheng Guo, Yanghua Xiao

entry.summary: Draws parallels between historical political institutions and multi-agent LLM system design, arguing that coordination challenges in MAS mirror those solved by human civilizations through various governance structures.

entry.title: Post-Optimization Adaptive Rank Allocation for LoRA

author.name: Vishnuprasadh Kumaravelu, Sunil Gupta, P. K. Srijith

entry.summary: Proposes PARA, a post-hoc method for adaptive rank allocation in LoRA that uses SVD-based pruning with a global threshold over singular values, enabling non-uniform rank based on layer-wise spectral importance without retraining.

entry.title: Graph World Models: Concepts, Taxonomy, and Future Directions

author.name: Jiawei Liu, Senqiao Yang, Mingjun Wang, Yu Wang, Bei Yu

entry.summary: Provides the first systematic survey of graph world models, formalizing how graph structures can decompose environments into entity nodes and interactive edges for structured prediction and planning.

entry.title: Taming the Centaur(s) with LAPITHS: a framework for a theoretically grounded interpretation of AI performances

author.name: Matteo Da Pelo, Alessio Donvito, Claudio Frongia, Pietro Salis, Antonio Lieto

entry.summary: Introduces LAPITHS framework to counter claims that transformer language models exhibit human-like cognition, using quantitative assessments (Minimal Cognitive Grid, Functional Equivalence Index) to evaluate AI performance claims.

entry.title: Exploring Interaction Paradigms for LLM Agents in Scientific Visualization

author.name: Jackson Vonderhorst, Kuangshi Ai, Haichao Miao, Shusen Liu, Chaoli Wang

entry.summary: Compares three LLM agent interaction paradigms (domain-specific agents, computer-use agents, and coding agents) for scientific visualization tasks across 15 benchmark tasks, evaluating quality, efficiency, robustness, and cost.

entry.title: DeepTutor: Towards Agentic Personalized Tutoring

author.name: Bingxi Zhao, Jiahao Zhang, Xubin Ren, Zirui Guo, Tianzhe Chu, Yi Ma, Chao Huang

entry.summary: Presents DeepTutor, an agent-native open-source framework for personalized tutoring that combines static knowledge grounding with dynamic multi-resolution memory to create continuously evolving learner profiles.

entry.title: AgenticRecTune: Multi-Agent with Self-Evolving Skillhub for Recommendation System Optimization

author.name: Xidong Wu, Yue Zhuan, Ruoqiao Wei, Hangxin Chen, Di Bai, Jintao Liu, Xinyi Wang, Xue Wang, Luoshu Wang, Xinwu Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces AgenticRecTune, a multi-agent system with a self-evolving skillhub for optimizing large-scale recommendation system configurations across pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking stages.

entry.title: Automatic Causal Fairness Analysis with LLM-Generated Reporting

author.name: Alessia Berarducci, Eric Rossetto, Alessandro Antonucci, Marco Zaffalon

entry.summary: Introduces FairMind, a software prototype that automates causal fairness analysis using the standard fairness model, with LLM-generated reporting for counterfactual fairness evaluation at the dataset level.

entry.title: ConformaDecompose: Explaining Uncertainty via Calibration Localization

author.name: Fatima Rabia Yapicioglu, Meltem Aksoy, Alberto Rigenti, Tuwe L\"ofstr\"om-Cavallin, Helena L\"ofstr\"om-Cavallin, Seyda Yoncaci, Luca Longo

entry.summary: Introduces an uncertainty-aware explainability framework that analyzes reducibility of conformal prediction uncertainty through progressive calibration localization, distinguishing reducible from irreducible uncertainty sources.

entry.title: Theory Under Construction: Orchestrating Language Models for Research Software Where the Specification Evolves

author.name: Halley Young, Nikolaj Bj\"orner

entry.summary: Proposes Comet-H, an iterative prompt automaton for orchestrating research software development where code, theory, benchmarks, and papers must co-evolve, addressing hallucination accumulation and desynchronization failures.

entry.title: When Does Structure Matter in Continual Learning? Dimensionality Controls When Modularity Shapes Representational Geometry

author.name: Kathrin Korte, Joachim Winter Pedersen, Eleni Nisioti, Sebastian Risi

entry.summary: Investigates how network architecture modularity, task similarity, and representational dimensionality jointly shape continual learning, finding that dimensionality controls when modularity matters for the stability-plasticity tradeoff.

entry.title: AgentEconomist: An End-to-end Agentic System Translating Economic Intuitions into Executable Computational Experiments

author.name: Jiaju Chen, Jinghua Piao, Xia Xu, Songwei Li, Tong Xia, Xiangnan He, Yong Li

entry.summary: Introduces AgentEconomist, an end-to-end system that translates economic intuitions into executable computational experiments through a multi-stage architecture grounded in 13,000+ academic papers, enabling automated hypothesis generation and experimental design.

entry.title: Can AI Be a Good Peer Reviewer? A Survey of Peer Review Process, Evaluation, and the Future

author.name: Sihong Wu, Owen Jiang, Yilun Zhao, Tiansheng Hu, Yiling Ma, Kaiyan Zhang, Manasi Patwardhan, Arman Cohan

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of AI-assisted peer review covering generation methods (fine-tuning, agents, RL), after-review tasks (rebuttals, meta-reviews), and evaluation approaches (human-centered, LLM-based), cataloging datasets and discussing ethical concerns.

entry.title: TopBench: A Benchmark for Implicit Prediction and Reasoning over Tabular Question Answering

author.name: An-Yang Ji, Jun-Peng Jiang, De-Chuan Zhan, Han-Jia Ye

entry.summary: Introduces TopBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on implicitly predictive tabular questions requiring inference of unobserved answers from historical patterns rather than mere data retrieval, covering prediction, decision making, and causal analysis.

entry.title: Computing Equilibrium beyond Unilateral Deviation

author.name: Mingyang Liu, Gabriele Farina, Asuman Ozdaglar

entry.summary: Studies equilibrium concepts beyond unilateral deviation (Nash), focusing on minimizing coalitional deviation incentives rather than requiring them to vanish, guaranteeing existence while providing stability against coordinated deviations.

entry.title: Analytical Correction for Subsampling Bias in Drifting Models

author.name: Jiaru Zhang, Zeyun Deng, Juanwu Lu, Ziran Wang, Ruqi Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies and corrects an O(1/n) bias in minibatch centroid estimates for drifting models (one-step generative models) that arises from softmax self-normalization. Proposes an analytical bias correction computed from in-batch statistics.

entry.title: Differential Subgroup Discovery: Characterizing Where Two Populations Differ, and Why

author.name: Sascha Xu, Jilles Vreeken

entry.summary: Formalizes differential subgroup discovery to identify regions where two populations exhibit exceptional outcome differences, proposing a general optimization objective with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Auto-FlexSwitch: Efficient Dynamic Model Merging via Learnable Task Vector Compression

author.name: Junqi Gao, Dazhi Zhang, Zhichang Guo, Biqing Qi, Yi Ran, Wangmeng Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes Auto-FlexSwitch for efficient dynamic model merging that compresses task vectors using learned low-bit representations, reducing storage overhead while maintaining multi-task performance.

entry.title: Continuous-time q-learning for mean-field control with common noise, part-I: Theoretical foundations

author.name: Zhenjie Ren, Xiaoli Wei, Xiang Yu, Xun Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Develops the continuous-time q-function for entropy-regularized mean-field control with common noise, establishing exploratory HJB equations and optimal policy characterization under concavity conditions.

entry.title: Taming Noise-Induced Prototype Degradation for Privacy-Preserving Personalized Federated Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yuhua Wang, Qinnan Zhang, Xiaodong Li, Huan Zhang, Yifan Sun, Wangjie Qiu, Hainan Zhang, Yongxin Tong, Zhiming Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes VPDR, a client-side privacy plug-in for prototype-based personalized federated learning that uses dimension-wise variance to guide anisotropic noise injection, avoiding over-perturbation of discriminative dimensions while maintaining differential privacy guarantees.

entry.title: Targeted Linguistic Analysis of Sign Language Models with Minimal Translation Pairs

author.name: Serpil Karab\"ukl\"u, Kanishka Misra, Shester Gueuwou, Diane Brentari, Greg Shakhnarovich, Karen Livescu

entry.summary: Introduces ASL Minimal Translation Pairs (ASL-MTP), a benchmark for evaluating sign language models' capture of linguistic phenomena across multiple articulators (hands, body, face), using minimal pair methodology.

entry.title: Multi-Level Narrative Evaluation Outperforms Lexical Features for Mental Health

author.name: Yuxi Ma, Jieming Cui, Muyang Li, Ye Zhao, Yu Li, Yixuan Wang, Chi Zhang, Yinyin Zang, Yixin Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces a three-level framework (micro-lexical, meso-embedding, macro-LLM narrative evaluation) for analyzing therapeutic writing, showing macro-level LLM evaluation substantially outperforms lexical and embedding approaches across 830 Chinese therapeutic texts.

entry.title: A Reproducibility Study of LLM-Based Query Reformulation

author.name: Amin Bigdeli, Radin Hamidi Rad, Hai Son Le, Mert Incesu, Negar Arabzadeh, Charles L. A. Clarke, Ebrahim Bagheri

entry.summary: Systematic reproducibility study of 10 LLM-based query reformulation methods under unified experimental conditions across 2 LLM families, 3 retrieval paradigms, and 9 benchmarks, revealing which findings are implementation-dependent.

entry.title: CasLayout: Cascaded 3D Layout Diffusion for Indoor Scene Synthesis with Implicit Relation Modeling

author.name: Yingrui Wu, Youkang Kong, Mingyang Zhao, Weize Quan, Dong-Ming Yan, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Presents CasLayout, a cascaded diffusion framework decomposing indoor scene synthesis into four conditional stages (quantity/categories, sizes/embeddings, spatial relationships, oriented bounding boxes) inspired by human design cognition.

entry.title: LA-Pose: Latent Action Pretraining Meets Pose Estimation

author.name: Zhengqing Wang, Saurabh Nair, Prajwal Chidananda, Pujith Kachana, Samuel Li, Matthew Brown, Yasutaka Furukawa

entry.summary: LA-Pose repurposes latent action representations from self-supervised inverse-dynamics pretraining (similar to Genie) as inputs to camera pose estimators. This provides a scalable alternative to fully supervised training with 3D annotations for pose estimation.

entry.title: MoCapAnything V2: End-to-End Motion Capture for Arbitrary Skeletons

author.name: Kehong Gong, Zhengyu Wen, Dao Thien Phong, Mingxi Xu, Weixia He, Qi Wang, Ning Zhang, Zhengyu Li, Guanli Hou, Dongze Lian, Xiaoyu He, Mingyuan Zhang, Hanwang Zhang

entry.summary: MoCapAnything V2 presents the first fully end-to-end framework for arbitrary-skeleton motion capture from monocular video, jointly optimizing both video-to-pose and pose-to-rotation stages, resolving ambiguities like bone-axis twist.

entry.title: FreeOcc: Training-Free Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Zeyu Jiang, Changqing Zhou, Xingxing Zuo, Changhao Chen

entry.summary: FreeOcc is a training-free framework for open-vocabulary occupancy prediction from monocular/RGB-D sequences, using SLAM, Gaussian maps, and VLM semantics without 3D annotations or learning.

entry.title: RopeDreamer: A Kinematic Recurrent State Space Model for Dynamics of Flexible Deformable Linear Objects

author.name: Tim Missal, Lucas Domingues, Berk Guler, Simon Manschitz, Jan Peters, Paula Dornhofer Paro Costa

entry.summary: Proposes RopeDreamer, a latent dynamics framework combining a Recurrent State Space Model with Quaternionic Kinematic Chain representation for modeling deformable linear objects (like ropes). Avoids common issues like self-intersections and non-physical deformations by encoding objects as sequences of relative rotations.

entry.title: No Strong Orthogonality From Selection Pressure

author.name: lumpenspace

entry.summary: Argues against the strong orthogonality thesis—the claim that a recursively self-improving superintelligence would remain bound to semantically thin terminal goals. Accepts that intelligence doesn't imply morality and weird minds are possible, but disputes that selection pressure maintains arbitrary goal stability.

entry.title: Mapping how LLMs debate societal issues when shadowing human personality traits, sociodemographics and social media behavior

author.name: Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili, Massimo Stella

entry.summary: Creates a 190,000-record synthetic corpus exploring how 19 LLMs generate discourse on controversial topics when prompted with different human personas, encoding sociodemographic and psychological attributes to study LLM-generated discourse patterns.

entry.title: MIFair: A Mutual-Information Framework for Intersectionality and Multiclass Fairness

author.name: Jeanne Monnier, Thomas George, Fr\'ed\'eric Guyard, Christ\`ele Tarnec, Marios Kountouris

entry.summary: Introduces MIFair, a mutual information-based framework for fairness that handles intersectionality and multiclass settings, providing flexible bias metrics and an in-processing mitigation method with theoretical equivalences to existing fairness criteria.

entry.title: Probabilistic Circuits for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Christian Kl\"otergens, Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi, Lars Schmidt-Thieme

entry.summary: Proposes CircuITS, a probabilistic circuit architecture for irregular multivariate time series forecasting that guarantees valid joint distributions while capturing complex inter-channel dependencies.

entry.title: Can Tabular Foundation Models Guide Exploration in Robot Policy Learning?

author.name: Buqing Ou, Frederike D\"umbgen

entry.summary: Proposes TFM-S3, a hybrid local-global method for robot policy learning that uses pretrained tabular foundation models as surrogate models within a low-dimensional policy subspace constructed via SVD, improving global exploration with limited rollout cost.

entry.title: Uni-HOI:A Unified framework for Learning the Joint distribution of Text and Human-Object Interaction

author.name: Mengfei Zhang, Jinlu Zhang, Zhigang Tu

entry.summary: Uni-HOI is a unified framework for modeling 4D human-object interaction that learns joint distributions among text, human motion, and object motion using LLMs and VQ-VAEs. Handles diverse conditional inputs rather than requiring task-specific architectures.

entry.title: FineState-Bench: Benchmarking State-Conditioned Grounding for Fine-grained GUI State Setting

author.name: Fengxian Ji, Jingpu Yang, Zirui Song, Yuanxi Wang, Zhexuan Cui, Yuke Li, Qian Jiang, Xiuying Chen

entry.summary: FineState-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating fine-grained, state-conditioned GUI interaction, with 2,209 instances across desktop/web/mobile platforms, testing whether agents can correctly ground instructions to UI controls and reach exact target states.

entry.title: Echo-{\alpha}: Large Agentic Multimodal Reasoning Model for Ultrasound Interpretation

author.name: Jing Zhang, Wentao Jiang, Tao Huang, Zhiwei Wang, Jianxin Liu, Jian Chen, Ping Ye, Gang Wang, Zengmao Wang, Bo Du, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Echo-α is an agentic multimodal reasoning model for ultrasound interpretation that unifies organ-specific detector outputs with global visual context in an invoke-and-reason framework, bridging precise localization and clinical reasoning.

entry.title: DOT-Sim: Differentiable Optical Tactile Simulation with Precise Real-to-Sim Physical Calibration

author.name: Yang You, Won Kyung Do, Aiden Swann, Rika Antonova, Monroe Kennedy, Leonidas Guibas

entry.summary: DOT-Sim proposes a differentiable optical tactile sensor simulation using Material Point Method for elastic materials, enabling rapid physical calibration from a small number of demonstrations within minutes.

entry.title: OmniRobotHome: A Multi-Camera Platform for Real-Time Multiadic Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Junyoung Lee, Sookwan Han, Jeonghwan Kim, Inhee Lee, Mingi Choi, Jisoo Kim, Wonjung Woo, Hanbyul Joo

entry.summary: OmniRobotHome is the first room-scale residential platform for real-time multiadic human-robot interaction, providing occlusion-robust 3D tracking of multiple humans and robots sharing a workspace.

entry.title: How Hard Is Continuous Clustering? Lower Bounds from the Existential Theory of the Reals

author.name: Angshul Majumdar

entry.summary: Proves computational hardness results for continuous clustering problems (on polynomial densities) using the existential theory of the reals, showing various natural questions are ETR-complete.

entry.title: Continuous-time q-learning for mean-field control with common noise, part-II: q-learning algorithms

author.name: Zhenjie Ren, Xiaoli Wei, Xiang Yu, Xun Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Continuation paper developing practical q-learning algorithms for mean-field control with common noise, including martingale conditions, error quantification for observable data, and convergent implementations.

entry.title: Fake3DGS: A Benchmark for 3D Manipulation Detection in Neural Rendering

author.name: Davide Di Nucci, Riccardo Catalini, Guido Borghi, Roberto Vezzani

entry.summary: Introduces Fake3DGS, a benchmark dataset for detecting 3D manipulations in Gaussian Splatting scenes, covering geometry, appearance, and spatial layout manipulations. Demonstrates that existing 2D fake detection methods struggle with 3D-rendered fakes.

entry.title: ResiHMR: Residual-Limb Aware Single-Image 3D Human Mesh Recovery for Individuals with Limb Loss

author.name: Jiaying Ying, Heming Du, Kaihao Zhang, Sean M. Tweedy, Xin Yu

entry.summary: ResiHMR is the first framework for single-image 3D human mesh recovery that handles individuals with limb loss, introducing residual-limb keypoints and topology-adaptive optimization for anatomically valid structures.

entry.title: Action Motifs: Self-Supervised Hierarchical Representation of Human Body Movements

author.name: Genki Kinoshita, Shu Nakamura, Ryo Kawahara, Shohei Nobuhara, Yasutomo Kawanishi, Ko Nishino

entry.summary: Proposes Action Motifs, a hierarchical self-supervised representation of human body movements using Action Atoms (atomic joint movements) and their temporal compositions, learned via A4Mer, a nested latent Transformer.

entry.title: Global Sampling-Based Trajectory Optimization for Contact-Rich Manipulation via KernelSOS

author.name: Zhongqi Wei, Frederike D\"umbgen

entry.summary: Global-MPPI introduces a trajectory optimization framework for contact-rich manipulation that integrates global exploration via kernel sum-of-squares optimization with local MPPI refinement, using graduated noise for non-smooth landscapes.

entry.title: Simulating Infant First-Person Sensorimotor Experience via Motion Retargeting from Babies to Humanoids

author.name: Francisco M. L\'opez, Hoshinori Kanazawa, Ondrej Fiala, Yakov Balashov, Valentin Marcel, Lukas Rustler, Miles Lenz, Dongmin Kim, Yasuo Kuniyoshi, Jochen Triesch, Matej Hoffmann

entry.summary: Presents a framework for retargeting infant motion from video to physical and virtual humanoid robots (iCub, pyCub, etc.) to simulate multimodal sensorimotor experiences. Reconstructs infant body configuration from single video and maps motion onto developmental platforms.

entry.title: Compositional Meta-Learning for Mitigating Task Heterogeneity in Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Beomchul Park, Minsu Koh, Heejo Kong, Seong-Whan Lee

entry.summary: Proposes LAM-PINN, a modular meta-learning approach for physics-informed neural networks that handles task heterogeneity across parameterized PDE families. Uses compositional modules with learning-affinity adaptive routing to mitigate negative transfer under limited training tasks.

entry.title: CoAX: Cognitive-Oriented Attribution eXplanation User Model of Human Understanding of AI Explanations

author.name: Louth Bin Rawshan, Zhuoyu Wang, Brian Y. Lim

entry.summary: Develops CoAX, a cognitive user model that explains how humans understand AI explanations by implementing reasoning strategies as cognitive processes, validated through formative and summative user studies on tabular data tasks.

entry.title: WaferSAGE: Large Language Model-Powered Wafer Defect Analysis via Synthetic Data Generation and Rubric-Guided Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ke Xu

entry.summary: Presents WaferSAGE, a framework for wafer defect visual question answering using small VLMs, with a three-stage synthesis pipeline and structured rubric generation to address data scarcity in semiconductor manufacturing.

entry.title: Knowledge Graph Representations for LLM-Based Policy Compliance Reasoning

author.name: Wilder Baldwin, Sepideh Ghanavati

entry.summary: Presents an agentic framework using knowledge graphs for AI policy compliance reasoning, showing KG augmentation improves all five tested LLMs on 42 policy QA tasks spanning entity lookup to cross-policy inference.

entry.title: ObjectGraph: From Document Injection to Knowledge Traversal -- A Native File Format for the Agentic Era

author.name: Mohit Dubey, Open Gigantic

entry.summary: Proposes ObjectGraph (.og), a file format that reconceives documents as typed directed knowledge graphs for LLM agents to traverse rather than inject entire documents into context windows.

entry.title: Modeling Clinical Concern Trajectories in Language Model Agents

author.name: Sukesh Subaharan, Venkatesan VS, Murugadasan P, Sivakumar D, Gautham N, Ganeshkumar M

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight agent architecture for clinical risk with continuous escalation pressure signals using first/second-order dynamics, avoiding sharp threshold-driven behaviors in clinical LLM deployment.

entry.title: LLM as Clinical Graph Structure Refiner: Enhancing Representation Learning in EEG Seizure Diagnosis

author.name: Lincan Li, Zheng Chen, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Uses LLMs as graph edge refiners for EEG seizure detection, proposing a two-stage framework that removes redundant connections in graph representations of EEG signals to improve seizure diagnosis accuracy.

entry.title: TypeBandit: Type-Level Context Allocation and Reweighting for Effective Attribute Completion in Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Ta-Yang Wang, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna

entry.summary: Introduces TypeBandit, a model-agnostic method for heterogeneous graph attribute completion that uses bandit-based sampling to allocate budget across node types based on their information contribution. Addresses type-dependent information asymmetry in heterogeneous graphs.

entry.title: AI Inference as Relocatable Electricity Demand: A Latency-Constrained Energy-Geography Framework

author.name: Xubin Luo, Yang Cheng

entry.summary: Develops an energy-geography framework modeling AI inference workload placement as constrained optimization over electricity prices, carbon intensity, and latency, treating inference as relocatable electricity demand.

entry.title: Reliable Answers for Recurring Questions: Boosting Text-to-SQL Accuracy with Template Constrained Decoding

author.name: Smit Jivani, Sarvam Maheshwari, Sunita Sarawagi

entry.summary: Introduces Template Constrained Decoding (TeCoD) for Text-to-SQL that leverages recurring query patterns from labeled workloads to constrain LLM decoding, using NLI-based template selection to improve reliability.

entry.title: Predicting Covariate-Driven Spatial Deformation for Nonstationary Gaussian Processes

author.name: Minghao Gu, Weizhi Lin, Qiang Huang

entry.summary: Models spatial deformation as a function of covariates for nonstationary Gaussian processes, using Lie algebra to connect diffeomorphic deformations with covariate vectors. Enables prediction of spatial correlations under new covariate conditions.

entry.title: Shuffling-Aware Optimization for Private Vector Mean Estimation

author.name: Shun Takagi, Seng Pei Liew

entry.summary: Studies optimal mean estimation in the single-message shuffle model of differential privacy, introducing shuffle index to formulate mechanism design as optimization and establishing minimax bounds.

entry.title: Strait: Perceiving Priority and Interference in ML Inference Serving

author.name: Haidong Zhao, Nikolaos Georgantas

entry.summary: Presents Strait, an ML inference serving system that models GPU contention and kernel execution interference to improve deadline satisfaction for dual-priority inference traffic under high utilization.

entry.title: REBENCH: A Procedural, Fair-by-Construction Benchmark for LLMs on Stripped-Binary Types and Names (Extended Version)

author.name: Jun Yeon Won, Xin Jin, Shiqing Ma, Zhiqiang Lin

entry.summary: Presents REBench, a standardized benchmark for evaluating LLMs on reverse engineering tasks (function/variable name recovery, type inference from stripped binaries), enabling fair comparison across approaches.

entry.title: Bayesian X-Learner: Calibrated Posterior Inference for Heterogeneous Treatment Effects under Heavy-Tailed Outcomes

author.name: Eichi Uehara

entry.summary: Presents a Bayesian X-Learner combining cross-fitted doubly robust pseudo-outcomes with MCMC posterior inference and a Welsch redescending pseudo-likelihood for heterogeneous treatment effect estimation robust to heavy-tailed outcomes. Achieves strong results on the IHDP benchmark while providing calibrated uncertainty.

entry.title: Skills-Coach: A Self-Evolving Skill Optimizer via Training-Free GRPO

author.name: Yu Tian, Jiawei Chen, Lifan Zheng, Mingxiang Tao, Xinyi Zeng, Zhaoxia Yin, Hang Su, Xian Sun

entry.summary: Introduces Skills-Coach, a training-free framework using GRPO-inspired optimization to automatically improve skill prompts and code in LLM-based agents through diverse task generation, comparative execution, and lightweight optimization.

entry.title: DPN-LE: Dual Personality Neuron Localization and Editing for Large Language Models

author.name: Lifan Zheng, Xue Yang, Jiawei Chen, Chenyan Wu, Jingyuan Zhang, Fanheng Kong, Xinyi Zeng, Xiang Chen, Yu Tian

entry.summary: Investigates personality representation in LLMs through dual neuron localization and editing (DPN-LE), finding that current neuron-editing methods change personality but reduce overall performance because neurons are multifunctional.

entry.title: On the Proper Treatment of Units in Surprisal Theory

author.name: Samuel Kiegeland, V\'esteinn Sn{\ae}bjarnarson, Tim Vieira, Ryan Cotterell

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for surprisal theory that disentangles the unit of analysis from regions of interest, addressing the mismatch between linguistically motivated units and model token alphabets.

entry.title: From Unstructured to Structured: LLM-Guided Attribute Graphs for Entity Search and Ranking

author.name: Yilun Zhu, Nikhita Vedula, Shervin Malmasi

entry.summary: Presents a two-stage approach for e-commerce entity search combining LLM-driven attribute graph construction (offline) with graph-aware LLM ranking (online), reducing per-product token usage while improving relevance.

entry.title: InterPartAbility: Text-Guided Part Matching for Interpretable Person Re-Identification

author.name: Shakeeb Murtaza, Aryan Shukla, Rajarshi Bhattacharya, Maguelonne Heritier, Eric Granger

entry.summary: Introduces InterPartAbility, an interpretable text-to-image person re-identification method that performs explicit part-wise matching with phrase-region grounding, enabling open-vocabulary explanations beyond simple attention visualization.

entry.title: Softmax-GS: Generalized Gaussians Learning When to Blend or Bound

author.name: Chen Ziwen, Peng Wang, Hao Tan, Zexiang Xu, Li Fuxin

entry.summary: Introduces Softmax-GS, which addresses view-inconsistency and diffuse-boundary problems in 3D Gaussian Splatting by enforcing softmax-based competition in overlapping regions. Learnable parameters control the spectrum from smooth blending to crisp boundaries.

entry.title: Assessing Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Vascular Invasion: the PDACVI Benchmark

author.name: M. Riera-Mar\'in, O. K. Sikha, J. Rodr\'iguez-Comas, M. S. May, T. Kirscher, X. Coubez, P. Meyer, S. Faisan, Z. Pan, X. Zhou, X. Liang, C. H\'emon, V. Boussot, J. -L. Dillenseger, J. -C. Nunes, K. -C. Kahl, C. L\"uth, J. Traub, P. -H. Conze, M. M. Duh, A. Aubanell, R. de Figueiredo Cardoso, S. Egger-Hackenschmidt, J. Garc\'ia-L\'opez, M. A. Gonz\'alez-Ballester, A. Galdran

entry.summary: Introduces CURVAS-PDACVI, an open benchmark for uncertainty-aware AI in pancreatic cancer vascular invasion assessment, with five independent expert annotations capturing inter-rater variability in this clinically critical task.

entry.title: Stop Holding Your Breath: CT-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Bronchoscopy

author.name: Andrea Dunn Beltran, Daniel Rho, Aarav Mehta, Xinqi Xiong, Ra\'ul San Jos\'e Est\'epar, Ron Alterovitz, Marc Niethammer, Roni Sengupta

entry.summary: Proposes CT-informed Gaussian Splatting for dynamic bronchoscopy that models respiratory motion using paired inhale-exhale CT scans, eliminating the need for breath-hold protocols during bronchoscopic navigation.

entry.title: SQuadGen: Generating Simple Quad Layouts via Chart Distance Fields

author.name: Youkang Kong, Yang Liu, Yue Dong, Xin Tong, Heung-Yeung Shum

entry.summary: SQuadGen is a diffusion-based framework for generating simple quad mesh layouts on 3D shapes using Chart Distance Fields, a continuous surface representation. Addresses the challenge of learning discrete mesh connectivity.

entry.title: The Field of Safe Motion: Operationalizing Affordances in the Field of Safe Travel Using Reachability Analysis

author.name: Leif Johnson, Trent Victor, Johan Engstr\"om

entry.summary: Presents the Field of Safe Motion (FSM), a computational operationalization of the 90-year-old Field of Safe Travel concept using reachability analysis to determine whether a driver maintains collision-free escape routes.

entry.title: SASI: Leveraging Sub-Action Semantics for Robust Early Action Recognition in Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Yongpeng Cao, Masahiro Hirano, Hyuno Kim, Yuji Yamakawa

entry.summary: Introduces SASI, a framework for early action recognition in human-robot interaction that decomposes actions into sub-actions for semantic and hierarchical cues. Enables robots to recognize human actions from incomplete observations by leveraging the structured nature of human movements.

entry.title: On today's panel with Bernie Sanders

author.name: David Scott Krueger

entry.summary: Reports on a public panel appearance with Senator Bernie Sanders about AI existential risk. Notes Sanders' outspoken advocacy on AI extinction risk and discusses the political dynamics of AI safety.

entry.title: Improving Calibration in Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models via Data-Free Flatness-Aware Prompt Pretraining

author.name: Hyeonseo Jang, Jaebyeong Jeon, Joong-Won Hwang, Kibok Lee

entry.summary: Reveals that calibration quality in test-time prompt tuning for VLMs is governed by the sharpness of the loss landscape around adapted prompts. Proposes data-free flatness-aware prompt pretraining to improve calibration without degrading performance.

entry.title: TripVVT: A Large-Scale Triplet Dataset and a Coarse-Mask Baseline for In-the-Wild Video Virtual Try-On

author.name: Dingbao Shao, Song Wu, Shenyi Wang, Ye Wang, Ziheng Tang, Fei Liu, Jiang Lin, Xinyu Chen, Qian Wang, Ying Tai, Jian Yang, Zili Yi

entry.summary: Introduces TripVVT-10K, the largest in-the-wild triplet dataset for video virtual try-on, and TripVVT, a Diffusion Transformer framework using human-mask priors instead of fragile garment masks for robust real-world performance.

entry.title: Think it, Run it: Autonomous ML pipeline generation via self-healing multi-agent AI

author.name: Adela Bara, Gabriela Dobrita, Simona-Vasilica Oprea

entry.summary: Proposes a five-agent system for automating end-to-end ML pipeline generation from datasets and natural language goals, with self-healing mechanisms and code-grounded RAG. Evaluated on 150 ML tasks.

entry.title: Toward Personalized Digital Twins for Cognitive Decline Assessment: A Multimodal, Uncertainty-Aware Framework

author.name: Bulent Soykan, Gulsah Hancerliogullari Koksalmis, Hsin-Hsiung Huang, Laura J. Brattain

entry.summary: Presents PCD-DT, a digital twin framework for cognitive decline that combines latent state-space models, multimodal fusion, and uncertainty-aware validation for modeling patient-specific disease trajectories from sparse longitudinal data.

entry.title: Learning Rate Engineering: From Coarse Single Parameter to Layered Evolution

author.name: Ming-Hong Yao, Di Wang, Jian Cui, Jin-Yan Chen, Zi-Hao Cui, Fa Wang, Chen Wei, Qiu-Ye Yu

entry.summary: Systematizes learning rate scheduling evolution into five generations and proposes Discriminative Adaptive Layer Scaling, addressing the tension between preserving lower-layer knowledge and adapting upper layers in transfer learning.

entry.title: Robust Learning on Heterogeneous Graphs with Heterophily: A Graph Structure Learning Approach

author.name: Yihan Zhang, Ercan E. Kuruoglu

entry.summary: Proposes HGUL, a unified framework for robust learning on heterogeneous graphs with heterophily, using kNN-based graph structure learning to handle noisy connectivity alongside heterophily-aware message passing.

entry.title: Math Education Digital Shadows for facilitating learning with LLMs: Math performance, anxiety and confidence in simulated students and AIs

author.name: Naomi Esposito, Anthony Tricarico, Luisa Porzio, Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili, Massimo Stella

entry.summary: Introduces MEDS dataset mapping how 14 LLMs reason about mathematics across 28,000 persona configurations, examining math performance, anxiety simulations, and confidence patterns when LLMs shadow humans vs AI assistants.

entry.title: Rethinking Agentic Reinforcement Learning In Large Language Models

author.name: Fangming Cui, Ruixiao Zhu, Cheng Fang, Sunan Li, Jiahong Li

entry.summary: Provides a survey/position paper on agentic reinforcement learning in LLMs, discussing the paradigm shift from traditional RL to autonomous agents with cognitive-like capabilities for open-ended environments.

entry.title: The Effects of Visual Priming on Cooperative Behavior in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Kenneth J. K. Ong

entry.summary: Investigates effects of visual priming on VLM cooperative behavior in Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, finding that images depicting behavioral concepts and color-coded matrices can influence VLM decision patterns.

entry.title: A Pattern Language for Resilient Visual Agents

author.name: Habtom Kahsay Gidey, Alexander Lenz, Alois Knoll

entry.summary: Proposes an architectural pattern language for visual agents that separates fast deterministic reflexes from slow probabilistic supervision, consisting of four design patterns for integrating multimodal models into enterprise systems.

entry.title: The Impact of LLM Self-Consistency and Reasoning Effort on Automated Scoring Accuracy and Cost

author.name: Scott Frohn

entry.summary: Examines how self-consistency (majority voting) and reasoning effort affect automated scoring accuracy in education, finding strategic model selection is more effective than ensembling and higher reasoning effort shows positive linear trend with accuracy.

entry.title: Entropy-Dominated Temporal Vocal Dynamics as Digital Biomarkers for Depression Detection

author.name: Himadri S Samanta

entry.summary: Investigates entropy-dominated temporal vocal dynamics as digital biomarkers for depression detection, finding that Shannon entropy biomarkers produce stronger statistical signals (AUC 0.676) than static feature pooling (AUC 0.593).

entry.title: PALCAS: A Priority-Aware Intelligent Lane Change Advisory System for Autonomous Vehicles using Federated Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yassine Ibork, Nhat Ha Nguyen, Myounggyu Won, Lokesh Das

entry.summary: Presents PALCAS, a priority-aware lane change advisory system using federated multi-agent reinforcement learning that prioritizes lane changes based on vehicle destination urgency.

entry.title: Preserving Temporal Dynamics in Time Series Generation

author.name: Ci Lin, Futong Li, Tet Yeap, Iluju Kiringa

entry.summary: Proposes an MCMC-based framework for time series generation that preserves temporal dynamics by mitigating distribution shift and temporal drift, designed as a model-agnostic enhancement for GANs.

entry.title: Improving Graph Few-shot Learning with Hyperbolic Space and Denoising Diffusion

author.name: Yonghao Liu, Jialu Sun, Wei Pang, Fausto Giunchiglia, Ximing Li, Xiaoyue Feng, Renchu Guan

entry.summary: Proposes a graph few-shot learning method that combines hyperbolic space representations (to capture hierarchical structure) with denoising diffusion (to improve target distribution estimation during meta-testing with few samples).

entry.title: HAVEN: Hybrid Automated Verification ENgine for UVM Testbench Synthesis with LLMs

author.name: Chang-Chih Meng, Yu-Ren Lu, Guan-Yu Lin, Tsung Tai Yeh, Kai-Chiang Wu, I-Chen Wu

entry.summary: Proposes HAVEN, a system that uses LLM agents to generate UVM testbenches for IC verification by preventing LLMs from writing HDL directly, instead using template-based approaches and specification analysis to overcome LLMs' weakness with hardware description languages.

entry.title: Learning to Reason: Targeted Knowledge Discovery and Fuzzy Logic Update for Robust Image Recognition

author.name: Gurucharan Srinivas, Joshua Niemeijer, Frank K\"oster

entry.summary: Proposes a Differentiable Knowledge Unit (DKU) that discovers and integrates implicit domain knowledge into classifiers through fuzzy logic rules, learning relationships between task classes and implicit concepts without requiring concept labels.

entry.title: To Build or Not to Build? Factors that Lead to Non-Development or Abandonment of AI Systems

author.name: Shreya Chappidi, Jatinder Singh

entry.summary: Investigates factors leading to non-development or abandonment of AI systems through a scoping review of academic literature, civil society resources, and grey literature, developing a taxonomy of pre-deployment decision factors.

entry.title: Fidelity, Diversity, and Privacy: A Multi-Dimensional LLM Evaluation for Clinical Data Augmentation

author.name: Guillermo Iglesias, Gema Bello-Orgaz, Mar\'ia Navas-Loro, Cristian Ramirez-Atencia, Merc\`e Salvador Robert, Enrique Baca-Garcia

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, OpenBioLLM, Qwen 3.5) for generating synthetic mental health reports conditioned on ICD-10 codes, proposing a comprehensive evaluation framework assessing fidelity, diversity, and privacy along multiple dimensions.

entry.title: PINN-Cast: Exploring the Role of Continuous-Depth NODE in Transformers and Physics Informed Loss as Soft Physical Constraints in Short-term Weather Forecasting

author.name: Hira Saleem, Flora Salim, Cormac Purcell

entry.summary: Proposes PINN-Cast, replacing discrete transformer encoder layers with Neural ODE-based continuous-depth updates for weather forecasting, while adding physics-informed loss as soft constraints. Combines data-driven and physics-based approaches.

entry.title: FMCL: Class-Aware Client Clustering with Foundation Model Representations for Heterogeneous Federated Learning

author.name: Mahad Ali, Laura J. Brattain

entry.summary: Proposes FMCL, a one-shot client clustering framework for federated learning that uses frozen foundation model representations to create semantic client signatures, enabling class-aware clustering without iterative coordination.

entry.title: Explainable Load Forecasting with Covariate-Informed Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Matthias Hertel, Alexandra Nikoltchovska, Sebastian P\"utz, Ralf Mikut, Benjamin Sch\"afer, Veit Hagenmeyer

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient SHAP computation algorithm for Time Series Foundation Models that leverages their flexibility with input context length and covariates, enabling scalable explanations for energy system forecasting.

entry.title: EdgeSpike: Spiking Neural Networks for Low-Power Autonomous Sensing in Edge IoT Architectures

author.name: Gustav Olaf Yunus Laitinen-Fredriksson Lundstrom-Imanov, Taner Yilmaz

entry.summary: Proposes EdgeSpike, a co-designed SNN framework for edge IoT combining surrogate-gradient training, hardware-aware NAS, event-driven runtime for neuromorphic chips, and local plasticity for on-device adaptation.

entry.title: Diffusion-OAMP for Joint Image Compression and Wireless Transmission

author.name: Wentao Hou, Yimin Bai, Zelei Luo, Jiadong Hong, Lei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Diffusion-OAMP, a training-free framework that embeds a pre-trained diffusion model into the OAMP (Orthogonal Approximate Message Passing) algorithm for joint image compression and wireless transmission, using SNR-matching between linear and nonlinear estimators.

entry.title: AppTek Call-Center Dialogues: A Multi-Accent Long-Form Benchmark for English ASR

author.name: Eugen Beck, Sarah Beranek, Uma Moothiringote, Daniel Mann, Wilfried Michel, Katie Nguyen, Taylor Tragemann

entry.summary: Presents AppTek Call-Center Dialogues, a multi-accent English ASR evaluation corpus with 14 accents, 16 service scenarios, and spontaneous role-played conversations specifically commissioned for evaluation to avoid training data overlap.

entry.title: Stable Behavior, Limited Variation: Persona Validity in LLM Agents for Urban Sentiment Perception

author.name: Neemias B da Silva, Rodrigo Minetto, Daniel Silver, Thiago H Silva

entry.summary: Tests persona prompting in multimodal LLMs for urban sentiment perception, finding strong within-persona consistency but limited cross-persona differentiation across gender, economic status, political orientation, and personality dimensions.

entry.title: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild

author.name: Wongi Park, Jordan A. James, Myeongseok Nam, Minjae Lee, Soomok Lee, Sang-Hyun Lee, William J. Beksi

entry.summary: Proposes a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for sparse-view novel view synthesis in unconstrained real-world scenarios with distractors. Uses reference-guided view refinement with diffusion models and transient masks to handle sparse unconstrained image collections.

entry.title: EdgeFM: Efficient Edge Inference for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Mengling Deng, Yuanpeng Chen, Sheng Yang, Wei Tao, Wenhai Zhang, Hui Song, Linyuanhao Qin, Kai Zhao, Xiaojun Ye, Shanhui Mo, Jingli Fan, Shuang Zhang, Bei Liu, Tiankun Zhao, Xiangjing An

entry.summary: Proposes EdgeFM, a lightweight agent-driven inference framework for deploying VLMs/LLMs on edge devices. Uses AI agents to search and tune configurations for generating optimized low-level kernels, enabling cross-platform industrial edge deployment.

entry.title: Dynamic Cluster Data Sampling for Efficient and Long-Tail-Aware Vision-Language Pre-training

author.name: Mingliang Liang, Zhuoran Liu, Arjen P. de Vries, Martha Larson

entry.summary: DynamiCS introduces dynamic cluster-based sampling for efficient VLM pre-training that upsamples small clusters and downsamples large ones, specifically addressing the problem of long-tail concept loss during data pruning.

entry.title: Continuous-tone Simple Points: An $\ell_0$-Norm of Cyclic Gradient for Topology-Preserving Data-Driven Image Segmentation

author.name: Wenxiao Li, Faqiang Wang, Yuping Duan, Li Cui, Liqiang Zhang, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes continuous-tone simple points using the ℓ0-norm of cyclic gradient for topology-preserving image segmentation, enabling differentiable topological inference compatible with deep learning optimization.

entry.title: Compressing ACAS-Xu Lookup Tables with Binary Decision Diagrams

author.name: Martin Boniol (ISAE-SUPAERO), Julien Brunel (ISAE-SUPAERO), Jean-Baptiste Chaudron (ISAE-SUPAERO), Christophe Garion (ISAE-SUPAERO), Xavier Thirioux (ISAE-SUPAERO)

entry.summary: Proposes using Binary Decision Diagrams to compress ACAS-Xu lookup tables while preserving exact semantics, enabling sound formal verification unlike neural network approximations that introduce errors.

entry.title: Robot Planning and Situation Handling with Active Perception

author.name: Austine Oloo, Zainab Altaweel, Yohei Hayamizu, Peiqi Liu, Yan Ding, Saeid Amiri, Hao Yang, Andy Kaminski, Chad Esselink, Chris Paxton, Xiaohan Zhang, Shiqi Zhang

entry.summary: VAP-TAMP develops a planning and situation-handling framework that enables robots to actively perceive and address unforeseen situations during plan execution using action knowledge and active perception.

entry.title: Learning-Based Hierarchical Scene Graph Matching for Robot Localization Leveraging Prior Maps

author.name: Nimrod Millenium Ndulue, Jose Andres Millan-Romera, Matteo Giorgi, Holger Voos, Jose Luis Sanchez-Lopez

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based method for hierarchical scene graph matching between robot observations and architectural priors (like BIM models) for indoor localization. Addresses the scalability limitations of combinatorial matching approaches while handling the hierarchical structure of scene graphs.

entry.title: AI unemployment and AI extinction are often the same

author.name: KatjaGrace

entry.summary: Argues that AI unemployment and AI extinction risk are fundamentally the same issue—both involve humans losing power and resources to more capable agents with different goals. The distinction is one of degree rather than kind.

entry.title: Generate Your Talking Avatar from Video Reference

author.name: Zujin Guo, Zhenhui Ye, Yi Ren, Yuanming Li, Ce Chen, Zhibin Hong, Chen Change Loy

entry.summary: TAVR introduces a framework for generating talking avatars from cross-scene video references rather than single static images, using token selection and a three-stage training scheme to bridge cross-scene domain gaps.

entry.title: Evaluating TabPFN for Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Conversion in Data Limited Settings

author.name: Brad Ye, Bulent Soykan, Gulsah Hancerliogullari Koksalmis, Hsin-Hsiung Huang, Laura J. Brattain

entry.summary: Evaluates TabPFN (a pre-trained tabular model) against traditional ML methods for predicting MCI-to-Alzheimer's conversion. TabPFN achieves competitive performance especially with small training sets (N=50-200).

entry.title: MM-StanceDet: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-modal Multi-agent Stance Detection

author.name: Weihai Lu, Zhejun Zhao, Yanshu Li, Huan He

entry.summary: Proposes MM-StanceDet, a multi-agent framework for multimodal stance detection integrating retrieval augmentation, specialized analysis agents, reasoning-enhanced debate, and self-reflection for robust adjudication.

entry.title: Collaborative Agent Reasoning Engineering (CARE): A Three-Party Design Methodology for Systematically Engineering AI Agents with Subject Matter Experts, Developers, and Helper Agents

author.name: Rahul Ramachandran, Nidhi Jha, Muthukumaran Ramasubramanian

entry.summary: Presents CARE methodology for engineering LLM agents in scientific domains through a three-party workflow involving subject matter experts, developers, and LLM helper agents, with systematic stage-gated phases.

entry.title: Multibit neural inference in a N-ary crossbar architecture

author.name: Anatole Moureaux, Anthony Lopes Temporao, Flavio Abreu Araujo

entry.summary: Presents a simulation framework for N-ary crossbar architectures using magnetic tunnel junctions for in-memory neural network inference, achieving 94.48% on MNIST with 4-state MTJ devices.

entry.title: Beyond Accuracy: LLM Variability in Evidence Screening for Software Engineering SLRs

author.name: Gilberto Sussumu Hida, Danilo Monteiro Ribeiro, Erika Yahata

entry.summary: Assesses LLM performance and variability in evidence screening for systematic literature reviews, comparing 12 LLMs from 4 providers with 4 classical models under a shared protocol.

entry.title: RAY-TOLD: Ray-Based Latent Dynamics for Dense Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance with TDMPC

author.name: Seungho Han, Seokju Lee, Jeonguk Kang

entry.summary: Proposes RAY-TOLD, a hybrid control architecture for robot navigation in dense crowds that combines LiDAR-based latent dynamics with reinforcement learning and physics-based MPPI control for long-horizon obstacle avoidance.

entry.title: APPSI-139: A Parallel Corpus of English Application Privacy Policy Summarization and Interpretation

author.name: Pengyun Zhu, Qiheng Sun, Long Wen, Yanbo Wang, Yang Cao, Junxu Liu, Deyi Xiong, Jinfei Liu, Zhibo Wang, Kui Ren

entry.summary: Introduces APPSI-139, a high-quality parallel corpus of 139 English privacy policies with 15,692 rewritten segments annotated by domain experts for summarization and interpretation tasks, addressing the complexity of privacy policy documents.

entry.title: CastFlow: Learning Role-Specialized Agentic Workflows for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Bokai Pan, Mingyue Cheng, Zhiding Liu, Shuo Yu, Xiaoyu Tao, Yuchong Wu, Qi Liu, Defu Lian, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes CastFlow, a dynamic agentic framework for time series forecasting using LLMs with role-specialized agents for multi-view pattern extraction, iterative refinement, and ensemble forecasting.

entry.title: PROMISE-AD: Progression-aware Multi-horizon Survival Estimation for Alzheimer's Disease Progression and Dynamic Tracking

author.name: Qing Lyu, Jeremy Hudson, Mohammad Kawas, Yuming Jiang, Chenyu You, Christopher T Whitlow

entry.summary: Proposes PROMISE-AD, a leakage-safe survival framework for predicting Alzheimer's disease progression using temporal Transformer with tokenized visit histories, addressing irregular visits, censoring, and diagnostic leakage.

entry.title: DEFault++: Automated Fault Detection, Categorization, and Diagnosis for Transformer Architectures

author.name: Sigma Jahan, Saurabh Singh Rajput, Tushar Sharma, Mohammad Masudur Rahman

entry.summary: Presents DEFault++, a hierarchical diagnostic system for transformer architectures that detects faults, classifies them into 12 transformer-specific categories, and identifies root causes across attention mechanisms and architectural components.

entry.title: Context-Aware Graph Attention for Unsupervised Telco Anomaly Detection

author.name: Sara Malacarne, Eirik Hoel-H{\o}iseth, Erlend Aune, David Zsolt Biro, Massimiliano Ruocco

entry.summary: Proposes C-MTAD-GAT, an unsupervised graph-attention model for anomaly detection in mobile network time series that combines context embeddings with reconstruction and forecasting heads. Deployed in a national mobile operator's core network, outperforming baselines.

entry.title: AMGenC: Generating Charge Balanced Amorphous Materials

author.name: Yan Lin, Jilin Hu, N. M. Anoop Krishnan, Morten M. Smedskjaer

entry.summary: Introduces AMGenC, a generative model for designing charge-balanced amorphous materials using probabilistic models conditioned on desired properties, addressing the challenge of generating large-scale disordered structures.

entry.title: Calibrating Attribution Proxies for Reward Allocation in Participatory Weather Sensing

author.name: Mark C. Ballandies, Michael T. C. Chiu, Claudio J. Tessone

entry.summary: Proposes using differentiable AI weather models for gradient-based attribution to value individual sensor contributions in participatory weather sensing networks, evaluating fidelity and gaming vulnerability.

entry.title: Budget-Constrained Online Retrieval-Augmented Generation: The Chunk-as-a-Service Model

author.name: Shawqi Al-Maliki, Ammar Gharaibeh, Mohamed Rahouti, Mohammad Ruhul Amin, Mohamed Abdallah, Junaid Qadir, Ala Al-Fuqaha

entry.summary: Proposes a Chunk-as-a-Service pricing model for RAG systems where costs are based on chunk relevance quality rather than prompt count, formulated as a constrained online optimization problem.

entry.title: State-Dependent Lyapunov Method for Rank-1 Matrix Factorization

author.name: Jaehong Moon

entry.summary: Analyzes gradient descent for rank-1 matrix factorization using a state-dependent Lyapunov framework, deriving convergence certificates from structural axioms.

entry.title: Proactive Dialogue Model with Intent Prediction

author.name: Yang Luo

entry.summary: Introduces a proactive dialogue model that uses a Temporal Bayesian Network to predict upcoming user intents, reducing turns needed for intent coverage in multi-intent conversations.

entry.title: Cross-Lingual Response Consistency in Large Language Models: An ILR-Informed Evaluation of Claude Across Six Languages

author.name: Camelia Baluta

entry.summary: Evaluates Claude Sonnet 4.6 across six languages using ILR-grounded prompts, finding 30% length differences between French and German responses and high cross-lingual variation in creative/affective tasks.

entry.title: Syntactically-guided Information Maintenance in Sentence Comprehension

author.name: Shinnosuke Isono, Kohei Kajikawa

entry.summary: Tests hypothesis that language users selectively maintain information guided by syntactic structure during comprehension, showing both predicted heads and incomplete dependencies independently affect processing cost in Japanese reading data.

entry.title: JaiTTS: A Thai Voice Cloning Model

author.name: Jullajak Karnjanaekarin, Pontakorn Trakuekul, Narongkorn Panitsrisit, Sumana Sumanakul, Vichayuth Nitayasomboon, Nithid Guntasin, Thanavin Denkavin, Attapol T. Rutherford

entry.summary: Presents JaiTTS-v1.0, a Thai voice cloning TTS model achieving state-of-the-art CER of 1.94% (surpassing human ground truth of 1.98%) for short-duration tasks, with native handling of Thai-English code-switching.

entry.title: RoadMapper: A Multi-Agent System for Roadmap Generation of Solving Complex Research Problems

author.name: Jiacheng Liu, Zichen Tang, Zhongjun Yang, Xinyi Hu, Xueyuan Lin, Linwei Jia, Ruofei Bai, Rongjin Li, Shiyao Peng, Haocheng Gao, Haihong E

entry.summary: Introduces RoadMapper, a multi-agent system for generating research roadmaps that decompose complex problems into hierarchical subtasks, addressing limitations of LLMs in professional knowledge, task decomposition, and logical ordering.

entry.title: Universal statistical laws governing culinary design

author.name: Ganesh Bagler, Gopal Krishna Tewari, Aditya Raj Yadav, Akshat Singh, Pranay Bansal, Ujjval Dargar, Mansi Goel, Madhvi Kumari Sinha

entry.summary: Analyzes a large corpus of global recipes using NER-annotated culinary attributes, finding Zipf's law in ingredient usage, Heaps' law in culinary diversity growth, and other universal statistical patterns across cuisines.

entry.title: Measuring research data reuse in scholarly publications using generative artificial intelligence: Open Science Indicator development and preliminary results

author.name: Lauren Cadwallader, Iain Hrynaszkiewicz, parth sarin, Tim Vines

entry.summary: Develops an LLM-based indicator to measure research data reuse at scale, finding a 43% data reuse rate (higher than bibliometric techniques), suggesting positive effects of open science may be underestimated.

entry.title: Automated Detection of Mutual Gaze and Joint Attention in Dual-Camera Settings via Dual-Stream Transformers

author.name: Jakub Kosmydel, Pawe{\l} Gajewski, Arkadiusz Bia{\l}ek

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-stream Transformer architecture for detecting mutual gaze and joint attention from synchronized dual-camera recordings, using frozen GazeLLE backbones with custom token fusion for caregiver-infant interaction analysis.

entry.title: AttriBE: Quantifying Attribute Expressivity in Body Embeddings for Recognition and Identification

author.name: Basudha Pal, Siyuan Huang, Anirudh Nanduri, Zhaoyang Wang, Rama Chellappa

entry.summary: Extends expressivity analysis to person re-identification by measuring mutual information between learned features and attributes (gender, pose, BMI) across transformer-based ReID models, finding BMI shows highest expressivity in deeper layers.

entry.title: Iterative Definition Refinement for Zero-Shot Classification via LLM-Based Semantic Prototype Optimization

author.name: Naeem Rehmat, Muhammad Saad Saeed, Ijaz Ul Haq, Khalid Malik

entry.summary: Proposes iterative definition refinement using LLMs to optimize category definitions for embedding-based zero-shot web content classification, improving separation in semantic space without training.

entry.title: JI-ADF: Joint-Individual Learning with Adaptive Decision Fusion for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification

author.name: Phan Nguyen, Dat Cao, Quang Hien Kha, Hien Chu, Minh H. N. Le, Trang Quoc Thao Pham, Nguyen Quoc Khanh Le

entry.summary: Proposes JI-ADF, a trimodal deep learning framework integrating dermoscopic images, clinical photographs, and patient metadata for skin lesion classification with adaptive decision fusion calibrating modality contributions per-sample.

entry.title: Context as Prior: Bayesian-Inspired Intent Inference for Non-Speaking Agents with a Household Cat Testbed

author.name: Wenqian Zhang, Zehao Wang

entry.summary: Presents CatSignal, a Bayesian-inspired framework for inferring intent from non-speaking agents (pets, pre-verbal infants) using spatial context as priors and behavioral observations as evidence. Tested on a household cat testbed.

entry.title: Towards All-Day Perception for Off-Road Driving: A Large-Scale Multispectral Dataset and Comprehensive Benchmark

author.name: Shuo Wang, Jilin Mei, Wenfei Guan, Shuai Wang, Yan Xing, Chen Min, Yu Hu

entry.summary: Presents IRON, the first large-scale infrared dataset for off-road temporal freespace detection under all-day conditions, with 24,314 annotated infrared images. Proposes IRONet for temporal infrared freespace detection.

entry.title: Residual Gaussian Splatting for Ultra Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction

author.name: Jian Lin, Jiancheng Fang, Shaoyu Wang, Changan Lai, Yikun Zhang, Yang Chen, Qiegen Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Residual Gaussian Splatting (RGS) for ultra sparse-view CBCT reconstruction, integrating wavelet multi-resolution analysis with 3DGS. Addresses the mathematical mismatch between non-negative X-ray attenuation and bipolar wavelet coefficients.

entry.title: Noise2Map: End-to-End Diffusion Model for Semantic Segmentation and Change Detection

author.name: Ali Shibli, Andrea Nascetti, Yifang Ban

entry.summary: Noise2Map applies diffusion model principles to semantic segmentation and change detection in remote sensing, using Gaussian noise denoising for discriminative tasks without extensive pretraining.

entry.title: Towards Topology-Aware Very Large-Scale Photonic AI Accelerators

author.name: Belal Jahannia, Abdolah Amirany, Hamed Dalir

entry.summary: Presents a scalable photonic accelerator architecture using a modular 4×4 photonic tensor core design with systematic analysis of practical scaling limits including insertion loss and fanout constraints.

entry.title: Flying by Inference: Active Inference World Models for Adaptive UAV Swarms

author.name: Kaleem Arshid, Ali Krayani, Lucio Marcenaro, David Martin Gomez, Carlo Regazzoni

entry.summary: Presents an active-inference-inspired framework for UAV swarm trajectory planning that converts the problem from combinatorial optimization into hierarchical probabilistic inference. Uses expert demonstrations from a genetic algorithm planner to learn probabilistic world models at mission, route, and motion levels.

entry.title: SFF's HSEE grant round; human intelligence amplification projects I'd like to see

author.name: TsviBT

entry.summary: Announces the Survival and Flourishing Fund's themed grant round on Human Self-Enhancement and Empowerment, listing research areas including reprogenetics, brain interfaces, gene editing, and intelligence amplification. Calls for researchers and projects seeking funding.

entry.title: Maybe I was too harsh on deep learning theory (three days ago)

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: Author reconsiders previous skepticism about deep learning theory, finding that infinite-width/depth limit work (NTK, neural network Gaussian processes) turned out more interesting than initially assessed. Discusses how theory illuminates deep learning phenomena.

entry.title: RIHA: Report-Image Hierarchical Alignment for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: Yucheng Chen, Yang Yu, Yufei Shi, Conghao Xiong, Xulei Yang, Si Yong Yeo

entry.summary: Proposes RIHA, a framework for radiology report generation that achieves hierarchical alignment between images and the structured sections of reports using a transformer architecture that respects report semantic hierarchies.

entry.title: Design Structure Matrix Modularization with Large Language Models

author.name: Shuo Jiang, Jianxi Luo

entry.summary: Applies LLMs to Design Structure Matrix modularization (system decomposition), finding near-reference quality within 30 iterations but counterintuitively showing that domain knowledge impairs performance on complex DSMs.

entry.title: Stable but Wrong: An Inference Limit in Galactic Archaeology

author.name: Zhipeng Zhang

entry.summary: Demonstrates a fundamental inference limit in galactic archaeology: as observational quality improves, inferred stellar ages converge to a stable but systematically biased result rather than the true value, challenging the assumption that more data yields better science.

entry.title: FiLMMeD: Feature-wise Linear Modulation for Cross-Problem Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing

author.name: Arthur Corr\^ea, Paulo Nascimento, Samuel Moniz

entry.summary: Proposes FiLMMeD, using Feature-wise Linear Modulation to create a unified neural solver for multiple multi-depot vehicle routing problem variants, enabling cross-problem generalization.

entry.title: VTBench: A Multimodal Framework for Time-Series Classification with Chart-Based Representations

author.name: Madhumitha Venkatesan, Xuyang Chen, Dongyu Liu

entry.summary: Introduces VTBench, a framework for evaluating time series classification using chart-based visual representations with multimodal models, systematically comparing chart types and visual encodings.

entry.title: World2Minecraft: Occupancy-Driven Simulated Scenes Construction

author.name: Lechao Zhang, Haoran Xu, Jingyu Gong, Xuhong Wang, Yuan Xie, Xin Tan

entry.summary: World2Minecraft converts real-world scenes into structured Minecraft environments using 3D semantic occupancy prediction, enabling embodied AI tasks like vision-language navigation. Includes a scalable data acquisition pipeline for occupancy prediction.

entry.title: MSR:Hybrid Field Modeling for CT-MRI Rigid-Deformable Registration of the Cervical Spine with an Annotated Dataset

author.name: Bohai Zhang, Wenjie Chen, Mu Li, Kaixing Long, Xing Shen, Xinqiang Yao, Jincheng Yang, Jianting Chen, Wei Yang, Qianjin Feng, Lei Cao

entry.summary: Proposes MSR, a rigid-deformable hybrid registration framework for cervical spine CT-MRI alignment, along with R-D-Reg, a comprehensively annotated CT-MRI dataset for this underexplored but clinically important task.

entry.title: Frequency-Aware Semantic Fusion with Gated Injection for AI-generated Image Detection

author.name: Shuchang Zhou, Shangkun Wu, Jiwei Wei, Ke Liu, Ran Ran, Caiyan Qin, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a Frequency-aware Gated Injection Network for AI-generated image detection that addresses frequency shortcut bias and cross-domain representation conflict between semantic and frequency features.

entry.title: Are DeepFakes Realistic Enough? Exploring Semantic Mismatch as a Novel Challenge

author.name: Sharayu Nilesh Deshmukh, Kailash A. Hambarde, Joana C. Costa, Hugo Proen\c{c}a, Tiago Roxo

entry.summary: Proposes a new evaluation setup for deepfake detection that models semantic-level inconsistency between authentic modalities, introducing a 'Real Audio-Real Video with Semantic Mismatch' class beyond binary or four-class formulations.

entry.title: Dreaming Across Towns: Semantic Rollout and Town-Adversarial Regularization for Zero-Shot Held-Out-Town Fixed-Route Driving in CARLA

author.name: Feeza Khan Khanzada, Jaerock Kwon

entry.summary: Studies zero-shot transfer of autonomous driving agents across unseen towns in CARLA simulator using a Dreamer-style world model augmented with semantic rollout prediction and town-adversarial regularization. Isolates the structural town shift problem by fixing weather and removing traffic.

entry.title: ZAYAN: Disentangled Contrastive Transformer for Tabular Remote Sensing Data

author.name: Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib, Tanpia Tasnim, Md. Ekramul Islam, Muntasir Tabasum

entry.summary: Presents ZAYAN, a self-supervised contrastive learning framework for tabular remote sensing data that performs feature-level (not sample-level) contrastive learning without anchor selection or class labels, using dynamic perturbations and masking.

entry.title: FedHarmony: Harmonizing Heterogeneous Label Correlations in Federated Multi-Label Learning

author.name: Zhiqiang Kou, Junxiang Wu, Wenke Huang, Wenwen He, Ming-Kun Xie, Changwei Wang, Yuheng Jia, Di Jiang, Yang Liu, Xin Geng, Qiang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FedHarmony to address label correlation drift in federated multi-label learning, using consensus correlations as global teachers to correct biased local label dependency models.

entry.title: SCOPE-FE: Structured Control of Operator and Pairwise Exploration for Feature Engineering

author.name: Minhee Park, Seongyeon Son, Yonghyun Lee, Eunchan Kim

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE-FE, a structured search space control framework that reduces the combinatorial explosion in automatic feature engineering by jointly controlling operator and feature-pair spaces.

entry.title: SECOS: Semantic Capture for Rigorous Classification in Open-World Semi-Supervised Learning

author.name: Hezhao Liu, Jiacheng Yang, Junlong Gao, Mengke Li, Yiqun Zhang, Shreyank N Gowda, Yang Lu

entry.summary: SECOS addresses open-world semi-supervised learning by extracting latent semantic information to enable direct textual label prediction for novel classes. Existing methods fail because novel samples lack explicit supervision and semantic correspondence.

entry.title: SpaAct: Spatially-Activated Transition Learning with Curriculum Adaptation for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Pengna Li, Kangyi Wu, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Hanbing Li, Lin Zhao, Kailin Lyu, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Nanning Zheng

entry.summary: SpaAct proposes a training framework for vision-language navigation that activates spatial awareness in VLMs through two tasks: Action Retrospection (inferring past actions from visual transitions) and Future Frame Selection (predicting visual outcomes).

entry.title: HiMix: Hierarchical Artifact-aware Mixup for Generalized Synthetic Image Detection

author.name: Shuchang Zhou, Kaiwen Shen, Jiwei Wei, Yuyang Zhou, Peng Wang, Yang Yang

entry.summary: HiMix proposes a framework for generalized synthetic image detection using hierarchical artifact-aware mixup to expand training distribution and promote artifact-aware representations, addressing poor generalization to unseen generators.

entry.title: Mechanized Foundations of Structural Governance: Machine-Checked Proofs for Governed Intelligence

author.name: Alan L. McCann

entry.summary: Presents machine-checked proofs in Coq for structural governance of cognitive workflow systems, establishing coinductive safety predicates and governance invariance theorems for infinite program behaviors.

entry.title: The TEA Nets framework combines AI and cognitive network science to model targets, events and actors in text

author.name: Sebastiano Franchini, Alexis Carrillo, Edoardo Sebastiano De Duro, Riccardo Improta, Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili, Massimo Stella

entry.summary: Introduces TEA Nets (Target-Event-Agent Networks) combining cognitive network science and AI to extract subjects, verbs, and objects from texts for interpretable analysis of conspiracy texts and LLM outputs.

entry.title: Building Persona-Based Agents On Demand: Tailoring Multi-Agent Workflows to User Needs

author.name: Giuseppe Arbore, Andrea Sillano, Luigi De Russis

entry.summary: Argues for on-demand persona-based agent generation that dynamically creates agents matched to user characteristics and task demands at runtime, rather than using fixed agent architectures.

entry.title: Normativity and Productivism: Ableist Intelligence? A Degrowth Analysis of AI Sign Language Translation Tools for Deaf People

author.name: Nina Seron-Abouelfadil, Poppy Fynes

entry.summary: Critically analyzes AI sign language translation tools through a degrowth and disability studies lens, arguing these systems are built from biased data without deaf community input and perpetuate ableist norms.

entry.title: Policy-Governed LLM Routing with Intent Matching for Instrument Laboratories

author.name: Emmanuel A. Olowe, Danial Chitnis

entry.summary: Describes a policy-governed routing system for LLM-based lab assistance that manages multiple LLM backends with configurable budgets, approval workflows, and embedding-based question matching for engineering education labs.

entry.title: A Gated Hybrid Contrastive Collaborative Filtering Recommendation

author.name: Eduardo Ferreira da Silva, Mayki dos Santos Oliveira, Joel Machado Pires, Denis Dantas Boaventura, Maycon Maciel Peixoto, Cassio Serafim Prazeres, Gustavo Bittencourt Figueiredo, Miriam Capretz, Frederico Araujo Dur\~ao

entry.summary: Proposes a gated hybrid collaborative filtering framework that integrates review-derived representations through adaptive gating and contrastive learning for top-N recommendation.

entry.title: Learning to Spend: Model Predictive Control for Budgeting under Non-Stationary Returns

author.name: Nilavra Pathak, Smriti Shyamal, Prasant Mhasker, Christopher Swartz

entry.summary: Studies Model Predictive Control for budget allocation, finding MPC only outperforms reactive baselines when return dynamics follow predictable deterministic trends rather than stochastic drift.

entry.title: Upskilling with Generative AI: Practices and Challenges for Freelance Knowledge Workers

author.name: Kashif Imteyaz, Isabel Lopez, Nakul Rajpal, Hunjun Shin, Saiph Savage

entry.summary: Mixed-methods study of how freelance knowledge workers use generative AI for upskilling, examining practices, challenges, and how AI-powered learning intersects with platform work precarity.

entry.title: Toward Autonomous SOC Operations: End-to-End LLM Framework for Threat Detection, Query Generation, and Resolution in Security Operations

author.name: Md Hasan Saju, Akramul Azim

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end framework for Security Operations Centers that combines ensemble LLM-based threat detection (82.8% accuracy), syntax-constrained query generation for SIEM platforms, and retrieval-augmented resolution support. Addresses practical challenges of automated security workflows.

entry.title: AdaBFL: Multi-Layer Defensive Adaptive Aggregation for Bzantine-Robust Federated Learning

author.name: Zehui Tang, Yuchen Liu, Feihu Huang

entry.summary: Proposes AdaBFL, a multi-layer adaptive aggregation method for Byzantine-robust federated learning that provides balanced defense against multiple attack types without requiring server-side data.

entry.title: Position-Aware Drafting for Inference Acceleration in LLM-Based Generative List-Wise Recommendation

author.name: Jiaju Chen, Chongming Gao, Chenxiao Fan, Haoyan Liu, Qingpeng Cai, Peng Jiang, Xiangnan He

entry.summary: Proposes position-aware speculative decoding for LLM-based generative list-wise recommendation, where draft tokens are modeled differently based on their within-item slot position to improve inference speed.

entry.title: TransVLM: A Vision-Language Framework and Benchmark for Detecting Any Shot Transitions

author.name: Ce Chen, Yi Ren, Yuanming Li, Viktor Goriachko, Zhenhui Ye, Zujin Guo, Zhibin Hong, Mingming Gong

entry.summary: Formalizes Shot Transition Detection (beyond just boundary detection) and proposes TransVLM, a vision-language model that injects optical flow as motion prior for detecting continuous temporal segments of video transitions.

entry.title: Towards Neuro-symbolic Causal Rule Synthesis, Verification, and Evaluation Grounded in Legal and Safety Principles

author.name: Zainab Rehan, Christian Medeiros Adriano, Sona Ghahremani, Holger Giese

entry.summary: Extends a neuro-symbolic causal framework with a meta-level layer for goal/rule synthesis and verification to mitigate goal misspecification in safety-critical rule-based systems, grounded in legal and safety principles.

entry.title: Cross-Subject Generalization for EEG Decoding: A Survey of Deep Learning Methods

author.name: Taida Li, Yujun Yan, Fei Dou, Wenzhan Song, Xiang Zhang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of deep learning methods for cross-subject EEG decoding, formalizing the problem as multi-source domain adaptation and taxonomizing approaches including feature alignment, adversarial learning, and contrastive learning.

entry.title: AG-TAL: Anatomically-Guided Topology-Aware Loss for Multiclass Segmentation of the Circle of Willis Using Large-Scale Multi-Center Datasets

author.name: Jialu Liu, Yue Cui, Shan Yu

entry.summary: Introduces AG-TAL, an anatomically-guided topology-aware loss function for multiclass segmentation of the Circle of Willis vasculature, addressing vascular discontinuities and class imbalance in 3D medical imaging.

entry.title: ChipLingo: A Systematic Training Framework for Large Language Models in EDA

author.name: Lei Li, Xingwen Yu, Jianguo Ni, Junxuan Zhu, Jieqiong Zhang, Jian Zhao, Zhi Liu
