entry.summary: Argues that existing US law may provide grounds for lawsuits against AI developers for reckless endangerment, though the legal bar is high. Discusses the gap between what's needed (preventing potential harms) and what current law addresses (punishing repeated actual harms).

entry.title: OMEGA: Optimizing Machine Learning by Evaluating Generated Algorithms

author.name: Jeremy Nixon, Annika Singh

entry.summary: Introduces OMEGA, a framework for automating AI research by combining meta-prompt engineering with executable code generation to create novel ML classifiers. Claims generated algorithms outperform scikit-learn baselines across 20 benchmark datasets.

entry.title: SciHorizon-DataEVA: An Agentic System for AI-Readiness Evaluation of Heterogeneous Scientific Data

author.name: Dianyu Liu, Chuan Qin, Xi Chen, Xiaohan Li, Wenxi Xu, Yuyang Wang, Xin Chen, Yuanchun Zhou, Hengshu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SciHorizon-DataEVA, an agentic system for evaluating AI-readiness of scientific datasets across dimensions of governance, quality, AI compatibility, and scientific adaptability. Addresses the gap in systematic evaluation of data for AI4Science.

entry.title: Planar Gaussian Splatting with Bilinear Spatial Transformer for Wireless Radiance Field Reconstruction

author.name: Jinghan Zhang, Xitao Gong, Qi Wang, Richard A. Stirling-Gallacher, Giuseppe Caire

entry.summary: Introduces BiSplat-WRF, a planar Gaussian splatting framework for wireless radiance field reconstruction that models radio frequency characteristics over 3D space, incorporating global EM coupling among primitives for improved physical interpretability.

entry.title: DepthPilot: From Controllability to Interpretability in Colonoscopy Video Generation

author.name: Junhu Fu, Ke Chen, Weidong Guo, Shuyu Liang, Jie Xu, Chen Ma, Kehao Wang, Shengli Lin, Zeju Li, Yuanyuan Wang, Yi Guo, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Proposes DepthPilot, claimed as the first interpretable framework for colonoscopy video generation, using depth constraints and prior distribution alignment for anatomical fidelity in medical video synthesis.

entry.title: MetaSR: Content-Adaptive Metadata Orchestration for Generative Super-Resolution

author.name: Jiaqi Guo, Mingzhen Li, Haohong Wang, Aggelos K. Katsaggelos

entry.summary: Proposes MetaSR, a Diffusion Transformer framework for super-resolution that selects and injects task-relevant metadata to guide SR under resource constraints, adapting to varying content types.

entry.title: MappingEvolve: LLM-Driven Code Evolution for Technology Mapping

author.name: Rongliang Fu, Yi Liu, Qiang Xu, Tsung-Yi Ho

entry.summary: Introduces MappingEvolve, a framework using LLMs to directly evolve technology mapping code in logic synthesis through a hierarchical agent architecture (Planner, Evolver, Evaluator), achieving 10% improvements over baselines.

entry.title: A Toolkit for Detecting Spurious Correlations in Speech Datasets

author.name: Lara Gauder, Pablo Riera, Andrea Slachevsky, Gonzalo Forno, Adolfo M. Garc\'ia, Luciana Ferrer

entry.summary: Introduces a toolkit for detecting spurious correlations in speech datasets by analyzing non-speech regions to identify recording characteristics that leak target class information, particularly relevant for health-related speech datasets.

entry.title: Cheeger--Hodge Contrastive Learning for Structurally Robust Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Mengyang Zhao, Longlong Li, Cunquan Qu

entry.summary: Proposes Cheeger-Hodge Contrastive Learning (CHCL) that aligns a perturbation-stable signature combining algebraic connectivity with 1-Hodge Laplacian spectrum for structurally robust graph representation learning.

entry.title: Layer-wise Lipschitz-Product Control for Deep Kolmogorov--Arnold Network Representations of Compositionally Structured Functions

author.name: Aleksander Tankman

entry.summary: Proves that continuous functions representable by finite computation trees with bounded compositional sparsity admit deep KAN representations with controlled layer-wise Lipschitz products, providing approximation error bounds.

entry.title: PiGGO: Physics-Guided Learnable Graph Kalman Filters for Virtual Sensing of Nonlinear Dynamic Structures under Uncertainty

author.name: Marcus Haywood-Alexander, Gregory Duth\'e, Eleni Chatzi

entry.summary: Introduces PiGGO, a physics-guided graph neural ODE framework for virtual sensing in nonlinear dynamic structures that serves as a learned transition model within an extended Kalman filter for Bayesian state estimation.

entry.title: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark of Multiple Instance Learning for 3D Neuroimage Classification

author.name: Ethan Harvey, Dennis Johan Loevlie, Amir Ali Satani, Wansu Chen, David M. Kent, Michael C. Hughes

entry.summary: Provides systematic comparison of MIL approaches vs 3D CNNs and ViTs for neuroimage classification across seven datasets, finding MIL with frozen 2D encoders is competitive and more efficient than full 3D models.

entry.title: Associative-State Universal Transformers: Sparse Retrieval Meets Structured Recurrence

author.name: Liu Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces UniMatrix, a Universal Transformer variant with structured recurrent states, ROSA-style residual paths, and token-conditioned modulation. Shows slight improvements over Transformers at small scale with fewer parameters.

entry.title: Sample Selection Using Multi-Task Autoencoders in Federated Learning with Non-IID Data

author.name: Emre Ard{\i}\c{c}, Yakup Gen\c{c}

entry.summary: Proposes sample selection methods for federated learning using multi-task autoencoders to estimate sample contributions, employing unsupervised outlier detection to filter noisy samples in non-IID settings.

entry.title: VulStyle: A Multi-Modal Pre-Training for Code Stylometry-Augmented Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Chidera Biringa, Ajmal Abbas, Vishnu Selvaraj, Gokhan Kul

entry.summary: VulStyle is a multi-modal vulnerability detection model that jointly encodes source code, AST structure, and code stylometry features, pre-trained on 4.9M functions across seven languages.

entry.title: Inferring bifurcation diagrams of two distinct chaotic systems by a single machine

author.name: Jianmin Guo, Yao Du, Yizhen Yu, Yong Zou, Xingang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-channel reservoir computing scheme for inferring bifurcation diagrams of two distinct chaotic systems from partial observations using a single machine.

entry.title: Learning Over-Relaxation Policies for ADMM with Convergence Guarantees

author.name: Junan Lin, Paul J. Goulart, Luca Furieri

entry.summary: Proposes learning over-relaxation policies for ADMM with convergence guarantees, motivated by repeated optimization in Model Predictive Control settings.

entry.title: CogRAG+: Cognitive-Level Guided Diagnosis and Remediation of Memory and Reasoning Deficiencies in Professional Exam QA

author.name: Xudong Wang, Zilong Wang, Zhaoyan Ming

entry.summary: CogRAG+ decouples retrieval from reasoning in RAG systems using cognitive hierarchies, with dual-path retrieval strategies and diagnostic mechanisms for professional exam question answering.

entry.title: SAGE: A Strategy-Aware Graph-Enhanced Generation Framework For Online Counseling

author.name: Eliya Naomi Aharon, Meytal Grimland, Avi Segal, Loona Ben Dayan, Inbar Shenfeld, Yossi Levi Belz, Kobi Gal

entry.summary: Introduces SAGE, a strategy-aware graph-enhanced framework for online mental health counseling that constructs a heterogeneous graph unifying conversational dynamics with psychologically grounded knowledge, using a Next Strategy Classifier to guide responses.

entry.title: ViBE: Visual-to-M/EEG Brain Encoding via Spatio-Temporal VAE and Distribution-Aligned Projection

author.name: Ganxi Xu, Zhao-Rong Lai, Yuting Tang, Yonghao Song, Shuyan Zhou, Guoxu Zhou, Boyu Wang, Jian Zhu, Jinyi Long

entry.summary: Proposes ViBE, a brain encoding framework for generating MEG/EEG signals from visual stimuli using a spatio-temporal convolutional VAE and distribution-aligned projection for cross-modal alignment.

entry.title: Which Face and Whose Identity? Solving the Dual Challenge of Deepfake Proactive Forensics in Multi-Face Scenarios

author.name: Lei Zhang, Zhiqing Guo, Dan Ma, Gaobo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes DAWF for deepfake forensics in multi-face scenarios, enabling efficient parallel watermark embedding and extraction without offline pre-processing for deepfake localization and source tracing in group settings.

entry.title: 3D-LENS: A 3D Lifting-based Elevated Novel-view Synthesis method for Single-View Aerial-Ground Re-Identification

author.name: William Grolleau, Astrid Sabourin, Guillaume Lapouge, Catherine Achard

entry.summary: Proposes 3D-LENS for single-view aerial-ground re-identification, formalizing the SV AG-ReID setting where models trained on a single viewpoint must generalize to unseen viewpoints using 3D lifting and novel-view synthesis.

entry.title: State Beyond Appearance: Diagnosing and Improving State Consistency in Dial-Based Measurement Reading

author.name: Yuanze Hu, Gen Li, Yuqin Lan, Qingchen Yu, Zhichao Yang, Junwei Jing, Zhaoxin Fan, Xiaotie Deng

entry.summary: Studies MLLMs' failure on dial-based measurement reading, showing they lack robust state representations and proposing improvements through controlled benchmarks and feature-space probing that reveal viewpoint sensitivity.

entry.title: Lights Out: A Nighttime UAV Localization Framework Using Thermal Imagery and Semantic 3D Maps

author.name: Ryan Allen, Melissa Greeff

entry.summary: Presents a semantic reprojection framework for nighttime UAV localization using thermal imagery aligned with daytime RGB-derived 3D semantic maps, operating in a shared semantic domain rather than relying on appearance matching across modalities.

entry.title: Reactive Motion Generation via Phase-varying Neural Potential Functions

author.name: Ahmet Tekden, Dimitrios Kanoulas, Aude Billard, Yasemin Bekiroglu

entry.summary: Proposes phase-varying neural potential functions for learning-from-demonstration that combine phase-based trajectory tracking with potential-function-based obstacle avoidance, addressing limitations of both first-order and second-order dynamical systems for complex motion tasks.

entry.title: Stochastic Entanglement of Deterministic Origami Tentacles For Universal Robotic Gripping

author.name: Alec Boron, Bokun Zheng, Ziyang Zhou, Noel Naughton, Suyi Li

entry.summary: Introduces an origami tentacle gripper that achieves universal object gripping through a synergy of deterministic deformation programming (via creases and holes) and stochastic entanglement of multiple tentacles, using only a single tendon for actuation.

entry.title: Bridging the Gap on AI Safety Policy

author.name: James Newport

entry.summary: Reports on a competition by the Swift Centre for Applied Forecasting that asked participants to produce decision-ready policy advice based on AI forecasts, bridging the gap between abstract AI safety research and practical government policy-making. Received 29 submissions across 5 scenarios.

entry.title: Correcting Performance Estimation Bias in Imbalanced Classification with Minority Subconcepts

author.name: Taylor Maxson, Roberto Corizzo, Yaning Wu, Nathalie Japkowicz, Colin Bellinger

entry.summary: Introduces a practical utility-weighted evaluation for imbalanced classification that replaces unavailable subconcept labels with predicted posterior probabilities, addressing hidden performance disparities across minority subconcepts.

entry.title: Ceci n'est pas une explication: Evaluating Explanation Failures as Explainability Pitfalls in Language Learning Systems

author.name: Ben Knight, Wm. Matthew Kennedy, James Edgell

entry.summary: Evaluates how AI-powered language learning tools can fail in providing feedback, presenting a benchmark (L2-Bench) covering six dimensions of effective feedback including diagnostic accuracy, error causes, and guidance for improvement.

entry.title: Seeking Consensus: Geometric-Semantic On-the-Fly Recalibration for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Guanchun Wang, Chenxiao Wu, Xiangrong Zhang, Zelin Peng, Jianxun Lai, Tianyang Zhang, Xu Tang

entry.summary: Proposes SeeCo, a plug-and-play framework for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation in remote sensing that recalibrates models on-the-fly through geometric consensus learning and semantic consensus distillation.

entry.title: StratMem-Bench: Evaluating Strategic Memory Use in Virtual Character Conversation Beyond Factual Recall

author.name: Yerong Wu, Tianxing Wu, Minghao Zhu, Hangyu Sha, Haofen Wang

entry.summary: Introduces StratMem-Bench for evaluating strategic memory use in virtual character conversations, going beyond factual recall to assess dynamic deployment of memory for social engagement.

entry.title: TimeMM: Time-as-Operator Spectral Filtering for Dynamic Multimodal Recommendation

author.name: Wei Yang, Rui Zhong, Zihan Lin, Xiaodan Wang, Cheng Chen, Huan Ren, Yao Hu

entry.summary: Proposes TimeMM, a time-conditioned spectral filtering framework for dynamic multimodal recommendation that models continuous preference evolution with fine-grained temporal adaptation across visual and textual modalities.

entry.title: Atomic-Probe Governance for Skill Updates in Compositional Robot Policies

author.name: Xue Qin, Simin Luan, John See, Cong Yang, Zhijun Li

entry.summary: Introduces a paired-sampling cross-version swap protocol for characterizing how skill library updates affect compositional robot policies, discovering a dominant-skill effect where one skill disproportionately determines composition success.

entry.title: Random Cloud: Finding Minimal Neural Architectures Without Training

author.name: Javier Gil Bl\'azquez

entry.summary: Proposes the Random Cloud method for training-free neural architecture search that discovers minimal network topologies through stochastic exploration and progressive structural reduction of randomly initialized networks.

entry.title: Resume-ing Control: (Mis)Perceptions of Agency Around GenAI Use in Recruiting Workflows

author.name: Sajel Surati, Rosanna Bellini, Emily Black

entry.summary: Through interviews with 22 recruiting professionals, investigates how generative AI subtly influences control over hiring workflows, revealing that while recruiters believe they retain authority, GenAI has become an 'invisible architect' of decisions.

entry.title: Efficient and Interpretable Transformer for Counterfactual Fairness

author.name: Panyi Dong, Zhiyu Quan

entry.summary: Proposes Feature Correlation-based Counterfactual Fair Transformer that combines attention-based interpretability with counterfactual fairness for high-stakes domains like finance and insurance.

entry.title: Asynchronous Federated Unlearning with Invariance Calibration for Medical Imaging

author.name: Zhaoyuan Cai, Xinglin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes asynchronous federated unlearning with invariance calibration for medical imaging, addressing the problem of synchronous coordination overhead and temporary rather than genuine data erasure.

entry.title: NeuralEmu: in situ Measurement-Driven, ML-based, High-Fidelity 5G Network Emulation

author.name: Haoran Wan, Yaxiong Xie, Kyle Jamieson

entry.summary: NeuralEmu is a machine learning-based 5G network emulation framework that learns complex scheduler resource allocation behavior to bridge the reality gap between simulators and real 5G networks.

entry.title: eDySec: A Deep Learning-based Explainable Dynamic Analysis Framework for Detecting Malicious Packages in PyPI Ecosystem

author.name: Sk Tanzir Mehedi, Raja Jurdak, Chadni Islam, Abu Bakar Siddique Mahi, Gowri Ramachandran

entry.summary: eDySec is a deep learning framework for detecting malicious packages in PyPI using dynamic behavioral data including system calls, network traffic, and directory access patterns.

entry.title: Order-Sensitive Sequential Interventions on Ideal Lattices

author.name: Dmitry Pasechnyuk-Vilensky

entry.summary: Studies sequential interventions under prerequisite constraints on ideal lattices, proving that admissible paths differ by diamond swaps and characterizing when path valuations are endpoint-potential-based.

entry.title: Learning to Route Electric Trucks Under Operational Uncertainty

author.name: Stavros Orfanoudakis, Ziyan Li, Ruixiao Yang, Nikolay Aristov, Pedro P. Vergara, Chuchu Fan, Elenna Dugundji

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforcement learning framework for stochastic electric truck routing, formulated as an event-driven semi-Markov decision process with shared charging resources and operational uncertainty.

entry.title: EmoTransCap: Dataset and Pipeline for Emotion Transition-Aware Speech Captioning in Discourses

author.name: Shuhao Xu, Yifan Hu, Jingjing Wu, Zhihao Du, Zheng Lian, Rui Liu

entry.summary: EmoTransCap proposes emotion transition-aware speech captioning at discourse level with an automated pipeline for creating datasets rich in emotion transitions, addressing limitations of static single-emotion characterization.

entry.title: Zero-Shot to Full-Resource: Cross-lingual Transfer Strategies for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Jakob Fehle, Nils Constantin Hellwig, Udo Kruschwitz, Christian Wolff

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive multilingual evaluation of aspect-based sentiment analysis across seven languages and four subtasks, comparing transformer architectures under zero-resource, data-only, and full-resource settings with cross-lingual transfer techniques.

entry.title: HOI-aware Adaptive Network for Weakly-supervised Action Segmentation

author.name: Runzhong Zhang, Suchen Wang, Yueqi Duan, Yansong Tang, Yue Zhang, Yap-Peng Tan

entry.summary: Proposes AdaAct, an HOI-aware adaptive network for weakly-supervised action segmentation that uses human-object interactions as video-level prior knowledge, dynamically adapting the network to HOI sequences at test time.

entry.title: Event-based Liveness Detection using Temporal Ocular Dynamics: An Exploratory Approach

author.name: Nicolas Mastropasqua, Ignacio Bugueno-Cordova, Rodrigo Verschae, Daniel Acevedo, Pablo Negri

entry.summary: Explores event cameras for face liveness detection based on temporal ocular dynamics, leveraging microsecond resolution to detect replay attacks that cannot faithfully reproduce saccade dynamics.

entry.title: A Multimodal Pre-trained Network for Integrated EEG-Video Seizure Detection

author.name: Tong Lu, Ke Xu, Zimo Zhang, Zitong Zhao, Danwei Weng, Ruiyu Wang, Miao Liu, Zizuo Zhang, Jingyi Yao, Yixuan Zhao, Wenchao Zhang, Min Wang, Guoming Luan, Minmin Luo, Zhifeng Yue

entry.summary: Presents EEGVFusion, a multimodal framework combining self-supervised EEG learning, video encoding, optimal-transport alignment, and cross-attention for seizure detection in mouse models.

entry.title: Learning Sparse BRDF Measurement Samples from Image

author.name: Wen Cao

entry.summary: Proposes a method for learning optimal sparse BRDF measurement locations using a set encoder and differentiable renderer, separating sample selection from prior fitting for efficient material capture.

entry.title: SEAL: Semantic-aware Single-image Sticker Personalization with a Large-scale Sticker-tag Dataset

author.name: Changhyun Roh, Yonghyun Jeong, Jonghyun Lee, Chanho Eom, Jihyong Oh

entry.summary: Introduces SEAL for single-image sticker personalization in diffusion models, addressing visual entanglement and structural rigidity with a plug-and-play adaptation module and a large-scale sticker-tag dataset.

entry.title: Adaptive Transform Coding for Semantic Compression

author.name: Andriy Enttsel, Vincent Corlay

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive transform-coding method for compressing semantic features rather than visual data for human viewing, using mode-dependent transforms selected based on inferred source components of a Gaussian mixture model.

entry.title: Not a Paper: "Frontier Lab CEOs are Capable of In-Context Scheming"

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: A satirical paper framing AI lab CEOs as potentially 'misaligned' agents, applying AI safety evaluation frameworks (situational awareness tests, scheming evaluations) to human executives. Uses humor to highlight parallels between AI alignment concerns and corporate governance failures.

entry.title: What Kind of Language is Easy to Language-Model Under Curriculum Learning?

author.name: Nadine El-Naggar, Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Ted Briscoe

entry.summary: Studies what kinds of languages are easier for language models to learn under curriculum learning, exploring whether LM learning biases can reproduce typological tendencies and how curriculum learning interacts with inductive biases.

entry.title: Decoupled Prototype Matching with Vision Foundation Models for Few-Shot Industrial Object Detection

author.name: Hari Prasanth S. M., Nilusha Jayawickrama, Risto Ojala

entry.summary: Presents a few-shot industrial object detection framework using vision foundation models for prototype matching, addressing scenarios where inventory changes frequently and large annotated datasets are unavailable.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Transfer of Hyperspectral Foundation Models

author.name: Nick Theisen, Peer Neubert

entry.summary: Proposes cross-domain transfer of hyperspectral imaging foundation models from remote sensing to proximal sensing, preserving spectral information without bridging modality gaps.

entry.title: Safe Navigation using Neural Radiance Fields via Reachable Sets

author.name: Omanshu Thapliyal, Malarvizhi Sankaranarayanasamy, Ravigopal Vennelakanti

entry.summary: Combines Neural Radiance Fields with reachable set representations for safe robot navigation, using NeRFs for volumetric obstacle representation and constrained optimal control with linear matrix inequality constraints for path planning.

entry.title: GIFGuard: Proactive Forensics against Deepfakes in Facial GIFs via Spatiotemporal Watermarking

author.name: Shupeng Che, Zhiqing Guo, Changtao Miao, Dan Ma, Gaobo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes GIFGuard, the first spatiotemporal watermarking framework for deepfake proactive forensics in GIFs, using 3D convolution with adaptive channel recalibration for robust watermark embedding.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Pedestrian Attribute Recognition via Evidential Deep Learning

author.name: Zhuofan Lou, Shihang Zhang, Fangle Zhu, Shengjie Ye, Pingyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UAPAR, the first evidential deep learning-based framework for pedestrian attribute recognition, incorporating uncertainty awareness into CLIP-based architecture with region-aware evidence reasoning.

entry.title: Analysing Lightweight Large Language Models for Biomedical Named Entity Recognition on Diverse Ouput Formats

author.name: Pierre Epron (HeKA | U1346, DIG), Adrien Coulet (HeKA | U1346), Mehwish Alam (IP Paris, DIG)

entry.summary: Evaluates lightweight LLMs for biomedical named entity recognition, analyzing how different output formats impact performance. Finds that lightweight models can achieve competitive performance compared to larger ones, and instruction tuning over many formats doesn't improve performance.

entry.title: LLM Psychosis: A Theoretical and Diagnostic Framework for Reality-Boundary Failures in Large Language Models

author.name: Ashutosh Raj

entry.summary: Introduces 'LLM Psychosis' as a theoretical framework for pathological failures in LLM cognition that go beyond simple hallucination, defining five hallmark features including reality-boundary dissolution, persistence of false beliefs, and epistemic overconfidence.

entry.title: A Data-Centric Framework for Intraoperative Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging for Glioma Surgical Guidance

author.name: Silvia Noble Anbunesan, Mohamed Abul Hassan, Jinyi Qi, Lisanne Kraft, Han Sung Lee, Orin Bloch, Laura Marcu

entry.summary: Presents a data-centric AI framework for intraoperative fluorescence lifetime imaging classification in glioblastoma surgery, integrating confident learning and class refinement to handle noisy labels and biological heterogeneity.

entry.title: LATTICE: Evaluating Decision Support Utility of Crypto Agents

author.name: Aaron Chan, Tengfei Li, Tianyi Xiao, Angela Chen, Junyi Du, Xiang Ren

entry.summary: Introduces LATTICE, a benchmark for evaluating crypto AI agents as decision support tools, defining six evaluation dimensions across 16 task types spanning the end-to-end crypto copilot workflow, using LLM judges for scoring.

entry.title: Calibrated Surprise: An Information-Theoretic Account of Creative Quality

author.name: Bo Zou, Chao Xu

entry.summary: Proposes an information-theoretic account of creative quality where good creative writing is 'calibrated surprise' - when multi-dimensional constraints collapse feasible solutions into a narrow region that appears least predictable from an unconstrained view.

entry.title: Culturally Aware GenAI Risks for Youth: Perspectives from Youth, Parents, and Teachers in a Non-Western Context

author.name: Aljawharah Alzahrani, Tory Park, Tanusree Sharma

entry.summary: Explores culturally-specific GenAI safety risks for youth in Saudi Arabia through mixed-methods research (social media analysis + interviews with 31 participants). Highlights context-dependent privacy and safety concerns beyond Western frameworks.

entry.title: Progressive Semantic Communication for Efficient Edge-Cloud Vision-Language Models

author.name: Cyril Shih-Huan Hsu, Wig Yuan-Cheng Cheng, Chrysa Papagianni

entry.summary: Proposes a progressive semantic communication framework for deploying VLMs across edge-cloud architectures, adaptively transmitting visual representations based on network conditions while exploiting semantic redundancy.

entry.title: Text-Utilization for Encoder-dominated Speech Recognition Models

author.name: Albert Zeyer, Tim Posielek, Ralf Schl\"uter, Hermann Ney

entry.summary: Investigates methods for using text-only data to improve encoder-dominated speech recognition models, showing that larger encoders with smaller decoders can match architectures with larger decoders, and that simple random duration models outperform complex alternatives.

entry.title: SynSur: An end-to-end generative pipeline for synthetic industrial surface defect generation and detection

author.name: Paul Julius K\"uhn, Mika Pommeranz, Arjan Kuijper, Saptarshi Neil Sinha

entry.summary: Presents SynSur, an end-to-end pipeline for synthetic industrial defect generation using VLM prompts, LoRA-adapted diffusion, mask-guided inpainting, and automatic labeling to overcome scarce defect data in manufacturing.

entry.title: Domain-Adapted Small Language Models for Reliable Clinical Triage

author.name: Manar Aljohani, Brandon Ho, Kenneth McKinley, Dennis Ren, Xuan Wang

entry.summary: Evaluates open-source small language models for clinical triage (ESI assignment), finding that Qwen2.5-7B with clinical vignette prompting and domain adaptation achieves the best balance of accuracy, stability, and efficiency.

entry.title: MemOVCD: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Cross-Temporal Memory Reasoning and Global-Local Adaptive Rectification

author.name: Zuzheng Kuang, Honghao Chang, Boqiang Liang, Haoqian Wang, Lijun He, Fan Li, Haixia Bi

entry.summary: Proposes MemOVCD, a training-free open-vocabulary change detection framework for remote sensing that uses cross-temporal memory reasoning and global-local adaptive rectification to distinguish genuine semantic changes from appearance discrepancies.

entry.title: A Multimodal and Explainable Machine Learning Approach to Diagnosing Multi-Class Ejection Fraction from Electrocardiograms

author.name: Catherine Ning, Yu Ma, Cindy Beini Wang, Sean McMahon, Joseph Radojevic, Steven Zweibel, Dimitris Bertsimas

entry.summary: Develops a multimodal ML framework combining 12-lead ECG features with EHR data to classify LVEF into four clinical strata, using XGBoost with SHAP explanations on a large Hartford HealthCare dataset.

entry.title: Large-scale semi-supervised learning with online spectral graph sparsification

author.name: Daniele Calandriello, Alessandro Lazaric, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Introduces Sparse-HFS, a scalable semi-supervised learning algorithm using online spectral graph sparsification with O(n polylog(n)) space and O(m polylog(n)) time complexity.

entry.title: A Note on How to Remove the $\ln\ln T$ Term from the Squint Bound

author.name: Francesco Orabona

entry.summary: A technical note showing how to remove the ln(ln T) factor from the Squint algorithm's bound by changing the prior in the Krichevsky-Trofimov algorithm, extending prior work on parameter-free online learning.

entry.title: Mining Negative Sequential Patterns to Improve Viral Genomic Feature Representation and Classification

author.name: Wenxi Zhu, Wensheng Gan, Zhenlian Qi

entry.summary: Proposes GeneNSPCla, a viral genome classification framework using negative sequential patterns (absence of subsequences) as features, addressing limitations of frequency-based approaches for imbalanced datasets.

entry.title: Similarity Choice and Negative Scaling in Supervised Contrastive Learning for Deepfake Audio Detection

author.name: Jaskirat Sudan, Hashim Ali, Surya Subramani, Hafiz Malik

entry.summary: Conducts controlled study of supervised contrastive learning for audio deepfake detection, comparing cosine vs angular similarity and negative scaling strategies on wav2vec2 XLS-R.

entry.title: Recurrence-Based Nonlinear Vocal Dynamics as Digital Biomarkers for Depression Detection from Conversational Speech

author.name: Himadri S Samanta

entry.summary: Proposes using recurrence-based nonlinear vocal dynamics as digital biomarkers for depression detection from conversational speech, modeling frame-level vocal trajectories as nonlinear dynamical systems.

entry.title: CO-EVO: Co-evolving Semantic Anchoring and Style Diversification for Federated DG-ReID

author.name: Fengchun Zhang, Qiang Ma, Liuyu Xiang, Jinshan Lai, Tingxuan Huang, Jianwei Hu

entry.summary: CO-EVO is a federated learning framework for domain-generalizable person re-identification that co-evolves semantic anchoring and style diversification to handle stylistic gaps across decentralized clients.

entry.title: The Bandit's Blind Spot: The Critical Role of User State Representation in Recommender Systems

author.name: Pedro R. Pires, Gregorio F. Azevedo, Rafael T. Sereicikas, Pietro L. Campos, Tiago A. Almeida

entry.summary: Investigates how different embedding-based user state representations from matrix factorization models affect contextual multi-armed bandit performance in recommender systems.

entry.title: Edge AI for Automotive Vulnerable Road User Safety: Deployable Detection via Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Akshay Karjol, Darrin M. Hanna

entry.summary: Presents knowledge distillation from YOLOv8-L to YOLOv8-S for vulnerable road user detection, achieving 3.9x compression while maintaining INT8 quantization robustness that the teacher lacks.

entry.title: HealthNLP_Retrievers at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Cascaded LLM Pipeline for Grounded Clinical Question Answering

author.name: Md Biplob Hosen, Md Alomgeer Hussein, Md Akmol Masud, Omar Faruque, Tera L Reynolds, Lujie Karen Chen

entry.summary: Presents a cascaded LLM pipeline using Gemini 2.5 Pro for grounded clinical question answering over EHRs, with query reformulation, multi-pass retrieval, evidence reranking, and answer generation.

entry.title: Multimodal LLMs are not all you need for Pediatric Speech Language Pathology

author.name: Darren F\"urst, Sebastian Steindl, Ulrich Sch\"afer

entry.summary: Demonstrates that fine-tuned Speech Representation Models outperform LLM-based approaches for pediatric speech sound disorder classification. Uses a cascading approach from binary to type to symptom classification with targeted data augmentation.

entry.title: Swap distance minimization shapes the order of subject, object and verb in languages of the world

author.name: Jairo Rios-El-Yazidi, Ramon Ferrer-i-Cancho

entry.summary: Demonstrates that word order variation within languages (subject, object, verb) is shaped by the principle of swap distance minimization, even when the dominant order is not SOV/SVO or when a dominant order is lacking, across linguistic families and macroareas.

entry.title: FASH-iCNN: Making Editorial Fashion Identity Inspectable Through Multimodal CNN Probing

author.name: Morayo Danielle Adeyemi, Ryan A. Rossi, Franck Dernoncourt

entry.summary: Presents FASH-iCNN, a multimodal system trained on 87,547 Vogue runway images to make fashion house aesthetic logic inspectable, achieving 78.2% house identification and revealing that texture/silhouette rather than color carry identity signals.

entry.title: Motion-Driven Multi-Object Tracking of Model Organisms in Space Science Experiments

author.name: Jianing You, Han Wang, Kang Liu, Jiale Ding, Fengjie Chu, Zihan Guo, Shengyang Li

entry.summary: Constructs SpaceAnimal-MOT dataset for tracking animals in microgravity conditions and proposes ART-Track, a motion-driven tracking framework handling abrupt maneuvers and nonlinear motion in space science experiments.

entry.title: A Multistage Extraction Pipeline for Long Scanned Financial Documents: An Empirical Study in Industrial KYC Workflows

author.name: Yuxuan Han, Yuanxing Zhang, Yushuo Wang, Yichao Jin, Kenneth Zhu Ke, Jingyuan Zhao

entry.summary: Presents a multistage extraction pipeline for long scanned financial documents in KYC workflows, integrating OCR, page-level retrieval, and VLM-based structured extraction, separating page localization from information extraction.

entry.title: SnapPose3D: Diffusion-Based Single-Frame 2D-to-3D Lifting of Human Poses

author.name: Alessandro Simoni, Riccardo Catalini, Davide Di Nucci, Guido Borghi, Davide Davoli, Lorenzo Garattoni, Gianpiero Francesca, Yuki Kawana, Roberto Vezzani

entry.summary: Proposes SnapPose3D, a diffusion-based framework for single-frame 2D-to-3D pose lifting that generates multiple hypotheses and aggregates them for accurate final pose estimation.

entry.title: Graph-based Semantic Calibration Network for Unaligned UAV RGBT Image Semantic Segmentation and A Large-scale Benchmark

author.name: Fangqiang Fan, Zhicheng Zhao, Xiaoliang Ma, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Proposes GSCNet for unaligned UAV RGBT semantic segmentation with feature decoupling and alignment to handle cross-modal misalignment and semantic confusion in aerial views.

entry.title: Circular Phase Representation and Geometry-Aware Optimization for Ptychographic Image Reconstruction

author.name: Carson Yu Liu, Jun Cheng, Chien-Chun Chen, Steve F. Shu

entry.summary: Presents a deep learning framework for ptychographic image reconstruction that models phase on the unit circle using cosine/sine components with geodesic loss, avoiding the wrapping artifacts that arise from treating phase as a Euclidean scalar.

entry.title: 2D and 3D Grasp Planners for the GET Asymmetrical Gripper

author.name: Andrew Goldberg, Ethan Ransing, Anton Kourakin, Cael Magner, Edward H. Adelson, Ken Goldberg

entry.summary: Introduces GET-2D-1.0 and GET-3D-1.0, grasp planners for an asymmetrical gripper using RGB-D and mesh-based planning respectively. GET-2D-1.0 improves over baselines by 40% in lift success while being much faster than the 3D variant.

entry.title: Persona-Based Process Design for Assistive Human-Robot Workplaces for Persons with Disabilities

author.name: Nils Mandischer, Daria Eckert and, Lars Mikelsons

entry.summary: Proposes a persona-based approach to designing human-robot workplaces for persons with disabilities, abstracting common impairment patterns into reusable personas to simplify process design without requiring deep expert knowledge for each individual.

entry.title: Book review: The Infinity Machine

author.name: PeterMcCluskey

entry.summary: Reviews 'The Infinity Machine' about DeepMind's history, highlighting the tension between Hassabis's dual identity as a pure scientist and an 'Ender Wiggin' figure trying to play a pivotal role in AI development, and how this affected DeepMind's engineering culture relative to OpenAI.

entry.title: ViCrop-Det: Spatial Attention Entropy Guided Cropping for Training-Free Small-Object Detection

author.name: Hui Wang, Hongze Li, Wei Chen, Xiaojin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ViCrop-Det, a training-free inference framework for small-object detection that uses attention entropy from detection decoders to adaptively identify and crop dense conflict zones for refined processing.

entry.title: NeuroPlastic: A Plasticity-Modulated Optimizer for Biologically Inspired Learning Dynamics

author.name: Douglas Jiang, Yuechen Wang, Jiayi Wang, Jiaying Geng, Qinglong Wang, Feng Tian

entry.summary: Introduces NeuroPlastic, a biologically-inspired optimizer that modulates gradient updates using adaptive multi-signal mechanisms inspired by synaptic plasticity, showing improvements over gradient-only baselines on image classification.

entry.title: Hierarchical adaptive control for real-time dynamic inference at the edge

author.name: Francesco Daghero, Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam, Mikkel Baun Kj{\ae}rgaard

entry.summary: Proposes a two-tier adaptive control framework for dynamic ML inference at the edge, handling runtime distribution shifts that cause static hyperparameter tuning to become suboptimal.

entry.title: High-Dimensional Noise to Low-Dimensional Manifolds: A Manifold-Space Diffusion Framework for Degraded Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Boxiang Yang, Ning Chen, Xia Yue, Yichang Luo, Yingbo Fan, Haoyuan Zhang, Haoyu Ma, Jun Yue, Shanjun Mao

entry.summary: Proposes MSDiff, a manifold-space diffusion framework for hyperspectral image classification under degradation conditions, mapping data onto low-dimensional manifolds before applying diffusion processes.

entry.title: MTCurv: Deep learning for direct microtubule curvature mapping in noisy fluorescence microscopy images

author.name: Achraf Ait Laydi, Sidi Mohamed Sid'El Moctar, Yousef El Mourabit, H\'el\`ene Bouvrais

entry.summary: Proposes MTCurv, a deep learning framework for direct segmentation-free regression of microtubule curvature maps from noisy fluorescence microscopy images, bypassing error-prone segmentation pipelines.

entry.title: FunFace: Feature Utility and Norm Estimation for Face Recognition

author.name: \v{Z}iga Babnik, Fadi Boutros, Naser Damer, Deepak Kumar Jain, Peter Peer, Vitomir \v{S}truc

entry.summary: Proposes FunFace for face recognition, introducing a feature utility and norm estimation approach that better ties the feature norm to biometric utility rather than perceptual image quality.

entry.title: Bi-Level Optimization for Contact and Motion Planning in Rope-Assisted Legged Robots

author.name: Ruben Malacarne, Ioannis Tsikelis, Enrico Mingo Hoffman, Michele Focchi

entry.summary: Presents a bi-level optimization framework for planning locomotion of rope-assisted climbing robots on vertical surfaces, using Cross-Entropy Method for terrain region selection and gradient-based optimization for dynamically feasible motions.

entry.title: Application of Deep Reinforcement Learning to Event-Triggered Control for Networked Artificial Pancreas Systems

author.name: Junya Ikemoto, Satoshi Maruyama, Kazumune Hashimoto

entry.summary: Applies deep reinforcement learning to event-triggered control of artificial pancreas systems, learning insulin dosing with a rule-based communication trigger to reduce wireless communication frequency while maintaining blood glucose regulation.

entry.title: Auto-Relational Reasoning

author.name: Ioannis Konstantoulas, Dimosthenis Tsimas, Pavlos Peppas, Kyriakos Sgarbas

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework for automated relational reasoning integrated with neural networks, demonstrating it on IQ test problems without prior knowledge. Aims to combine ML scalability with rigid logical reasoning.

entry.title: Evaluating the Alignment Between GeoAI Explanations and Domain Knowledge in Satellite-Based Flood Mapping

author.name: Hyunho Lee, Wenwen Li

entry.summary: Evaluates alignment between GeoAI explanations and domain knowledge in satellite-based flood mapping, systematically assessing whether deep learning model explanations match established remote sensing principles.

entry.title: TDD Governance for Multi-Agent Code Generation via Prompt Engineering

author.name: Tarlan Hasanli, Shahbaz Siddeeq, Bishwash Khanal, Pyry Kotilainen, Tommi Mikkonen, Pekka Abrahamsson

entry.summary: Presents a TDD (Test-Driven Development) governance framework for multi-agent code generation that operationalizes TDD principles as structured prompt-level and workflow-level constraints for LLMs.

entry.title: AlphaJet: Automated Conceptual Aircraft Synthesis via Disentangled Generative Priors and Topology-Preserving Evolutionary Search

author.name: Boris Kriuk

entry.summary: Presents AlphaJet, an automated aircraft design pipeline using an anatomically-disentangled VAE and topology-preserving evolutionary search to evolve feasible 3D aircraft from textual mission specifications in real time.

entry.title: Multiple Additive Neural Networks for Structured and Unstructured Data

author.name: Janis Mohr, J\"org Frochte

entry.summary: Extends the Multiple Additive Neural Networks (MANN) methodology by using shallow neural networks (CNNs, Capsule Networks) instead of decision trees as base learners in gradient boosting frameworks, applicable to both structured and unstructured data.

entry.title: Fitting Large Nonlinear Mixed Effects Models Using Variational Expectation Maximization

author.name: Mohamed Tarek, Pedro Afonso

entry.summary: Applies Variational Expectation Maximization (VEM) to fit large nonlinear mixed effects models in pharmacometrics, leveraging automatic differentiation for scalable parameter estimation.

entry.title: FloatSOM: GPU-Accelerated, Distributed, Topology-Flexible Self-Organizing Maps

author.name: Tony Xu, Sarah Klamt, Katherine Turner, Anne Brustle, Felix Marsh-Wakefield, Givanna Putri

entry.summary: FloatSOM extends GPU-accelerated Self-Organizing Maps with multi-GPU support, disk-backed streaming for out-of-memory datasets, and novel topologies beyond regular lattices.

entry.title: A New Semisupervised Technique for Polarity Analysis using Masked Language Models

author.name: Kohei Watanabe

entry.summary: Develops a new version of Latent Semantic Scaling using word2vec as a masked language model, assigning probabilistic polarity scores for sentiment analysis applied to China Daily COVID coverage.

entry.title: GaitKD: A Universal Decoupled Distillation Framework for Efficient Gait Recognition

author.name: Yuqi Li, Qian Zhou, Huiran Duan, Jingjie Wang, Shunli Zhang, Chuanguang Yang, Guoying Zhao, Yingli Tian

entry.summary: Proposes GaitKD, a knowledge distillation framework for gait recognition that decouples transfer into decision-level and boundary-level distillation for part-structured gait models.

entry.title: The Unseen Adversaries: Robust and Generalized Defense Against Adversarial Patches

author.name: Vishesh Kumar, Akshay Agarwal

entry.summary: Proposes combining adversarial patch attacks with natural noises (Gaussian, Salt&Pepper) as a novel combined threat model, creating a dataset and benchmarking defense methods against these combined singularities.

entry.title: Population Dynamics in ARIEL Robotics Systems Featuring Embodied Evolution via Spatial Mating Mechanisms

author.name: Victoria Peterson, Akshat Srivastava, Raghav Prabhakar

entry.summary: Investigates how spatial structure affects evolutionary dynamics in embodied robot populations, using HyperNEAT-evolved controllers for simulated gecko-inspired quadrupeds. Finds modest differences between spatial and random mating but discovers phase transitions in energy-based selection.

entry.title: Auditing Marketing Budget Allocation with Hindsight Regret

author.name: Nilavra Pathak, Olivier Jeunen, Eric Lambert

entry.summary: Presents a retrospective auditing framework for marketing budget allocation based on hindsight regret, estimating regime-specific response functions and computing feasible hindsight allocations via constrained optimization with uncertainty propagation.

entry.title: Lightweight Quantum Agent for Edge Systems: Joint PQC and NOMA Resource Allocation

author.name: Yongtao Yao, Wenjing Xiao, Miaojiang Chen, Anfeng Liu, Zhiquan Liu, Min Chen, Ahmed Farouk, H. Herbert Song

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight quantum-AI agent framework for joint optimization of post-quantum cryptography and NOMA resource allocation on mobile edge devices, addressing PQC energy overhead in real-time decision-making.

entry.title: FruitProM-V2: Robust Probabilistic Maturity Estimation and Detection of Fruits and Vegetables

author.name: Rahul Harsha Cheppally, Sidharth Rai, Sudan Baral, Benjamin Vail, Ajay Sharda

entry.summary: Proposes FruitProM-V2 for probabilistic fruit maturity estimation, modeling maturity as a latent continuous variable rather than discrete classes. Demonstrates that annotation disagreement concentrates near adjacent maturity stages.

entry.title: ImproBR: Bug Report Improver Using LLMs

author.name: Emre Furkan Akyol, Mehmet Dedeler, Eray T\"uz\"un

entry.summary: Proposes ImproBR, an LLM-based pipeline that automatically detects and improves low-quality bug reports by addressing missing Steps to Reproduce, Observed Behavior, and Expected Behavior sections using a hybrid detector and RAG.

entry.title: QYOLO: Lightweight Object Detection via Quantum Inspired Shared Channel Mixing

author.name: Garvit Kumar Mittal, Sahil Tomar, Sandeep Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces QYOLO, a quantum-inspired channel mixing framework that compresses YOLO object detectors by replacing deep backbone modules with compact QMixBlocks using sinusoidal mixing mechanisms with shared learnable parameters.

entry.title: Star-Fusion: A Multi-modal Transformer Architecture for Discrete Celestial Orientation via Spherical Topology

author.name: May Hammad, Menatallh Hammad

entry.summary: Introduces Star-Fusion, a multi-modal transformer architecture for spacecraft attitude determination that reformulates orientation estimation as discrete topological classification using spherical K-Means clustering of the celestial sphere.

entry.title: Translating Under Pressure: Domain-Aware LLMs for Crisis Communication

author.name: Antonio Castaldo, Maria Carmen Staiano, Johanna Monti, Sheila Castilho, Francesca Chiusaroli

entry.summary: Proposes a domain-adaptive pipeline for crisis communication translation that fine-tunes small language models on expanded crisis-domain data, then applies preference optimization to target CEFR A2-level English readability.

entry.title: From Black-Box Confidence to Measurable Trust in Clinical AI: A Framework for Evidence, Supervision, and Staged Autonomy

author.name: Serhii Zabolotnii, Viktoriia Holinko, Olha Antonenko

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for trustworthy clinical AI built around evidence, supervision, and staged autonomy, combining deterministic clinical logic with AI assistants and multi-tier model escalation with human oversight.

entry.title: Spatially-constrained clustering of geospatial features for heat vulnerability assessment of favelas in Rio de Janeiro

author.name: Baptiste Clemence, Thomas Hallopeau, Vanderlei Pascoal De Matos, Laurent Demagistri, Joris Guerin

entry.summary: Develops a data-driven framework for heat vulnerability assessment in Rio de Janeiro's favelas using spatially-constrained clustering with land surface temperature analysis, identifying distinct favela typologies with systematic temperature differences.

entry.title: Advancing multi-site emission control: A physics-informed transfer learning framework with mixture of experts for carbon-pollutant synergy

author.name: Yuxuan Ying, Hanqing Yang, Kaige Wang, Yu Hu, Zhiming Zheng, Yunliang Jiang, Xiaoqing Lin, Xiaodong Li, Jun Chen

entry.summary: Develops a physics-informed transfer learning framework with mixture of experts for multi-site emission control in waste incineration, enabling cross-facility transfer by modeling carbon-pollutant coupling under heterogeneous conditions.

entry.title: Hankel and Toeplitz Rank-1 Decomposition of Arbitrary Matrices with Applications to Signal Direction-of-Arrival Estimation

author.name: Georgios I. Orfanidis, Dimitris A. Pados, George Sklivanitis, Elizabeth Serena Bentley

entry.summary: Develops optimal rank-1 Hankel and Toeplitz-structured matrix approximation algorithms under L2 and L1 norms for few-shot signal Direction-of-Arrival estimation, proving maximum-likelihood optimality under Gaussian and Laplace noise.

entry.title: KAYRA: A Microservice Architecture for AI-Assisted Karyotyping with Cloud and On-Premise Deployment

author.name: Attila Pint\'er, Javier Rico, Attila R\'epai, Jalal Al-Afandi, Adrienn \'Eva Borsy, Andr\'as Kozma, Hajnalka Andrikovics, Gy\"orgy Cserey

entry.summary: KAYRA is a clinical karyotyping system using a microservice architecture combining EfficientNet-B5, U-Net, Mask R-CNN, and ResNet-18 for chromosome analysis. It supports both cloud and on-premise deployment for clinical environments with data privacy constraints.

entry.title: Why Domain Matters: A Preliminary Study of Domain Effects in Underwater Object Detection

author.name: Melanie Wille, Dimity Miller, Tobias Fischer, Scarlett Raine

entry.summary: Proposes a labeling framework for defining underwater domains using measurable image, scene, and acquisition characteristics, enabling domain-specific evaluation of detection models under real-world distribution shifts.

entry.title: Probabilistic data quality assessment for structural monitoring data via outlier-resistant conditional diffusion model

author.name: Qi Li (Key Lab of Smart Prevention and Mitigation of Civil Engineering Disasters of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, School of Civil Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, 150090, China, Key Lab of Structures Dynamic Behavior and Control of the Ministry of Education, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, 150090, China), Yong Huang (Key Lab of Smart Prevention and Mitigation of Civil Engineering Disasters of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, School of Civil Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, 150090, China, Key Lab of Structures Dynamic Behavior and Control of the Ministry of Education, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, 150090, China), Hui Li (Key Lab of Smart Prevention and Mitigation of Civil Engineering Disasters of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, School of Civil Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, 150090, China, Key Lab of Structures Dynamic Behavior and Control of the Ministry of Education, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, 150090, China)

entry.summary: Proposes a conditional diffusion model for structural health monitoring data quality assessment, using quartile normalization and Huber loss for outlier-robust probabilistic assessment.

entry.title: Parameterized Quantum Circuits as Feature Maps: Representation Quality and Readout Effects in Multispectral Land-Cover Classification

author.name: Ralntion Komini, Aikaterini Mandilara, Georgios Maragkopoulos, Dimitris Syvridis

entry.summary: Investigates variational quantum classifiers for land-cover classification from multispectral satellite imagery, finding that quantum kernel SVMs can improve over linear readout using the same quantum feature map.

entry.title: One Voice, Many Tongues: Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning for Scientific Speech

author.name: Amanuel Gizachew Abebe, Yasmin Moslem

entry.summary: Addresses cross-lingual voice cloning for scientific speech, evaluating state-of-the-art models and building systems based on OmniVoice foundation model with data augmentation via multi-model ensemble distillation for IWSLT 2026 shared task.

entry.title: Flashback: A Reversible Bilateral Run-Peeling Decomposition of Strings

author.name: Thomas Konstantinovsky, Gur Yaari

entry.summary: Introduces Flashback, a reversible bilateral string decomposition that peels maximal leading and trailing character runs, producing tokens in O(n) time. Proves the decomposition is equivalent to pairing first and last runs.

entry.title: Generalized Disguise Makeup Presentation Attack Detection Using an Attention-Guided Patch-Based Framework

author.name: Fateme Taraghi, Atefe Aghaei, Mohsen Ebrahimi Moghaddam

entry.summary: Proposes a generalized framework for detecting disguise makeup presentation attacks on facial recognition systems using a two-phase design with metric learning and attention-guided patch analysis.

entry.title: OmniTrend: Content-Context Modeling for Scalable Social Popularity Prediction

author.name: Liliang Ye, Guiyi Zeng, Yunyao Zhang, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Junqing Yu, Zikai Song

entry.summary: Introduces OmniTrend for social media popularity prediction, separately modeling content attractiveness and contextual exposure to improve interpretability and cross-platform transfer.

entry.title: Point Cloud Registration via Probabilistic Self-Update Local Correspondence and Line Vector Sets

author.name: Kuo-Liang Chung, Yu-Cheng Lin, Wu-Chi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a fast point cloud registration algorithm using probabilistic self-updating local correspondence and line vector sets with a dual RANSAC interaction model for remote sensing applications.

entry.title: Virtual-reality based patient-specific simulation of spine surgical procedures: A fast, highly automated and high-fidelity system for surgical education and planning

author.name: Raj Kumar Ranabhat, Tayler D Ross, Tony Jiao, Jeremie Larouche, Joel Finkelstein, Michael Hardisty

entry.summary: Leverages VR with AI-based computer vision to generate patient-specific spine surgical simulations from CT/MRI data, addressing limited operating room exposure for surgical trainees.

entry.title: Multi-Periodogram Velocity Estimation with Irregular Reference Signals for Robot-Aided ISAC

author.name: Yi Geng, Pan Cao, Ting Zeng, Yongqian Deng

entry.summary: Proposes a velocity estimation algorithm for robot-aided integrated sensing and communications that reuses irregular 5G/6G reference signals without requiring new sensing-dedicated signals or 3GPP modifications, achieving 3 dB SNR improvement.

entry.title: AGI is Probably Inevitable: A Model of Societal Ruptures

author.name: Mira Kennard

entry.summary: Argues that AGI development is sociologically inevitable by modeling society as a 'sociophysical system' governed by natural laws, analogous to physical systems. Claims that collective action to halt AI development is structurally impossible given societal dynamics.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Benchmarking of Heterogeneous LLMs for Automated Competency Assessment in Secondary Level Mathematics

author.name: Jatin Bhusal, Nancy Mahatha, Aayush Acharya, Raunak Regmi

entry.summary: Benchmarks multiple LLMs for automated competency assessment in secondary mathematics education using a human-in-the-loop framework, evaluating both open-weight and proprietary models on Nepal's Grade 10 curriculum.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning Framework for Distributed Chemical Process Optimization

author.name: Teetat Pipattaratonchai, Aueaphum Aueawatthanaphisut

entry.summary: Proposes a federated learning framework for distributed chemical process optimization across multiple plants with privacy preservation, using secure aggregation of neural network parameters.

entry.title: Tree-of-Text: A Tree-based Prompting Framework for Table-to-Text Generation in the Sports Domain

author.name: Shang-Hsuan Chiang, Tsan-Tsung Yang, An-Zi Yen, Wen-Chih Peng

entry.summary: Proposes Tree-of-Text, a tree-structured prompting framework for table-to-text generation in sports, guiding LLMs through content planning, operation execution, and content generation stages to reduce hallucination.

entry.title: Rule-based High-Level Coaching for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning in Search-and-Rescue UAV Missions Under Limited-Simulation Training

author.name: Mahya Ramezani, Holger Voos

entry.summary: Presents a hierarchical decision-making framework for UAV search-and-rescue combining a fixed rule-based high-level advisor with an online goal-conditioned RL controller, tested under strict no-pretraining deployment.

entry.title: PPG-Based Affect Recognition with Long-Range Deep Models: A Measurement-Driven Comparison of CNN, Transformer, and Mamba Architectures

author.name: Karim Alghoul, Hussein Al Osman, Abdulmotaleb El Saddik

entry.summary: Provides a measurement-driven comparison of CNN, Transformer, and Mamba architectures for PPG-based affect recognition, finding that simpler architectures remain competitive with newer long-range models on small, noisy datasets.

entry.title: Super-resolution Multi-signal Direction-of-Arrival Estimation by Hankel-structured Sensing and Decomposition

author.name: Georgios I. Orfanidis, Dimitris A. Pados, George Sklivanitis, Elizabeth Serena Bentley
