entry.summary: Develops methodology for nearly optimal subdata selection using optimal approximate design theory, addressing the NP-hard problem of selecting the most informative subset of data points for parameter estimation.

entry.title: When Cow Urine Cures Constipation on YouTube: Limits of LLMs in Detecting Culture-specific Health Misinformation

author.name: Anamta Khan, Ratna Kandala, Deepti, Sheza Munir, Joyojeet Pal

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs fail to detect culturally embedded health misinformation, using cow urine health claims on Indian YouTube as a case study. Shows that promotional content blends sacred language with pseudo-science in ways that Western-trained LLMs systematically miss.

entry.title: Neural Recovery of Historical Lexical Structure in Bantu Languages from Modern Data

author.name: Hillary Mutisya, John Mugane

entry.summary: Investigates whether neural models trained on modern morphological data can recover historical lexical structure in Bantu languages. Confirms 90.9% of top noun cognate candidates align with previously reconstructed Proto-Bantu forms.

entry.title: AnalogRetriever: Learning Cross-Modal Representations for Analog Circuit Retrieval

author.name: Yihan Wang, Lei Li, Yao Lai, Jing Wang, Yan Lu

entry.summary: AnalogRetriever is a tri-modal retrieval framework for analog circuits that enables cross-modal search across SPICE netlists, schematics, and functional descriptions using vision-language and graph neural network encoders.

entry.title: Breaking the Resource Wall: Geometry-Guided Sequence Modeling for Efficient Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Sheng-Wei Chan, Xin-Jui Pan, Chun-Po Shen, Chia-Min Lin, Yung-Che Wang, Jen-Shiun Chiang

entry.summary: DGM-Net proposes an efficient semantic segmentation architecture using Directional Geometric Mamba, a linear-complexity O(N) operator as an alternative to ASPP/PPM context modeling.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Degradation-Aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for Realistic Underwater Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Shaohua Liu, Ning Gao, Zuoya Gu, Hongkun Dou, Yue Deng, Hongjue Li

entry.summary: MarineSTD-GS proposes a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for underwater scene reconstruction that explicitly models both temporal (caustics, flickering) and spatial (attenuation, backscattering) degradations.

entry.title: ShredBench: Evaluating the Semantic Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Document Reconstruction

author.name: Zichun Guo, Yuling Shi, Wenhao Zeng, Chao Hu, Haotian Lin, Terry Yue Zhuo, Jiawei Chen, Xiaodong Gu, Wenping Ma

entry.summary: Introduces ShredBench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs' ability to reconstruct content from shredded document fragments, requiring both visual pattern recognition and semantic reasoning under content discontinuities.

entry.title: GS-DOT: Gaussian splatting-based image reconstruction for diffuse optical tomography

author.name: Jingjing Jiang

entry.summary: GS-DOT adapts Gaussian Splatting from rendering to diffuse optical tomography, representing absorption coefficients as sparse anisotropic Gaussian primitives. This is the first adaptation of GS algorithms to the photon diffusion regime, replacing ray transport with diffusion functions.

entry.title: ReCast: Recasting Learning Signals for Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation

author.name: Peiyan Zhang, Hanmo Liu, Chengxuan Tong, Yuxia Wu, Wei Guo, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ReCast for reinforcement learning in generative recommendation, addressing the failure of standard group-based RL in sparse-hit scenarios by repairing all-zero groups and using boundary-focused contrastive updates.

entry.title: Unstable Rankings in Bayesian Deep Learning Evaluation

author.name: Qishi Zhan, Minxuan Hu, Guansu Wang, Jiaxin Liu, Liang He

entry.summary: Shows that Bayesian deep learning method rankings are unstable under data scarcity and dataset-dependent. Uses Bayesian hierarchical model to properly quantify evaluation uncertainty. No universal sample size threshold exists.

entry.title: TEMPO: Transformers for Temporal Disease Progression from Cross-Sectional Data

author.name: Hongtao Hao, Joseph L. Austerweil

entry.summary: Proposes TEMPO, a Transformer architecture for inferring temporal disease progression from cross-sectional data, learning both ordinal and continuous event sequences. Reduces Kendall's Tau distance by 52.89% vs state-of-the-art.

entry.title: Deep Learning of Solver-Aware Turbulence Closures from Nudged LES Dynamics

author.name: Ashwin Suriyanarayanan, Melissa Adrian, Dibyajyoti Chakraborty, Romit Maulik

entry.summary: Develops deep learning-based turbulence closure models for LES that are solver-aware through nudged dynamics training, addressing instabilities that arise from mismatch between assumed filters and numerical discretizations.

entry.title: Semantic Segmentation for Histopathology using Learned Regularization based on Global Proportions

author.name: Yangping Li, Thomas Pinetz, Michael H\"olzel, Marieta Toma, Alexander Effland

entry.summary: Introduces VSLP, a two-stage framework that infers dense segmentations from global label proportions in histopathology without pixel-level annotations, using pre-trained transformers with test-time augmentation and variational regularization.

entry.title: Micro-Expression-Aware Avatar Fingerprinting via Inter-Frame Feature Differencing

author.name: Masoumeh Chapariniya, Jean-Marc Odobez, Volker Dellwo, Teodora Vukovi\'c

entry.summary: Proposes a preprocessing-free avatar fingerprinting system using micro-expression-aware backbone with inter-frame feature differencing to verify who drives a synthetic talking-head video.

entry.title: Focus Session: Hardware and Software Techniques for Accelerating Multimodal Foundation Models

author.name: Muhammad Shafique, Abdul Basit, Muhammad Abdullah Hanif, Alberto Marchisio, Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra, Minghao Shao

entry.summary: Presents a multi-layered methodology for accelerating multimodal foundation models combining hardware-software co-design, mixed-precision quantization, structural pruning, speculative decoding, and model cascading.

entry.title: Ethics Testing: Proactive Identification of Generative AI System Harms

author.name: Shin Hwei Tan, Haibo Wang, Heng Li

entry.summary: Introduces the concept of 'ethics testing' for generative AI systems, a systematic approach to generating tests for identifying software harms in AI-generated content including code and images.

entry.title: Protect the Brain When Treating the Heart: A Convolutional Neural Network for Detecting Emboli

author.name: Andrea Angino, Ken Trotti, Diego Ulisse Pizzagalli, Rolf Krause, Tiziano Torre, Stefanos Demertzis

entry.summary: Proposes a 2.5D U-Net approach for detecting gaseous microemboli in cardiac ultrasound, achieving robust detection with real-time execution speed and integration into an operating room workflow.

entry.title: BLAST: Benchmarking LLMs with ASP-based Structured Testing

author.name: Manuel Alejandro Borroto Santana, Erica Coppolillo, Francesco Calimeri, Giuseppe Manco, Simona Perri, Francesco Ricca

entry.summary: Introduces BLAST, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating LLM accuracy in generating Answer Set Programming (ASP) code, with two novel semantic metrics and evaluation of ten graph-related ASP problems.

entry.title: FeatEHR-LLM: Leveraging Large Language Models for Feature Engineering in Electronic Health Records

author.name: Hojjat Karami, David Atienza, Jean-Philippe Thiran, Anisoara Ionescu

entry.summary: Presents FeatEHR-LLM, which uses LLMs to generate clinically meaningful features from irregular EHR time series by operating on dataset schemas rather than raw patient data, preserving privacy. Uses tool-augmented generation for specialized clinical feature engineering.

entry.title: Towards Understanding the Expressive Power of GNNs with Global Readout

author.name: Maurice Funk, Daumantas Kojelis

entry.summary: Studies the expressive power of message-passing GNNs with global readout, showing that sum aggregation suffices to capture FO properties beyond C2 logic. Identifies two ways to restore logical characterization.

entry.title: Utility-Aware Data Pricing: Token-Level Quality and Empirical Training Gain for LLMs

author.name: Minghui Xu, Qi Luo, Kun Li

entry.summary: Presents a dynamic data valuation framework for LLM training data with three layers: token-level information density, empirical training gain measurement, and cryptographic verifiability. Proposes utility-based pricing over static accounting.

entry.title: C-MORAL: Controllable Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization with Reinforcement Alignment for LLMs

author.name: Rui Gao, Youngseung Jeon, Swastik Roy, Morteza Ziyadi, Xiang 'Anthony' Chen

entry.summary: Proposes C-MORAL, an RL post-training framework for controllable multi-objective molecular optimization with LLMs. Combines group-based optimization, property score alignment, and nonlinear reward aggregation for drug design.

entry.title: CombiMOTS: Combinatorial Multi-Objective Tree Search for Dual-Target Molecule Generation

author.name: Thibaud Southiratn, Bonil Koo, Yijingxiu Lu, Sun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes CombiMOTS, a combinatorial multi-objective tree search for dual-target molecule generation that integrates synthetic planning into the generative process. Addresses trade-offs between target engagement and molecular properties.

entry.title: GeoCert: Certified Geometric AI for Reliable Forecasting

author.name: Regina Zhang, Zongru Li, Honggang Wen, Xiaofeng Liu, Siu-Ming Yiu, Pietro Li\`o, Kwok-Yan Lam

entry.summary: Introduces GeoCert, a geometric AI framework that unifies forecasting, physical reasoning, and formal verification using hyperbolic manifold evolution with logarithmic-time certification. Claims certified generalization across energy, climate, and finance domains.

entry.title: CAPSULE: Control-Theoretic Action Perturbations for Safe Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Rahul Narava, Siddharth Verma, Ojas Jain, Shashi Shekhar Jha, Mayank Shekhar Jha

entry.summary: Proposes CAPSULE, a safe RL framework that learns probabilistic control-affine dynamics models offline and constructs control barrier functions incorporating model uncertainty for conservative safety constraints during exploration.

entry.title: Hindsight Preference Optimization for Financial Time Series Advisory

author.name: Yanwei Cui, Guanghui Wang, Xing Zhang, Peiyang He, Ziyuan Li, Bing Zhu, Wei Qiu, Xusheng Wang, Zheng Yu, Anqi Xin

entry.summary: Proposes Hindsight Preference Optimization for financial time series advisory, using observed outcomes to retrospectively rank LLM-generated advisories via DPO without human annotation.

entry.title: Fix Initial Codes and Iteratively Refine Textual Directions Toward Safe Multi-Turn Code Correction

author.name: Yuto Tanaka, Issei Sato

entry.summary: Proposes Iterative Refinement of Textual Directions (IRTD), a simpler alternative to Scattered Forest Search for multi-turn code correction, with theoretical safety guarantees via Oracle-Guided Inductive Synthesis.

entry.title: FlashOverlap: Minimizing Tail Latency in Communication Overlap for Distributed LLM Training

author.name: Rezaul Karim, Austin Wen, Wang Zongzuo, Weiwei Zhang, Yang Liu, Walid Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes FlashOverlap for eliminating tail latency in communication-computation overlap during distributed LLM training, targeting tensor parallelism and data parallelism bottlenecks.

entry.title: BitRL: Reinforcement Learning with 1-bit Quantized Language Models for Resource-Constrained Edge Deployment

author.name: Md. Ashiq Ul Islam Sajid, Mohammad Sakib Mahmood, Md. Tareq Hasan, Md Abdur Rahim, Rafat Ara, Md. Arafat Hossain

entry.summary: Introduces BitRL, a framework for RL agents using 1-bit quantized language models (BitNet b1.58 with ternary weights) for on-device learning and inference under severe resource constraints.

entry.title: Complexity of Linear Regions in Self-supervised Deep ReLU Networks

author.name: Mufhumudzi Muthivhi, Terence L. van Zyl

entry.summary: Studies the complexity of linear regions in ReLU networks trained with self-supervised learning, extending prior work that only examined supervised models. Shows that the evolution of linear regions correlates with representation quality in SSL.

entry.title: Hierarchical RL-MPC Control for Dynamic Wake Steering in Wind Farms

author.name: Marcus Binder Nilsen, Teodor Olof Benedict {\AA}strand, Tuhfe G\"o\c{c}men, Pierre-Elouan R\'ethor\'e

entry.summary: Presents a hierarchical RL-MPC framework for wind farm wake steering where RL learns compensatory state estimates for an MPC controller, achieving 23% power gain and safer training than direct RL control.

entry.title: In-Sync: Adaptation of Speech Aware Large Language Models for ASR with Word Level Timestamp Predictions

author.name: Xulin Fan, Vishal Sunder, Samuel Thomas, Mark Hasegawa-Johnson, Brian Kingsbury, George Saon

entry.summary: Extends a speech-aware language model to predict word-level timestamps alongside transcripts, introducing lightweight training strategies that improve alignment robustness while preserving ASR quality.

entry.title: Accelerating New Product Introduction for Visual Quality Inspection via Few-Shot Diffusion-Based Defect Synthesis

author.name: Serkan Hamdi G\"u\u{g}\"ul, Kemal Levi, Burak Acar

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based framework for few-shot industrial defect synthesis during new product introduction, disentangling defect morphology from background and enabling cross-domain transfer of defect patterns.

entry.title: AmaraSpatial-10K: A Spatially and Semantically Aligned 3D Dataset for Spatial Computing and Embodied AI

author.name: Mohammad Sadegh Salehi, Alex Perkins, Igor Maurell, Ashkan Dabbagh, Raymond Wong

entry.summary: Presents AmaraSpatial-10K, a dataset of 10,000+ deployment-ready 3D assets with metric scaling, PBR materials, collision hulls, and rich metadata for embodied AI, robotics, and AR/VR applications.

entry.title: Learning from Imperfect Text Guidance: Robust Long-Tail Visual Recognition with High-Noise Label

author.name: Mengke Li, Haiquan Ling, Yiqun Zhang, Yang Lu, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Proposes using VLM cross-modal alignment as weak teacher supervision to correct label-image inconsistencies in long-tailed noisy data, leveraging text information from labels to address high-noise settings.

entry.title: Tessera: Secure, Near-Line-Rate Weight Streaming for UMA Edge Accelerators

author.name: Animan Naskar

entry.summary: Presents Tessera, a hardware DRM architecture for secure weight streaming on edge devices with unified memory, using tile-granularity encryption to protect DNN weights from physical and software adversaries at near line-rate.

entry.title: Why Architecture Choice Matters in Symbolic Regression

author.name: Chakshu Gupta

entry.summary: Demonstrates that architecture (tree structure) choice in symbolic regression significantly affects which targets can be recovered, with cases where one structure achieves 100% while another scores 0% despite equal expressiveness.

entry.title: Explicit integral representations and quantitative bounds for two-layer ReLU networks

author.name: Anthony Lee

entry.summary: Presents explicit integral representations for two-layer ReLU networks approximating multivariate polynomials, with quantitative bounds showing L2 approximation errors that don't depend explicitly on dimension or degree. This provides theoretical foundations for understanding neural network expressiveness.

entry.title: Leveraging Spatial Transcriptomics as Alternative to Manual Annotations for Deep Learning-Based Nuclei Analysis

author.name: Kazuya Nishimura, Ryoma Bise, Haruka Hirose, Yasuhiro Kojima

entry.summary: Proposes using spatial transcriptomics data as supervision for nuclei segmentation and classification in pathology images, replacing costly pixel-level manual annotations with gene expression profiles converted to cell-type labels.

entry.title: TimingLLM: A Two-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Pre-Synthesis Timing Prediction from Verilog

author.name: Armin Abdollahi, Negin Ashrafi, Mehdi Kamal, Massoud Pedram

entry.summary: Introduces TimingLLM, a two-stage retrieval-augmented LLM pipeline for pre-synthesis timing prediction from Verilog code, using a fine-tuned LLM as a timing oracle and a second LLM with steering vectors for regression.

entry.title: Accelerating Quantum Materials Characterization: Hybrid Active Learning for Autonomous Spin Wave Spectroscopy

author.name: William Ratcliff II

entry.summary: Presents TAS-AI, a hybrid framework for autonomous triple-axis spin-wave spectroscopy that separates detection, inference, and refinement tasks, finding model-agnostic methods work better for discovery while physics-informed methods excel at parameter refinement.

entry.title: Adaptive-Distribution Randomized Neural Networks for PDEs: A Low-Dimensional Distribution-Learning Framework

author.name: You Yang, Fei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive-Distribution Randomized Neural Networks (AD-RaNN) for PDEs that adaptively optimizes the sampling distribution of hidden-layer parameters through a low-dimensional optimization problem rather than heuristic choices.

entry.title: A Divergence-Based Method for Weighting and Averaging Model Predictions

author.name: Olav Benjamin Vassend

entry.summary: Introduces a minimum divergence framework for calculating model weights for averaging probabilistic predictions, showing empirical advantages over standard methods especially at small sample sizes.

entry.title: Extreme bandits

author.name: Alexandra Carpentier, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Studies bandit problems where the goal is detecting extreme values rather than maximizing mean reward. Proposes the ExtremeHunter algorithm and analyzes extreme regret, which compares performance against an oracle that selects the source with the heaviest tail.

entry.title: XGRAG: A Graph-Native Framework for Explaining KG-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Zhuoling Li, Ha Linh Hong Tran Nguyen, Valeria Bladinieres, Maxim Romanovsky

entry.summary: Introduces XGRAG, a framework for explaining knowledge-graph-based retrieval-augmented generation by generating causally grounded explanations for how specific graph structures influence LLM outputs. Addresses the transparency gap in GraphRAG systems.

entry.title: CLARITY: A Framework and Benchmark for Conversational Language Ambiguity and Unanswerability in Interactive NL2SQL Systems

author.name: Tabinda Sarwar, Farhad Moghimifar, Cong Duy Vu Hoang, Xiaoxiao Ma, Shawn Chang Xu, Fahimeh Saleh, Poorya Zaremoodi, Avirup Sil, Katrin Kirchhoff

entry.summary: Introduces CLARITY, a framework for generating NL2SQL benchmarks with multi-faceted ambiguities and diverse user behaviors across single and multi-turn settings. Shows leading NL2SQL systems struggle with ambiguous or unanswerable queries.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Morphological Discovery in Low-Resource Bantu Languages via Cross-Lingual Transfer and Unsupervised Clustering

author.name: Hillary Mutisya, John Mugane

entry.summary: Discovers morphological features in low-resource Bantu languages by combining cross-lingual transfer with unsupervised clustering. Applied to Giriama (91 labeled paradigms), discovers 2,455 word classifications and two previously undocumented morphological patterns.

entry.title: PivotMerge: Bridging Heterogeneous Multimodal Pre-training via Post-Alignment Model Merging

author.name: Zibo Shao, Baochen Xiong, Xiaoshan Yang, Yaguang Song, Qimeng Zhang, Haifeng Chen, Changsheng Xu

entry.summary: Proposes PivotMerge for merging multimodal LLMs pretrained on different data sources, introducing post-alignment merging to integrate cross-modal alignment capabilities from multiple expert models.

entry.title: A Digital Pathology Resource for Liver Cancer Quantification with Datasets, Benchmarks, and Tools

author.name: Ying Xiao, Shimiao Tang, Xitong Ling, Weiming Chen, Jun Wang, Jiawen Li, Huaitian Yuan, Jianghui Yang, Bowen Li, Huan Li, Yiting Meng, Tian Guan, Yonghong He, Hongfang Yin

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive digital pathology resource for liver cancer quantification including fine-grained annotated datasets, benchmarks, and tools for tissue component identification in hepatocellular carcinoma histopathology slides.

entry.title: Federated Cross-Modal Retrieval with Missing Modalities via Semantic Routing and Adapter Personalization

author.name: Hefeng Zhou, Xuan Liu, Sicheng Chen, Wutong Zhang, Wu Yan, Jiong Lou, Chentao Wu, Guangtao Xue, Wei Zhao, Jie Li

entry.summary: RCSR is a federated cross-modal retrieval framework handling non-IID distributions and missing modalities using prototype anchoring, semantic routing, and client-specific adapters on a frozen CLIP backbone.

entry.title: UpstreamQA: A Modular Framework for Explicit Reasoning on Video Question Answering Tasks

author.name: Jason Nguyen, Ameet Rao, Alexander Chang, Ishaan Kumar, Erin Tan

entry.summary: UpstreamQA is a modular framework for Video QA that disentangles and evaluates core reasoning components through explicit upstream reasoning modules, bridging large multimodal and reasoning models.

entry.title: Lightweight and Production-Ready PDF Visual Element Parsing

author.name: Meizhu Liu, Yassi Abbasi, Matthew Rowe, Michael Avendi, Paul Li

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight production-ready PDF parsing framework that accurately detects visual elements (figures, tables, forms) and associates captions using spatial heuristics, layout analysis, and semantic similarity for multimodal RAG.

entry.title: EmoTrans: A Benchmark for Understanding, Reasoning, and Predicting Emotion Transitions in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: He Hu, Tengjin Weng, Zebang Cheng, Yu Wang, Jiachen Luo, Bj\"orn Schuller, Zheng Lian, Laizhong Cui

entry.summary: EmoTrans is a benchmark for evaluating emotion dynamics understanding in multimodal videos, with 1,000 annotated clips covering emotion transitions across diverse social contexts.

entry.title: BurstGP: Enhancing Raw Burst Image Super Resolution with Generative Priors

author.name: Dong Huo, Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong, Samrudhdhi B. Rangrej, Maitreya Suin, Angela Ning Ye, Zhiming Hu, Amanpreet Walia, Amirhossein Kazerouni, Konstantinos G. Derpanis, Iqbal Mohomed, Alex Levinshtein

entry.summary: BurstGP enhances burst image super-resolution by leveraging pretrained diffusion model generative priors, addressing texture complexity and oversmoothing in multi-frame fusion.

entry.title: Learning to Identify Out-of-Distribution Objects for 3D LiDAR Anomaly Segmentation

author.name: Simone Mosco, Daniel Fusaro, Alberto Pretto

entry.summary: Proposes a new approach for 3D LiDAR anomaly segmentation that models inlier feature distributions in feature space, plus a new larger-scale benchmark dataset addressing limitations of existing data.

entry.title: HAC: Parameter-Efficient Hyperbolic Adaptation of CLIP for Zero-Shot VQA

author.name: Francesco Dibitonto, Cigdem Beyan, Vittorio Murino

entry.summary: Proposes HAC, a parameter-efficient method to adapt pretrained CLIP models into hyperbolic space for zero-shot VQA, avoiding expensive training from scratch. This bridges hyperbolic representation learning with efficient fine-tuning of foundation models.

entry.title: Zoom In, Reason Out: Efficient Far-field Anomaly Detection in Expressway Surveillance Videos via Focused VLM Reasoning Guided by Bayesian Inference

author.name: Xiaowei Mao, Bowen Sui, Weijie Zhang, Yawen Yang, Shengnan Guo, Shilong Zhao, Jiaqi Lin, Tingrui Wu, Youfang Lin, Huaiyu Wa

entry.summary: Proposes VIBES, a framework combining VLMs with Bayesian inference for expressway anomaly detection, using asynchronous collaboration to handle far-field targets efficiently without processing full global frames.

entry.title: Hierarchical Prototype-based Domain Priors for Multiple Instance Learning in Multimodal Histopathology Analysis

author.name: Xuemei Qiu, Dawei Fan, Yebin Huang, Yanping Chen, Lifang Wei

entry.summary: Proposes HPDP, a hierarchical prototype-based framework for MIL in computational pathology that incorporates morphological semantics and spatial geometry as domain priors for multimodal histopathology analysis.

entry.title: Robust Grounding with MLLMs against Occlusion and Small Objects via Language-guided Semantic Cues

author.name: Beomchan Park, Seongho Kim, Hyunjun Kim, Sungjune Park, Yong Man Ro

entry.summary: Proposes Language-Guided Semantic Cues (LGSC) to improve MLLM grounding in crowded scenes with occlusion and small objects, using text embeddings to guide visual semantic cue extraction.

entry.title: Light 'em Up: Enabling Few-Shot Low-Light 3D Gaussian Splatting with Multi-Scale Explicit Retinex Illumination Decoupling

author.name: YuHao Yin, Zongji Wang, Yuanben Zhang, Biqing Li, Jiesong Bai, Junyi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MERID-GS, a Gaussian splatting framework for low-light 360° novel view synthesis that explicitly separates illumination and reflectance based on Retinex theory for consistent multi-view rendering.

entry.title: POCA: Pareto-Optimal Curriculum Alignment for Visual Text Generation

author.name: Yaohou Fan, Qingzhong Wang, Yongsong Huang, Junyi Liu, Tomo Miyazaki, Shinichiro Omachi

entry.summary: Proposes POCA for visual text generation, using Pareto-optimal curriculum alignment with reinforcement learning to balance text accuracy against image coherence, with intelligent prompt selection.

entry.title: Instance Awareness of Multi-class Semantic Segmentation Loss Functions

author.name: Soumya Snigdha Kundu, Florian Kofler, Marina Ivory, Hendrik Moller, Jonathan Shapey, Tom Vercauteren

entry.summary: Shows that extending instance-sensitive segmentation losses to multi-class settings via one-vs-rest decomposition naturally addresses both instance and class imbalance, with a stabilized inverse-size weighting approach.

entry.title: Monocular Depth Estimation via Neural Network with Learnable Algebraic Group and Ring Structures

author.name: Qianlei Wang, Kexun Chen, Shaolin Zhang, Hongli Gao, Chaoning Zhang, Xiaolin Qin

entry.summary: Proposes LAGRNet for monocular depth estimation that explicitly embeds learnable group, ring, and sheaf structures from algebraic geometry into the deep learning pipeline to model perspective projection.

entry.title: BMD-45: A Large-Scale CCTV Vehicle Detection Dataset for Urban Traffic in Developing Cities

author.name: Akash Sharma, Chinmay Mhatre, Sankalp Gawali, Ruthvik Bokkasam, Brij Sharma, Vishwajeet Pattanaik, Punit Rathore, Raghu Krishnapuram, Vijay Gopal Kovvali, Anirban Chakraborty, Yogesh Simmhan

entry.summary: Introduces BMD-45, a large-scale CCTV vehicle detection dataset with 480K bounding boxes from 3.6K cameras in developing cities, addressing the bias toward organized traffic in existing benchmarks.

entry.title: Point-MF: One-step Point Cloud Generation from a Single Image via Mean Flows

author.name: Yuta Baba, Keiji Yanai

entry.summary: Point-MF proposes a Mean-Flow-based framework for single-step point cloud reconstruction from a single image, achieving one-step generation (1-NFE) without VAE latent representations. This dramatically reduces inference cost compared to diffusion-based methods that require many denoising iterations.

entry.title: Personalizing Causal Audio-Driven Facial Motion via Dynamic Multi-modal Retrieval

author.name: Xuangeng Chu, Yu Han, Wei Mao, Shih-En Wei

entry.summary: Presents a causal framework for personalizing audio-driven facial animation via dynamic multi-modal style retrieval, enabling ultra-low latency streaming while leveraging unstructured style references. Introduces temporal hierarchical motion representation for maintaining decoding causality.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Agentic Floor Plan Parsing for Accessible Indoor Navigation of Blind and Low-Vision People

author.name: Aydin Ayanzadeh, Tim Oates

entry.summary: An agentic framework that converts floor plan images into spatial knowledge graphs for generating accessible navigation instructions for blind and low-vision individuals. Uses multi-agent parsing with self-correcting pipelines and safety evaluation.

entry.title: Betting for Sim-to-Real Performance Evaluation

author.name: Zaid Mahboob, Yujia Chen, Bowen Weng

entry.summary: Proposes a betting-based framework for sim-to-real performance evaluation of robots, providing accurate and efficient estimates of real-world behavior under limited physical experimentation. Complements variance reduction approaches with a novel statistical methodology.

entry.title: Anchored Variational Inference for Personalized Sequential Latent-State Models

author.name: Xingche Guo

entry.summary: Proposes an anchored variational inference framework for sequential latent-variable models with subject-specific random effects. Replaces expensive integration over random effects with evaluation at representative 'anchor points' while preserving tractable local inference.

entry.title: Continuum-marginal optimal transport: a mesh-free kernel method

author.name: Yumiharu Nakano

entry.summary: Proposes a mesh-free kernel method for continuum-marginal optimal transport, embedding the weak continuity equation in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. Enables recovery of minimum-energy velocity fields from time-continuous marginals without spatial discretization.

entry.title: Omni-o3: Deep Nested Omnimodal Deduction for Deliberative Audio-Visual Reasoning

author.name: Zhicheng Zhang, Wentao Gu, Weicheng Wang, Yongjie Zhu, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang, Pengfei Wan, Jufeng Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-o3, a framework for deliberative audio-visual reasoning using deep nested deduction that formulates reasoning as dynamic recursive search with shared reasoning prefixes across branches.

entry.title: PrivSTRUCT: Untangling Data Purpose Compliance of Privacy Policies in Google Play Store

author.name: Bhanuka Silva, Anirban Mahanti, Aruna Seneviratne, Suranga Senevirante

entry.summary: Introduces PrivSTRUCT, a framework that leverages the structural hierarchy of privacy policies to extract data practices, finding 2x more data item/purpose excerpts than state-of-the-art while preserving structural context.

entry.title: From Global to Local: Rethinking CLIP Feature Aggregation for Person Re-Identification

author.name: Aotian Zheng, Winston Sun, Bahaa Alattar, Vitaly Ablavsky, Jenq-Neng Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes SAGA-ReID for CLIP-based person re-identification, replacing global CLS token aggregation with spatially-aware anchor-guided aggregation in CLIP's text embedding space to handle occlusion and cross-camera variation.

entry.title: Tell Me Why: Designing an Explainable LLM-based Dialogue System for Student Problem Behavior Diagnosis

author.name: Zhilin Fan, Deliang Wang, Penghe Chen, Yu Lu

entry.summary: Presents an explainable LLM-based dialogue system for student problem behavior diagnosis that uses hierarchical attribution to identify dialogue evidence for each recommendation and generate natural-language explanations.

entry.title: From Natural Language to Verified Code: Toward AI Assisted Problem-to-Code Generation with Dafny-Based Formal Verification

author.name: Md Erfan, Md Kamal Hossain Chowdhury, Ahmed Ryan, Md Rayhanur Rahman

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-based code generation with formal verification using Dafny, introducing the NL2VC-60 dataset of 60 complex algorithmic problems. Tests 7 open-weight LLMs with tiered prompting strategies for transitioning from natural language to verified code.

entry.title: When Policies Cannot Be Retrained: A Unified Closed-Form View of Post-Training Steering in Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Elias Hossain, Mohammad Jahid Ibna Basher, Ivan Garibay, Ozlem Garibay, Niloofar Yousefi

entry.summary: Studies deployment-time adaptation for frozen offline RL policies using Product-of-Experts composition with goal-conditioned priors. Main finding is graceful degradation rather than universal gain, with a KL-budget selector recovering near-oracle performance.

entry.title: Accelerating Frequency Domain Diffusion Models with Error-Feedback Event-Driven Caching

author.name: Dong Liu, Haisheng Wang, Yanxuan Yu

entry.summary: Proposes E²-CRF for accelerating frequency domain diffusion models using error-feedback event-driven KV caching. Exploits spectral localization and mirror symmetry to selectively recompute only high-energy or rapidly-changing tokens.

entry.title: Channel Adaptation for EEG Foundation Models: A Systematic Benchmark Across Architectures, Tasks, and Training Regimes

author.name: Kuntal Kokate, Bruno Aristimunha, Dung Truong, Arnaud Delorme

entry.summary: First systematic comparison of four channel adaptation methods across five EEG foundation models, five tasks, and two training regimes. Finds that rigid-montage models require external adaptation while flexible models handle it natively when fine-tuned.

entry.title: Hybrid JIT-CUDA Graph Optimization for Low-Latency Large Language Model Inference

author.name: Divakar Kumar Yadav, Tian Zhao

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid runtime combining JIT compilation with CUDA Graph execution for low-latency LLM inference, partitioning transformer inference into static (CUDA Graph) and dynamic (JIT) components. Evaluated on LLaMA models for short-sequence interactive settings.

entry.title: Reparameterization through Coverings and Topological Weight Priors

author.name: Maxim Beketov, Pavel Snopov

entry.summary: Generalizes the VAE reparameterization trick to latent spaces with non-trivial topology using covering maps, establishing KL-divergence bounds for pushforward densities on base manifolds.

entry.title: Crystal structure prediction using graph neural combinatorial optimization

author.name: Stavros Gerolymatos, J. Kyle Brubaker, Martin J. A. Schuetz, Vladimir V. Gusev

entry.summary: Applies graph neural network-based combinatorial optimization to crystal structure prediction, addressing the challenge of allocating atoms on a discrete grid while minimizing interaction energy for large-scale instances.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Offline-to-Online Learning in Linear Contextual Bandits

author.name: Zean Han, Ruihan Lin, Zezhen Ding, Jiheng Zhang

entry.summary: Studies offline-to-online learning in linear contextual bandits with biased offline data, proposing Ellipsoidal-MINUCB that uses geometry-aware confidence regions from offline ridge estimation rather than isotropic warm-starting.

entry.title: Leveraging Human Feedback for Semantically-Relevant Skill Discovery

author.name: Maxence Hussonnois, Thommen George Karimpanal, Santu Rana

entry.summary: Introduces semantic labelling as a feedback-efficient alternative to preference-based approaches for grounding unsupervised skill discovery in RL, leveraging human cognitive strengths to categorize skills.

entry.title: SceneSelect: Selective Learning for Trajectory Scene Classification and Expert Scheduling

author.name: Xinrun Wang, Deshun Xia, Ke Xu, Weijie Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces SceneSelect, a scene-centric paradigm for trajectory prediction that uses selective learning to classify scenes and schedule specialized expert models, rather than training a single unified model across heterogeneous environments.

entry.title: A Functorial Formulation of Neighborhood Aggregating Deep Learning

author.name: Sun Woo Park, Yun Young Choi, U Jin Choi, Youngho Woo

entry.summary: Provides a category-theoretic interpretation of convolutional/message-passing neural networks using presheaves and copresheaves, deriving theoretical heuristics for known empirical limitations from obstruction theory.

entry.title: Load constrained wind farm flow control through multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning

author.name: Teodor {\AA}strand, Marcus Binder Nilsen, Iasonas Tsaklis, Tuhfe G\"o\c{c}men, Pierre-Elouan R\'ethor\'e, Nikolay Dimitrov

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent RL framework for load-constrained wind farm flow control using Independent SAC with data-driven surrogate models for structural load estimation, balancing power production against fatigue damage.

entry.title: Applied AI-Enhanced RF Interference Rejection

author.name: Rahul Jain, Pierre Trepagnier, Rick Gentile, Joey Botero, Alexia Schulz

entry.summary: Uses autoregressive transformer decoders for AI-enhanced RF interference rejection, achieving orders of magnitude faster throughput than previous WaveNet models while maintaining interference suppression performance.

entry.title: VS-DDPM: Efficient Low-Cost Diffusion Model for Medical Modality Translation

author.name: Nikoo Moradi, Gijs Luijten, Behrus Hinrichs-Puladi, Jens Kleesiek, Victor Alves, Jan Egger, Andr\'e Ferreira

entry.summary: Proposes 3D Variable-Step DDPM for medical image modality translation, achieving state-of-the-art performance in missing MRI synthesis while significantly accelerating inference through variable denoising steps.

entry.title: Turtle shell clustering: A mixture approach to discriminative clustering with applications to flow cytometry and other data

author.name: Mackenzie R. Neal, Paul D. McNicholas, Arthur White

entry.summary: Presents turtle shell clustering, a fully unsupervised probabilistic discriminative clustering method using regularized mutual information with a mixture-of-mixtures model and automatic component number selection.

entry.title: UniAda: Universal Adaptive Multi-objective Adversarial Attack for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Systems

author.name: Jingyu Zhang, Jacky Wai Keung, Yan Xiao, Yihan Liao, Yishu Li, Xiaoxue Ma

entry.summary: Introduces UniAda, a multi-objective adversarial attack for end-to-end autonomous driving systems that targets both steering angle and speed-related controls simultaneously while maintaining imperceptible perturbations.

entry.title: Nonlinear Non-Gaussian Density Steering with Input and Noise Channel Mismatch: Sinkhorn with Memory for Solving the Control-affine Schr\"{o}dinger Bridge Problem

author.name: Georgiy A. Bondar, Asmaa Eldesoukey, Yongxin Chen, Abhishek Halder

entry.summary: Proposes 'Sinkhorn with Memory' algorithm for solving the control-affine Schrödinger bridge problem when control and noise channels don't match, addressing cases where the standard Hopf-Cole transform doesn't linearize the system.

entry.title: Multi-Plane HyperX: A Low-Latency and Cost-Effective Network for Large-Scale AI and HPC Systems

author.name: Ziyu Wang, Fei Lei, Dezun Dong

entry.summary: Investigates multi-plane HyperX network architecture for AI data centers, showing significantly smaller network diameter and superior bisection bandwidth compared to multi-plane Fat-Tree, Dragonfly, and Dragonfly+ topologies.

entry.title: ComplianceNLP: Knowledge-Graph-Augmented RAG for Multi-Framework Regulatory Gap Detection

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Introduces ComplianceNLP, an end-to-end system for regulatory compliance that combines knowledge-graph-augmented RAG, multi-task obligation extraction, and gap detection across SEC, MiFID II, and Basel III frameworks.

entry.title: FAIR_XAI: Improving Multimodal Foundation Model Fairness via Explainability for Wellbeing Assessment

author.name: Sophie Chiang, Tom Brennan, Fethiye Irmak Dogan, Jiaee Cheong, Hatice Gunes

entry.summary: Investigates VLM performance for wellbeing assessment across lab and naturalistic datasets, focusing on diagnostic reliability and demographic fairness, finding substantial performance variation across environments and demographics.

entry.title: PEPS: Positional Encoding Projected Sampling -- Extended

author.name: Guillaume Perez, Janarbek Matai, Takahiro Harada

entry.summary: Proposes Positional Encoding Projected Sampling (PEPS) for implicit neural representations, showing positional encoding can be decomposed as meaningful points for sampling rather than just high-dimensional embeddings.

entry.title: Identifiability and Stability of Generative Drifting with Companion-Elliptic Kernel Families

author.name: Hak Geun Lee

entry.summary: Analyzes identifiability and stability of the drifting field in the Generative Drifting framework, proving the field vanishes iff measures are equal for companion-elliptic kernels (Gaussian and Matérn with ν≥1/2).

entry.title: Meta-CoT: Enhancing Granularity and Generalization in Image Editing

author.name: Shiyi Zhang, Yiji Cheng, Tiankai Hang, Zijin Yin, Runze He, Yu Xu, Wenxun Dai, Yunlong Lin, Chunyu Wang, Qinglin Lu, Yansong Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Meta-CoT for image editing, which performs two-level decomposition of editing operations into (task, target, required understanding ability) triplets. Enhances both understanding granularity and generalization in unified multimodal models.

entry.title: RouteLMT: Learned Sample Routing for Hybrid LLM Translation Deployment

author.name: Yingfeng Luo, Hongyu Liu, Dingyang Lin, Kaiyan Chang, Chenglong Wang, Bei Li, Quan Du, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu

entry.summary: Formulates machine translation routing as a budget allocation problem, identifying marginal gain (large model improvement over small) as the optimal routing signal. Proposes learned sample routing for hybrid LLM translation deployment.

entry.title: Identifying and typifying demographic unfairness in phoneme-level embeddings of self-supervised speech recognition models

author.name: Felix Herron, Solange Rossato, Alexandre Allauzen, Fran\c{c}ois Portet

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for identifying and typifying demographic unfairness in ASR systems at the phoneme embedding level, distinguishing between random error (high variance) and systematic error (embedding bias) across speaker groups.

entry.title: Representational Harms in LLM-Generated Narratives Against Global Majority Nationalities

author.name: Ilana Nguyen, Harini Suresh, Thema Monroe-White, Evan Shieh

entry.summary: Studies how national origin identities are portrayed by widely-adopted LLMs in open-ended narrative generation, finding persistent representational harms against Global Majority nationalities including stereotyping and negative sentiment bias.

entry.title: AeSlides: Incentivizing Aesthetic Layout in LLM-Based Slide Generation via Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Yiming Pan, Chengwei Hu, Xuancheng Huang, Can Huang, Mingming Zhao, Yuean Bi, Xiaohan Zhang, Aohan Zeng, Linmei Hu

entry.summary: Proposes AeSlides, using reinforcement learning with verifiable aesthetic rewards to improve LLM-generated slide layouts. Addresses the modality gap between text-centric generation and visual quality requirements.

entry.title: NeuroAPS-Net: Neuro-Anatomically Aware Point Cloud Representation for Efficient Alzheimer's Disease Classification

author.name: Towhidul Islam (ICS Department, King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia), Mufti Mahmud (SDAIA-KFUPM JRC for AI, King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, IRC for Bio Systems and Machines, King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia)

entry.summary: NeuroAPS-Net converts T1-weighted MRI into anatomically informed 2D point clouds for lightweight Alzheimer's disease classification, creating the first neuroanatomically labeled MRI-derived point cloud dataset (ADNI-2DPC).

entry.title: Text-Guided Multimodal Unified Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Zewen Li, Shuo Ye, Zitong Yu, Weicheng Xie, Linlin Shen

entry.summary: Proposes a unified multimodal industrial anomaly detection framework guided by text semantics, combining geometry-aware cross-modal mapping (RGB to 3D) with object-conditioned textual feature adaptation.

entry.title: One Identity, Many Roles: Multimodal Entity Coreference for Enhanced Video Situation Recognition

author.name: Balaji Darur, Amanmeet Garg, Makarand Tapaswi

entry.summary: Proposes Multimodal Entity Coreference (MEC) for video situation recognition, uniting entity descriptions in text with spatio-temporal grounding across video shots for coherent understanding.

entry.title: Bridging the Pose-Semantic Gap: A Cascade Framework for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search

author.name: Zequn Xie, Guijin Luo, Chuxin Wang, Sihang Cai, Tao Jin, Zhou Zhao, Yixuan Tang

entry.summary: SSDC framework for text-based person anomaly search decouples retrieval into structural (skeletal) coarse filtering and multi-agent semantic verification stages to bridge the pose-semantic gap in surveillance video search.

entry.title: Learn&Drop: Fast Learning of CNNs based on Layer Dropping

author.name: Giorgio Cruciata, Luca Cruciata, Liliana Lo Presti, Jan Van Gemert, Marco La Cascia

entry.summary: Learn&Drop proposes a training method that evaluates layer-wise learning scores and progressively drops layers that stop learning, reducing forward propagation operations during training.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Multicenter Nancy Index Scoring in Ulcerative Colitis Using Foundation Models

author.name: Adam Kuku\v{c}ka, Ond\v{r}ej Fabi\'an, V\'it Musil, Tom\'a\v{s} Br\'azdil

entry.summary: Proposes a weakly supervised MIL approach using foundation models for automated Nancy histological index scoring of ulcerative colitis from whole-slide images, requiring only slide-level labels.

entry.title: From Noisy Historical Maps to Time-Series Oil Palm Mapping Without Annotation in Malaysia and Indonesia (2020-2024)

author.name: Nuttaset Kuapanich, Juepeng Zheng, Bohan Shi, Jiaying Liu, Jiayin Jiang, Jiatao Huang, Shenghan Tan, Qingmei Li, Haohuan Fu

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework to generate 10-meter resolution oil palm plantation maps for Indonesia and Malaysia (2020-2024) from Sentinel-2 imagery without new annotations, using noisy historical labels.

entry.title: Bringing a Personal Point of View: Evaluating Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Jan Warchocki, Xi Wang, Jonas Kulhanek, Jan van Gemert

entry.summary: Evaluates dynamic monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting models on egocentric video reconstruction using paired ego-exocentric data, finding significant challenges specific to the egocentric setting.

entry.title: TopoHR: Hierarchical Centerline Representation for Cyclic Topology Reasoning in Driving Scenes with Point-to-Instance Relations

author.name: Yifeng Bai, Zhirong Chen, Erkang Cheng, Haibin Ling

entry.summary: Proposes TopoHR for autonomous driving topology reasoning, establishing cyclic interaction between centerline detection and topology reasoning with hierarchical point-to-instance representations.

entry.title: Multivariate Gaussian NeRF for Wide Field-of-View Ultrasound Reconstruction

author.name: Patris Valera, Magdalena Wysocki, Felix Duelmer, Mohammad Farid Azampour, Sebastian Herz, Stefan W\"orz, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Introduces Ultra-Wide-NeRF, a NeRF-based method using multivariate 3D Gaussians for wide field-of-view ultrasound reconstruction that models complex convex probe beam geometry to reduce compounding artifacts.

entry.title: WildLIFT: Lifting monocular drone video to 3D for species-agnostic wildlife monitoring

author.name: Vandita Shukla, Fabio Remondino, Blair Costelloe, Benjamin Risse

entry.summary: WildLIFT integrates 3D scene geometry from monocular drone video with open-vocabulary 2D instance segmentation for species-agnostic wildlife monitoring. It produces oriented 3D bounding boxes with semantic face information for quantitative viewpoint coverage and occlusion assessment.

entry.title: Geometric Analysis of Self-Supervised Vision Representations for Semantic Image Retrieval

author.name: Esteban Rodr\'iguez-Betancourt, Edgar Casasola-Murillo

entry.summary: Evaluates how representations from modern self-supervised vision learning methods perform for content-based image retrieval using vector databases. Reveals that latent space geometry impacts approximate nearest neighbor indexing and retrieval effectiveness.

entry.title: Large Language Model based Interactive Decision-Making for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xinwei Dong, Jiyang Li, Jiabin Xie, Yang Yi, Tianshang Jia, Shiyu Fang, Ye Tian, Peng Hang

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-based interactive decision-making framework for autonomous driving that uses Object-Process Methodology for semantic modeling of multi-vehicle scenes. Augments intent understanding and interaction for improved safety and efficiency in mixed traffic.

entry.title: Cooptimizing Safety and Performance Using Safety Value-Constrained Model Predictive Control

author.name: Hao Wang, Nam Nguyen, Armand Jordana, Ludovic Righetti, Somil Bansal

entry.summary: Augments MPC with safety value function-based terminal constraints to enforce control-invariant safe set membership, enabling trajectories that are both high-performing and provably safe beyond the finite planning horizon.

entry.title: FreqCache: Accelerating Embodied VLN Models with Adaptive Frequency-Guided Token Caching

author.name: Zihao Zheng, Xingyue Zhou, Zhihao Mao, Songyu Sun, Lingyue Zhang, Yulong Ao, Yupu Feng, Qiongqiong Zhang, Yonghua Lin, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: FreqCache accelerates Vision-Language-Navigation models through adaptive frequency-guided token caching, addressing limitations of visual domain caching methods for VLN including viewpoint migration, edge information loss, and temporal scenario variation.

entry.title: Design, Cups, and Blankets. A Free-Energy-Principle-Based Approach to Product Design

author.name: Luca M. Possati

entry.summary: Formalizes 'requirement-steered interface type inference' using the Free Energy Principle, where the task is to infer what kind of interface (Markov blanket) a physical system needs for functional requirements to be satisfiable. Proposes Constrained Dynamic Markov Blanket Detection (C-DMBD) algorithm.

entry.title: Investigating echo tasks in Qwen 2.5-1.5B Instruct - part 1

author.name: nesiacel

entry.summary: Mechanistic interpretability investigation of echo/repeat tasks in Qwen 2.5-1.5B, finding that MLP layers rather than attention handle most of the processing for these tasks. Ablation and direct logit attribution results disagree, pointing to MLP importance.

entry.title: MambaCSP: Hybrid-Attention State Space Models for Hardware-Efficient Channel State Prediction

author.name: Aladin Djuhera, Haris Gacanin, Holger Boche

entry.summary: Proposes MambaCSP, a hybrid-attention state space model architecture for channel state prediction in wireless systems, replacing LLM-based prediction with a more hardware-efficient alternative.

entry.title: A Co-Evolutionary Theory of Human-AI Coexistence: Mutualism, Governance, and Dynamics in Complex Societies

author.name: Somyajit Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework for human-AI coexistence based on conditional mutualism under governance, drawing on ecology, computability theory, and alignment research to argue against simple obedience-based AI frameworks.

entry.title: How Supply Chain Dependencies Complicate Bias Measurement and Accountability Attribution in AI Hiring Applications

author.name: Gauri Sharma, Maryam Molamohammadi

entry.summary: Examines how supply chain dependencies in AI hiring systems (data vendors, model developers, platform providers) complicate bias measurement and accountability attribution. Analyzes regulatory responses including EU AI Act and NYC Local Law 144.

entry.title: A Tale of Two Variances: When Single-Seed Benchmarks Fail in Bayesian Deep Learning

author.name: Qishi Zhan, Minxuan Hu, Liang He, Guansu Wang, Jiaxin Liu

entry.summary: Studies when single-seed BDL evaluations fail, showing CRPS variance trajectories differ across methods with learned heteroscedastic variance heads showing pronounced variance peaks. Argues for multi-seed evaluation.

entry.title: Follow the TRACE: Exploiting Post-Click Trajectories for Online Delayed Conversion Rate Prediction

author.name: Xinyue Zhang, Yuanhao Ding, Xiang Ao

entry.summary: Proposes TRACE for online CVR prediction that models post-click behavior evolution as feedback trajectories rather than forcing hard labels on unrevealed conversions. Includes a reliability-gated retrospective completer.

entry.title: A Layer Separation Optimization Framework for Cross-Entropy Training in Deep Learning

author.name: Yaru Liu, Michael K. Ng, Yiqi Gu

entry.summary: Proposes layer separation optimization for cross-entropy training in deep learning, decomposing the nested optimization into manageable subproblems using auxiliary variables. Proves the separated loss upper-bounds the original.

entry.title: Approximating Uniform Random Rotations by Two-Block Structured Hadamard Rotations in High Dimensions

author.name: Tomer Zilca, Gal Mendelson

entry.summary: Studies two-block structured Hadamard rotations as approximations to uniform random rotations in high dimensions, providing both positive and negative theoretical results. Relevant to JL embeddings, kernel approximation, and AI compression.

entry.title: Geometry Preserving Loss Functions Promote Improved Adaptation of Blackbox Generative Model

author.name: Sinjini Mitra, Constantine Kyriakakis, Shenyuan Liang, Anuj Srivastava, Pavan Turaga

entry.summary: Proposes geometry-preserving loss functions for adapting blackbox generative models without access to weights/gradients, using an end-to-end pipeline that leverages geometric structure of the output space.

entry.title: Gromov-Wasserstein Methods for Multi-View Relational Embedding and Clustering

author.name: Rafael Pereira Eufrazio, Eduardo Fernandes Montesuma, Charles Casimiro Cavalcante

entry.summary: Proposes Bary-GWMDS and Mean-GWMDS-C, Gromov-Wasserstein-based methods for learning consensus embeddings from multi-view relational data that naturally handle nonlinear distortions across views.

entry.title: FreeScale: Distributed Training for Sequence Recommendation Models with Minimal Scaling Cost

author.name: Chenhao Feng, Haoli Zhang, Shakhzod Ali-Zade, Yanli Zhao, Liang Luo, Jennifer Cao, Lisen Deng, Siqiao Chen, Chenyu Zhao, Tristan Rice, Daniel Johnson, Min Si, Tiantu Xu, Yi Zhang, Siqi Yan, Chuanhao Zhuge, Min Ni, Bi Xue, Qunshu Zhang, Shen Li

entry.summary: Introduces FreeScale for distributed training of sequence recommendation models, addressing computational heterogeneity through load balancing, overlapped embedding communication, and GPU resource management.

entry.title: Mitigating Error Amplification in Fast Adversarial Training

author.name: Mengnan Zhao, Lihe Zhang, Bo Wang, Tianhang Zheng, Hong Zhong, Geyong Min

entry.summary: Analyzes how guidance strength affects model performance in Fast Adversarial Training across confidence groups, finding that low-confidence samples drive catastrophic overfitting, and proposes mitigation strategies.

entry.title: Dialysis Risk Prediction and Treatment Effect Estimation for AKI patients using Longitudinal Electronic Health Records

author.name: Kalyani P. Pande, Evan Yang, Bryan Zhu, Sandeep K. Mallipattu, Alisa Yurovsky, Tengfei Ma

entry.summary: Develops a transformer-based causal model for predicting dialysis risk in AKI patients from longitudinal EHR data, estimating drug-level treatment effects using counterfactual analysis. Achieves AUC of 0.694 on a cohort of 81,401 patients.

entry.title: Fraud Detection in Cryptocurrency Markets with Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Lidia Losavio, Luca Persia, Madan Sathe, Dimosthenis Pasadakis

entry.summary: Proposes graph-based methods for cryptocurrency fraud detection using spatio-temporal GNNs, constructing graphs from aggregated hourly market data to capture coordination and repetition patterns in market manipulation.

entry.title: Accelerating Reinforcement Learning for Wind Farm Control via Expert Demonstrations

author.name: Marcus Binder Nilsen, Julian Quick, Tuhfe G\"o\c{c}men, Nikolay Dimitrov, Pierre-Elouan R\'ethor\'e

entry.summary: Investigates pretraining RL agents for wind farm control using expert demonstrations from steady-state wake models, showing that behavior cloning initialization significantly accelerates training and improves initial performance of Soft Actor-Critic agents.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Learning for Android Malware Detection on a Time-Stamped Dataset

author.name: Annan Fu, Hao Pei, Maryam Tanha

entry.summary: Proposes an Android malware detection framework using BYOL self-supervised pre-training with temporal-aware evaluation, achieving 98% accuracy under time-stamped dataset conditions that prevent temporal information leakage.

entry.title: Toward Real-World Adoption of Portrait Relighting via Hybrid Domain Knowledge Fusion

author.name: Qian Huang, Mayoore Selvarasa Jaiswal, Zhen Zhong, Rochelle Pereira, Jianyuan Min

entry.summary: Proposes Hybrid Domain Knowledge Fusion for portrait relighting, distilling specialized models trained on synthetic, OLAT, and real-world data into a lightweight student model, achieving 6x-240x inference speedup.

entry.title: MetaErr: Towards Predicting Error Patterns in Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Varun Totakura, Shayok Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes MetaErr, a meta-model framework that predicts whether a deep neural network will succeed or fail on a given input before inference. This addresses the under-explored problem of failure prediction in deep learning systems.

entry.title: Probabilistic Graphical Model using Graph Neural Networks for Bayesian Inversion of Discrete Structural Component States

author.name: Teng Li, Stephen Wu, Yong Huang, James L. Beck, Hui Li

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian inversion framework using graph neural networks as probabilistic graphical models to infer discrete structural component health states from measurable responses in civil infrastructure.

entry.title: COMO: Closed-Loop Optical Molecule Recognition with Minimum Risk Training

author.name: Zhuoqi Lyu, Qing Ke

entry.summary: Proposes COMO for optical chemical structure recognition using minimum risk training to address exposure bias in translating molecular images to SMILES, optimizing toward molecular-level metrics like chemical validity and structural similarity.

entry.title: From Rights to Rites: Expectations Management in Smart-Home AI

author.name: Varad Vishwarupe, Ivan Flechais, Marina Jirotka, Nigel Shadbolt

entry.summary: Based on 33 interviews with practitioners from Amazon Alexa, Microsoft Azure IoT, and Google Nest, develops 'Expectations Management' model describing how smart-home AI practitioners shape and repair user expectations balancing organizational rights with cultural rites.

entry.title: Fixed-Reservoir vs Variational Quantum Architectures for Chaotic Dynamics: Benchmarking QRC and QPINN on the Lorenz System

author.name: Tushar Pandey

entry.summary: Compares Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Quantum Reservoir Computing for Lorenz system prediction, finding QRC achieves 81% lower MSE while training 52,000x faster than QPINN under matched quantum resources.

entry.title: New non-Euclidean neural quantum states from additional types of hyperbolic recurrent neural networks

author.name: H. L. Dao

entry.summary: Extends non-Euclidean neural quantum states to include Poincaré RNN, Lorentz RNN, and Lorentz GRU variants, demonstrating outperformance over Euclidean counterparts for quantum many-body problems with hierarchical structures.

entry.title: A Survey on Split Learning for LLM Fine-Tuning: Models, Systems, and Privacy Optimizations

author.name: Zihan Liu, Yizhen Wang, Rui Wang, Xiu Tang, Sai Wu

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey on split learning approaches for LLM fine-tuning, covering model methods, system optimizations, and privacy defenses. It addresses the practical problem of enabling resource-constrained organizations to fine-tune LLMs while maintaining data privacy.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Analysis of Shared Syntactic Mechanisms in Language Models

author.name: Ryoma Kumon, Hitomi Yanaka

entry.summary: Investigates whether language models use shared neural mechanisms across different syntactic constructions (filler-gap dependencies and NPI licensing). Finds highly localized shared mechanisms for filler-gap but not for NPI processing.

entry.title: Using Embedding Models to Improve Probabilistic Race Prediction

author.name: Noan Dasanaike, Kosuke Imai

entry.summary: Proposes using pre-trained text embeddings to improve Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG) for race prediction, particularly for uncommon surnames. Shows substantial improvement for the 10% of the US population with omitted surnames.

entry.title: Can QPP Choose the Right Query Variant? Evaluating Query Variant Selection for RAG Pipelines

author.name: Negar Arabzadeh, Andrew Drozdov, Michael Bendersky, Matei Zaharia

entry.summary: Investigates using Query Performance Prediction (QPP) for selecting the best query reformulation variant in RAG pipelines before executing expensive retrieval and generation. Studies intra-topic discrimination across ad-hoc retrieval and end-to-end RAG.

entry.title: Neural Network Optimization Reimagined: Decoupled Techniques for Scratch and Fine-Tuning

author.name: Xin Ning, Qiankun Li, Xiaolong Huang, Qiupu Chen, Feng He, Weijun Li, Prayag Tiwari, Xinwang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DualOpt, decoupling optimization techniques for training from scratch vs. fine-tuning. Introduces real-time layer-wise weight decay for training from scratch and specialized strategies for fine-tuning pre-trained models.

entry.title: Breaking Degradation Coupling: A Structural Entropy Guided Decoupled Framework and Benchmark for Infrared Enhancement

author.name: Pu Li, Huafeng Li, Yafei Zhang, Yu Liu, Wen Wang

entry.summary: SEGD framework decomposes compound thermal infrared image degradations into independent sub-processes using structural entropy guidance, modeling them via degradation-specific residual modules instead of a single shared backbone.

entry.title: DyABD: The Abdominal Muscle Segmentation in Dynamic MRI Benchmark

author.name: Niamh Belton, Victoria Joppin, Aonghus Lawlor, Catherine Masson, Thierry Bege, David Bendahan, Kathleen M. Curran

entry.summary: DyABD introduces the first benchmark of dynamic abdominal MRIs from hernia patients with muscle annotations during exercises, creating an extremely challenging segmentation task with pre/post-operative data.

entry.title: SemiGDA: Generative Dual-distribution Alignment for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Kaiwen Huang, Yi Zhou, Yizhe Zhang, Jingxiong Li, Tao Zhou

entry.summary: SemiGDA proposes a generative dual-distribution alignment framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation, aligning feature and semantic distributions to boost learning with limited labels.

entry.title: Keypoint-based Dynamic Object 6-DoF Pose Tracking via Event Camera

author.name: Zhe Wang, Qijin Song, Zihao Li, Jingyu Xiao, Weibang Bai

entry.summary: Proposes keypoint-based 6-DoF pose tracking for dynamic objects using event cameras, with detection network on time surfaces and tracking via event density analysis.

entry.title: BVI-Mamba: Video Enhancement Using a Visual State-Space Model for Low-Light and Underwater Environments

author.name: Guoxi Huang, Ruirui Lin, Yini Li, David R. Bull, Nantheera Anantrasirichai

entry.summary: BVI-Mamba proposes Visual State Space Model-based video enhancement for low-light and underwater conditions, using feature alignment and VSS-based enhancement modules to reduce memory usage.

entry.title: Reading in the Dark: Low-light Scene Text Recognition

author.name: Xuanshuo Fu, Lei Kang, Ernest Valveny, Dimosthenis Karatzas, Javier Vazquez-Corral

entry.summary: Introduces LSTR, a large-scale low-light scene text recognition dataset, and explores OCR fine-tuning strategies and joint training with low-light image enhancement for improved text recognition in dark conditions.

entry.title: ESIA: An Energy-Based Spatiotemporal Interaction-Aware Framework for Pedestrian Intention Prediction

author.name: Yanping Wu, Meiting Dang, Lin Wu, Edmond S. L. Ho, Zhenghua Chen, Chongfeng Wei

entry.summary: Proposes ESIA, a CRF-based framework for pedestrian intention prediction that models multi-agent interactions as structured energy-based prediction over a unified graph representation for autonomous driving.

entry.title: Focus on What Matters: Two-Stage ROI-Aware Refinement for Anatomy-Preserving Fetal Ultrasound Reconstruction

author.name: Ines Abbes, Mahmood Alzubaidi, Mowafa Househ, Khalid Alyafei, Marco Agus, Samir Brahim Belhaouari

entry.summary: Proposes an ROI-aware representation learning framework for fetal ultrasound reconstruction that refines clinically important regions (nuchal translucency) while maintaining global image fidelity, addressing multi-hospital domain shift.

entry.title: Multi-View Synergistic Learning with Vision-Language Adaption for Low-Resource Biomedical Image Classification

author.name: Xiaoliu Luo, Minxue Xiao, Ting Xie, Mengzhu Wang, Huiqing Qi, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Taiping Zhang, Xu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-View Synergistic Learning (MVSL) for low-resource biomedical image classification, combining parameter-efficient adaptation of vision-language models with multi-granularity representation learning.

entry.title: Breaking the Scalability Limit of Multi-Projector Calibration with Embedded Cameras

author.name: Takumi Kawano, Kohei Miura, Daisuke Iwai

entry.summary: Presents a new multi-projector calibration framework using embedded cameras in the calibration target, enabling simultaneous calibration of all projectors and breaking the linear scaling bottleneck.

entry.title: FDIM: A Feature-distance-based Generic Video Quality Metric for Versatile Codecs

author.name: Jiayi Wang, Lichun Zhang, Xiaoqi Zhuang, Jiaqi Zhang, Lu Yu, Yin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes FDIM, a feature-distance-based video quality metric designed to generalize across traditional and neural video codecs, content types, and dynamic ranges including UHD and HDR.

entry.title: Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation Network Integrating Object-Level Label and Scene-Level Semantic Features for Multimodal Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Jinkun Dai, Yuanxin Ye, Peng Tang, Tengfeng Tang, Xianping Ma, Jing Xiao, Mi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TSMNet for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation of multi-modal remote sensing imagery by integrating textual supervision with visual representation learning.

entry.title: BIMStruct3D: A Fully Automated Hybrid Learning Scan-to-BIM Pipeline with Integrated Topology Refinement

author.name: Mahdi Chamseddine, Fabian Kaufmann, Marius Schellen, Christian Glock, Didier Stricker, Jason Rambach

entry.summary: Presents BIMStruct3D, a modular pipeline for generating BIM models from 3D point clouds combining learning-based segmentation with topology-aware reconstruction. Releases a new German Hospital dataset.

entry.title: DYMAPIA: A Multi-Domain Framework for Detecting AI-based Video Manipulation

author.name: Md Shohel Rana, Andrew H. Sung

entry.summary: Introduces DYMAPIA, a multi-domain deepfake detection framework fusing spatial, spectral, and temporal cues with dynamic anomaly masks guiding a lightweight distilled classifier.

entry.title: Probing CLIP's Comprehension of 360-Degree Textual and Visual Semantics

author.name: Hai Wang, Xiaochen Yang, Mingzhi Dong, Jing-Hao Xue

entry.summary: Probes CLIP's understanding of 360-degree panoramic images by introducing concepts of 360-degree textual semantics (format identifiers) and visual semantics (horizontal shift invariance). Evaluates whether standard CLIP models trained on perspective images can properly handle panoramic content.

entry.title: Generalizable CT-Free PET Attenuation and Scatter Correction for Pediatric Patients

author.name: Jia-Mian Wu, Jun Liu, Siqi Li, Xiaoya Wang, Shibai Yin, Huanyu Luo, Lingling Zheng, Qiang Gao, Jigang Yang, Tai-Xiang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes GPCN for CT-free PET attenuation and scatter correction in pediatric patients, using wavelet-based multiscale decomposition and frequency-aware spectral decoupling to handle scanner and radiotracer shifts. Reduces radiation exposure for children by eliminating CT dependency.

entry.title: Deep Learning-Enabled Dissolved Oxygen Sensing in Biofouling Environments for Ocean Monitoring

author.name: Nikolaos Salaris, Adrien Desjardins, Manish K. Tiwari

entry.summary: Combines camera-based dissolved oxygen sensors with a Vision Transformer-based physics-informed neural network for robust sensing under biofouling conditions. Addresses the critical challenge of sensor drift in marine environments for climate monitoring.

entry.title: Control Barrier Functions Solved with Hierarchical Quadratic Programming for Safe Physical Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Rui Luo, Jonas Mariager Jakobsen, Wesley Roozing, Federico Califano, Cheng Fang

entry.summary: Presents hierarchical QP formulation for Control Barrier Functions in physical human-robot interaction, enabling hierarchical relaxation of safety tasks for managing numerous safety constraints in collaborative robotics.

entry.title: Cooperative Informative Sensing for Monitoring Dynamic Indoor Environments via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Kanghoon Lee, Matthew M. Sato, Jinnyeong Yang, Seungro Lee, Sujin Lee, Jiachen Li, Kuk-Jin Yoon, Jinkyoo Park, Kincho H. Law, Yoonjin Yoon

entry.summary: Formulates cooperative active observation as a decentralized control problem where multiple robots optimize monitoring accuracy of human activity in indoor environments using multi-agent reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Decentralized Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Collaborative Exploration for Indoor and Outdoor 3D Environments

author.name: Yuxiang Li, Kun Chen, Jiancheng Wang, Shihao Fang, Haoyao Chen, Yunhui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a decentralized framework for heterogeneous multi-robot collaborative exploration in 3D environments, with improved supervoxel segmentation for lightweight communication and capability-aware task assignment for heterogeneous platforms.

entry.title: Event-based SLAM Benchmark for High-Speed Maneuvers

author.name: Sheng Zhong, Junkai Niu, Guillermo Gallego, Kaizhen Sun, Yang Yi, Zhiqiang Miao, Dewen Hu, Yaonan Wang, Davide Scaramuzza, Yi Zhou

entry.summary: Presents an event-based SLAM benchmark for high-speed maneuvers with 6-DoF motions, addressing limitations of existing event camera approaches that only handle restricted motion types or require persistent local map visibility.

entry.title: Generalizable Friction Coefficient Estimation via Material Embedding and Proxy Interaction Modeling

author.name: Zhendong Wang, Huamin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a proxy-based framework for estimating friction coefficients between arbitrary material pairs from a small set of proxy materials, learning per-material embeddings that generalize to unseen pairs.

entry.title: MCMC with Adaptive Principal-Component Transformation: Rotation-Invariant Universal Samplers for Bayesian Structural System Identification

author.name: Xianghao Meng, Yong Huang, James L. Beck, Kui Jiang, Hui Li

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Principal-Component Transformation MCMC methods that achieve rotation-invariance for Bayesian structural system identification. Addresses low sampling efficiency in generic MCMC by replacing neural network components with PCA-based transformations.

entry.title: How does Reinforcement Learning Affect Models

author.name: humanityfirst

entry.summary: Explores how reinforcement learning in post-training affects language models through the lens of 'persona theory' - the idea that models learn to simulate different personas and RL sharpens the distribution toward desired ones. Discusses implications for AI risk.

entry.title: PermaFrost-Attack: Stealth Pretraining Seeding(SPS) for planting Logic Landmines During LLM Training

author.name: Harsh Kumar, Rahul Maity, Tanmay Joshi, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain, Suranjana Trivedy, Amitava Das

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage from [yesterday](/?date=2026-04-27&category=research#item-0787ea49b176), Introduces Stealth Pretraining Seeding (SPS), an attack where adversaries distribute small poisoned content across stealth websites to be absorbed into training corpora via web crawlers, creating dormant 'logic landmines' in trained models.

entry.title: How Hard is it to Decide if a Fact is Relevant to a Query?

author.name: Meghyn Bienvenu, Diego Figueira, Pierre Lafourcade

entry.summary: Studies the computational complexity of determining whether a database fact is relevant to a query, identifying self-joins as a key source of hardness and establishing new complexity boundaries for various CQ fragments.

entry.title: Cross-Stage Coherence in Hierarchical Driving VQA: Explicit Baselines and Learned Gated Context Projectors

author.name: Gautam Kumar Jain, Carsten Markgraf, Julian St\"ahler

entry.summary: Studies cross-stage context passing in hierarchical driving VQA (Perception→Prediction→Planning), comparing explicit prompt-based and implicit gated context projector approaches. Reduces NLI contradiction by up to 42.6% on DriveLM-nuScenes.

entry.title: CRAFT: Clustered Regression for Adaptive Filtering of Training data

author.name: Parthasarathi Panda, Asheswari Swain, Subhrakanta Panda

entry.summary: Proposes CRAFT, a data selection method for fine-tuning seq2seq models that uses k-means clustering to match validation distributions with two-stage selection: source distribution matching followed by conditional target selection.

entry.title: Conditional Imputation for Within-Modality Missingness in Multi-Modal Federated Learning

author.name: Wugeng Zheng, Ziwen Kan, Katie Wang, Chen Chen, Song Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CondI, a federated framework using conditional diffusion models to handle within-modality missingness in multimodal federated learning. Employs two-phase training for imputation and optimization.

entry.title: Scalable and Verifiable Federated Learning for Cross-Institution Financial Fraud Detection

author.name: Prajwal Panth, Nishant Nigam

entry.summary: Proposes a federated learning system for cross-institution financial fraud detection that addresses scalability, privacy, and integrity through verified computation mechanisms, avoiding expensive homomorphic encryption.

entry.title: ZenBrain: A Neuroscience-Inspired 7-Layer Memory Architecture for Autonomous AI Systems

author.name: Alexander Bering

entry.summary: Presents ZenBrain, a 7-layer neuroscience-inspired memory architecture for AI agents integrating 15 neuroscience models with principles of consolidation, forgetting, and reconsolidation, plus predictive memory components.

entry.title: SPLIT: Separating Physical-Contact via Latent Arithmetic in Image-Based Tactile Sensors

author.name: Wadhah Zai El Amri, Nicol\'as Navarro-Guerrero

entry.summary: Proposes SPLIT for simulating image-based tactile sensors using latent space arithmetic to disentangle contact geometry from sensor-specific optical properties, enabling transfer across different sensor units.

entry.title: Energy-Arena: A Dynamic Benchmark for Operational Energy Forecasting

author.name: Max Kleinebrahm, Jonathan Berrisch, Philipp Eiser, Wolf Fichtner, Veit Hagenmeyer, Matthias Hertel, Nils Koster, Sebastian Lerch, Ralf Mikut, Jan Priesmann, Melanie Schienle, Benjamin Schaefer, Jann Weinand, Florian Ziel

entry.summary: Introduces Energy-Arena, a dynamic benchmarking platform for operational energy time series forecasting with continuously updated challenges, standardized submission via API, and operational deadlines to address the comparability gap in energy forecasting research.

entry.title: ReLeVAnT: Relevance Lexical Vectors for Accurate Legal Text Classification

author.name: Ishaan Gakhar, Harsh Nandwani

entry.summary: Proposes ReLeVAnT, a framework for legal document classification using n-gram processing, contrastive learning, and discriminative lexical features, avoiding dependence on metadata or large computational resources.

entry.title: On the Hybrid Nature of ABPMS Process Frames and its Implications on Automated Process Discovery

author.name: Anti Alman, Izack Cohen, Avigdor Gal, Fabrizio Maria Maggi, Marco Montali

entry.summary: Conceptualizes ABPMS process frames as hybrid business process models combining predefined procedures with commonsense rules, examining implications for automated process discovery in AI-augmented business process management.

entry.title: Model Predictive Control of Hybrid Dynamical Systems

author.name: Ricardo G. Sanfelice, Berk Altin

entry.summary: Formulates model predictive control for hybrid dynamical systems modeled as hybrid equations, providing sufficient conditions for asymptotic stability with a novel prediction/control horizon construction.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM-Based Goal Extraction in Requirements Engineering: Prompting Strategies and Their Limitations

author.name: Anna Arnaudo, Riccardo Coppola, Maurizio Morisio, Flavio Giobergia, Andrea Bioddo, Angelo Bongiorno, Luca Dadone

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-based goal extraction for requirements engineering through a chain of LLMs, testing different in-context learning variants and generation-critic patterns for actor identification and goal extraction from software documentation.

entry.title: SSG: Logit-Balanced Vocabulary Partitioning for LLM Watermarking

author.name: Chenxi Gu, Xiaoning Du, John Grundy

entry.summary: Proposes SSG, a logit-balanced vocabulary partitioning method for LLM watermarking that improves upon the KGW scheme, especially in low-entropy settings like code generation and mathematical reasoning. The approach analyzes how next-token probability distributions affect watermark effectiveness.

entry.title: QDTraj: Exploration of Diverse Trajectory Primitives for Articulated Objects Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Mathilde Kappel, Mahdi Khoramshahi, Louis Annabi, Faiz Ben Amar, St\'ephane Doncieux

entry.summary: Presents QDTraj, a method using quality-diversity optimization to generate diverse trajectory primitives for robotic manipulation of articulated objects. Emphasizes the importance of solution diversity for adaptable robot manipulation.

entry.title: AutoCompress: Critical Layer Isolation for Efficient Transformer Compression

author.name: Archit Thorat

entry.summary: Presents AutoCompress, a transformer compression method that protects Layer 0 at full dimensionality while compressing intermediate layers through a learned bottleneck. Achieves 2.47x compression on GPT-2 Medium.

entry.title: ML-Guided Primal Heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs

author.name: Weimin Huang, Natalie M. Isenberg, J\'an Drgo\v{n}a, Draguna L Vrabie, Bistra Dilkina

entry.summary: Proposes ML-guided primal heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs, extending recent ML-for-optimization work beyond MILPs to handle nonlinear objectives.

entry.title: HBGSA: Hydrogen Bond Graph with Self-Attention for Drug-Target Binding Affinity Prediction

author.name: Junxiao Kong, Chupei Tang, Di Wang, Jixiu Zhai, Yi He, Moyu Tang, Tianchi Lu

entry.summary: Introduces HBGSA, a compact 3.06M-parameter model for drug-target binding affinity prediction that encodes hydrogen bond spatial features using graph neural networks with self-attention and Pearson correlation loss.
