entry.summary: Studies LLM limitations in detecting culture-specific health misinformation using cow urine discourse on YouTube in India, finding that culturally embedded claims mixing sacred language with pseudo-science evade LLM analysis trained on Western corpora.

entry.title: Kernel Contracts: A Specification Language for ML Kernel Correctness Across Heterogeneous Silicon

author.name: Cooper Veit

entry.summary: Proposes Kernel Contracts, a formal specification language for ML kernels that defines correctness across heterogeneous hardware (AMD vs NVIDIA), with eight parts including tolerance, reference oracle, and violation signatures.

entry.title: LayerBoost: Layer-Aware Attention Reduction for Efficient LLMs

author.name: Mohamed Ali Souibgui, Jan Fostier, Rodrigo Abad\'ia-Heredia, Bohdan Denysenko, Christian Marschke, Igor Peric

entry.summary: Proposes LayerBoost, a layer-aware attention reduction method that selectively modifies attention mechanisms based on per-layer sensitivity analysis, avoiding uniform replacement that causes quality degradation.

entry.title: Sound Agentic Science Requires Adversarial Experiments

author.name: Dionizije Fa, Marko Culjak

entry.summary: Argues that LLM-based agents for science require adversarial experiments—deliberate attempts to falsify claims—rather than just generating plausible analyses, to avoid accelerating publication of unfalsified hypotheses.

entry.title: Do Not Imitate, Reinforce: Iterative Classification via Belief Refinement

author.name: Mahdi Kallel, Johannes T\"olle, Ahmed Hendawy, Carlo D'Eramo

entry.summary: Proposes Reinforced Iterative Classification (RIC), replacing standard supervised classification's imitative objective with reinforcement learning. A recurrent agent iteratively updates predictions, with the value function providing a natural halting criterion based on estimated remaining improvement.

entry.title: PAGaS: Pixel-Aligned 1DoF Gaussian Splatting for Depth Refinement

author.name: David Recasens, Robert Maier, Aljaz Bozic, Stephane Grabli, Javier Civera, Tony Tung, Edmond Boyer

entry.summary: Proposes PAGaS, a Pixel-Aligned 1DoF Gaussian Splatting method that constrains Gaussians to have depth as their sole degree of freedom for multi-view stereo depth refinement. Achieves improved geometric fidelity by tightly constraining Gaussian positions and sizes to back-projected pixel volumes.

entry.title: Near-Optimal Regret for the Safe Learning-based Control of the Constrained Linear Quadratic Regulator

author.name: Spencer Hutchinson, Nanfei Jiang, Mahnoosh Alizadeh

entry.summary: Achieves near-optimal O(√T) regret for the constrained linear quadratic regulator under chance constraints, improving upon prior O(T^{2/3}) results. Uses an SDP-based optimistic policy selection with a 'scale back' mechanism for verifiable safety.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Analysis of Shared Syntactic Mechanisms in Language Models

author.name: Ryoma Kumon, Hitomi Yanaka

entry.summary: Uses causal interpretability methods (activation patching) to investigate whether language models share neural mechanisms across different syntactic constructions (filler-gap dependencies and NPI licensing). Finds shared mechanisms for filler-gap but not NPI processing.

entry.title: On Benchmark Hacking in ML Contests: Modeling, Insights and Design

author.name: Xiaoyun Qiu, Yang Yu, Haifeng Xu

entry.summary: Models benchmark hacking in ML contests game-theoretically, where contestants allocate effort between true capability improvement and contest-specific optimization. Establishes equilibrium existence and provides insights for contest design to minimize hacking.

entry.title: CodeGraphVLP: Code-as-Planner Meets Semantic-Graph State for Non-Markovian Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Khoa Vo, Sieu Tran, Taisei Hanyu, Yuki Ikebe, Duy Nguyen, Bui Duy Quoc Nghi, Minh Vu, Anthony Gunderman, Chase Rainwater, Anh Nguyen and Ngan Le

entry.summary: Presents CodeGraphVLP, a hierarchical framework for non-Markovian long-horizon robot manipulation combining persistent semantic-graph state with executable code-based planning and progress-guided visual-language prompting.

entry.title: OccDirector: Language-Guided Behavior and Interaction Generation in 4D Occupancy Space

author.name: Zhuding Liang, Tianyi Yan, Dubing Chen, Jiasen Zheng, Huan Zheng, Cheng-zhong Xu, Yida Wang, Kun Zhan, Jianbing Shen

entry.summary: Proposes OccDirector, a framework that generates 4D occupancy dynamics for autonomous driving simulation conditioned solely on natural language descriptions. Uses VLM-driven Spatio-Temporal MMDiT with history-prefix anchoring for long-horizon interaction consistency.

entry.title: CAGE-SGG: Counterfactual Active Graph Evidence for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation

author.name: Suiyang Guang, Chenyu Liu, Ruohan Zhang, Siyuan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes CAGE-SGG for open-vocabulary scene graph generation that verifies whether predicted relations are grounded in visual evidence rather than driven by language priors, using counterfactual verification.

entry.title: PoseFM: Relative Camera Pose Estimation Through Flow Matching

author.name: Dominik Kuczkowski and Laura Ruotsalainen

entry.summary: Proposes PoseFM, the first framework to reformulate monocular visual odometry as a generative task using Flow Matching, modeling camera motion as a distribution rather than point estimate for uncertainty-aware pose estimation.

entry.title: From Local to Cluster: A Unified Framework for Causal Discovery with Latent Variables

author.name: Zongyu Li

entry.summary: Proposes L2C, a unified framework bridging local causal structure learning and cluster-level causal discovery, automatically discovering variable partitions without requiring prior cluster knowledge or causal sufficiency.

entry.title: CognitiveTwin: Robust Multi-Modal Digital Twins for Predicting Cognitive Decline in Alzheimer's Disease

author.name: Bulent Soykan, Gulsah Hancerliogullari Koksalmis, Hsin-Hsiung Huang, Laura J. Brattain

entry.summary: Presents CognitiveTwin, a digital twin framework for predicting patient-specific cognitive decline in Alzheimer's using a Transformer-based multimodal fusion and Deep Markov Model for temporal dynamics across 1,666 patients.

entry.title: From Skills to Talent: Organising Heterogeneous Agents as a Real-World Company

author.name: Zhengxu Yu and Yu Fu and Zhiyuan He and Yuxuan Huang and Lee Ka Yiu and Meng Fang and Weilin Luo and Jun Wang

entry.summary: Introduces OneManCompany (OMC), a framework that adds an organizational layer to multi-agent systems, encapsulating skills and configurations into portable 'Talents' with typed organizational interfaces.

entry.title: ReLIC-SGG: Relation Lattice Completion for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation

author.name: Amir Hosseini, Sara Farahani, Xinyi Li, Suiyang Guang

entry.summary: Proposes ReLIC-SGG for open-vocabulary scene graph generation that treats unannotated relations as latent variables rather than negatives, building a semantic relation lattice to handle annotation incompleteness and granularity variation in relation descriptions.

entry.title: FlowAnchor: Stabilizing the Editing Signal for Inversion-Free Video Editing

author.name: Ze Chen, Lan Chen, Yuanhang Li, and Qi Mao

entry.summary: FlowAnchor is a training-free framework for inversion-free video editing that stabilizes editing signals by explicitly anchoring spatial localization and edit strength. Introduces Spatial-aware Attention Refinement for multi-object scenes.

entry.title: The Exact Replica Threshold for Nonlinear Moments of Quantum States

author.name: Shuai Zeng

entry.summary: Proves a sharp information-theoretic threshold for estimating nonlinear moments of quantum states: for order t≥3, exactly ⌈t/2⌉ replicas are necessary and sufficient for polynomial-sample estimation, resolving an open question.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Morphological Discovery in Low-Resource Bantu Languages via Cross-Lingual Transfer and Unsupervised Clustering

author.name: Hillary Mutisya, John Mugane

entry.summary: Presents a method combining cross-lingual transfer with unsupervised clustering for morphological discovery in low-resource Bantu languages, discovering undocumented morphological patterns in Giriama with only 91 labeled paradigms.

entry.title: Representational Harms in LLM-Generated Narratives Against Global Majority Nationalities

author.name: Ilana Nguyen, Harini Suresh, Thema Monroe-White, and Evan Shieh

entry.summary: Studies how widely-adopted LLMs portray national origin identities in narrative generation, finding persistent representational harms including stereotypes, erasure, and one-dimensional portrayals for Global Majority nationalities.

entry.title: Diary of a "Doomer": 12+ years arguing about AI risk (part 3: the LLM era)

author.name: David Scott Krueger

entry.summary: Part 3 of AI safety researcher David Scott Krueger's memoir covering the LLM era, documenting how mainstream ML researchers became interested in alignment work not through intellectual curiosity or x-risk concerns but through the practical utility of alignment methods for LLMs. He reflects on the shift from fundamental/conceptual safety research to more pragmatic approaches tied to current paradigms.

entry.title: Source-Modality Monitoring in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Etha Tianze Hua, Tian Yun, Ellie Pavlick

entry.summary: Investigates source-modality monitoring in VLMs—the ability to track which input source information comes from—finding that both syntactic and semantic signals matter but semantic signals dominate when modalities are distributionally distinct.

entry.title: QuantClaw: Precision Where It Matters for OpenClaw

author.name: Manyi Zhang, Ji-Fu Li, Zhongao Sun, Xiaohao Liu, Zhenhua Dong, Xianzhi Yu, Haoli Bai, Xiaobo Xia

entry.summary: QuantClaw analyzes quantization sensitivity across agent workflows in OpenClaw and proposes a plug-and-play precision routing plugin that dynamically assigns quantization precision based on task characteristics, reducing costs while preserving performance.

entry.title: From Natural Language to Verified Code: Toward AI Assisted Problem-to-Code Generation with Dafny-Based Formal Verification

author.name: Md Erfan, Md Kamal Hossain Chowdhury, Ahmed Ryan, and Md Rayhanur Rahman

entry.summary: Evaluates 7 open-weight LLMs on generating formally verified Dafny code from natural language specifications using a new NL2VC-60 dataset of 60 complex algorithmic problems, with tiered prompting strategies.

entry.title: Inter-Stance: A Dyadic Multimodal Corpus for Conversational Stance Analysis

author.name: Xiang Zhang, Xiaotian Li, Taoyue Wang, Nan Bi, Xin Zhou, Cody Zhou, Zoie Wang, Andrew Yang, Yuming Su, Jeff Cohn, Qiang Ji and Lijun Yin

entry.summary: Presents Inter-Stance, a multimodal dyadic interaction corpus of 90 persons with synchronized face video, 3D geometry, thermal data, voice, speech, and physiology for studying conversational stance and interpersonal dynamics.

entry.title: Adversarial Co-Evolution of Malware and Detection Models: A Bilevel Optimization Perspective

author.name: Olha Jure\v{c}kov\'a, Martin Jure\v{c}ek, Matou\v{s} Koz\'ak and R\'obert L\'orencz

entry.summary: Proposes a bilevel optimization framework modeling the adversarial co-evolution between malware attackers and defenders, demonstrating that standard adversarial training fails while the bilevel approach achieves near-zero evasion rates against adaptive RL attackers.

entry.title: PASR: Pose-Aware 3D Shape Retrieval from Occluded Single Views

author.name: Jiaxin Shi, Guofeng Zhang, Wufei Ma, Naifu Liang, Adam Kortylewski, Alan Vuile

entry.summary: PASR formulates single-view 3D shape retrieval as feature-level analysis-by-synthesis, distilling knowledge from DINOv3 into a 3D encoder with pose-conditional alignment for robust retrieval under occlusion.

entry.title: CRAFT: Clustered Regression for Adaptive Filtering of Training data

author.name: Parthasarathi Panda, Asheswari Swain, Subhrakanta Panda

entry.summary: CRAFT is a data selection method for fine-tuning sequence-to-sequence models that decomposes source-target distributions and performs two-stage selection: matching validation source distribution via cluster allocation, then selecting targets minimizing conditional expected distance.

entry.title: Characterizing control between interacting subsystems with deep Jacobian estimation

author.name: Adam J. Eisen, Mitchell Ostrow, Sarthak Chandra, Leo Kozachkov, Earl K. Miller, Ila R. Fiete

entry.summary: Develops a data-driven nonlinear control-theoretic framework using deep Jacobian estimation to characterize how biological subsystems control one another, applied to brain circuits and gene regulatory networks.

entry.title: AugVLA-3D: Depth-Driven Feature Augmentation for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zhifeng Rao, Wenlong Chen, Lei Xie, Xia Hua, Dongfu Yin, Zhen Tian, F. Richard Yu

entry.summary: Proposes AugVLA-3D, a framework integrating depth estimation into Vision-Language-Action models for robotics, using VGGT for geometry-aware 3D feature extraction from RGB inputs to improve spatial understanding.

entry.title: DM$^3$-Nav: Decentralized Multi-Agent Multimodal Multi-Object Semantic Navigation

author.name: Amin Kashiri (1), Atharva Jamsandekar (1), Yasin Yaz{\i}c{\i}o\u{g}lu (1) ((1) Northeastern University, Boston, USA)

entry.summary: Presents DM³-Nav, a fully decentralized multi-agent semantic navigation system supporting multimodal open-vocabulary goals and multi-object missions without central coordination, matching or exceeding centralized approaches.

entry.title: Rethinking Publication: A Certification Framework for AI-Enabled Research

author.name: Yang Lu, Rabimba Karanjai, Lei Xu, Weidong Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a two-layer certification framework for AI-generated research publications that separates knowledge quality assessment from human contribution grading, addressing the gap in evaluating pipeline-generated academic work.

entry.title: Mochi: Aligning Pre-training and Inference for Efficient Graph Foundation Models via Meta-Learning

author.name: Jo\~ao Mattos and Arlei Silva

entry.summary: Proposes Mochi, a Graph Foundation Model using meta-learning that pre-trains on few-shot episodes mirroring downstream evaluation, aligning training objectives with inference rather than relying on post-hoc unification.

entry.title: LTBs-KAN: Linear-Time B-splines Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Eduardo Said Merin-Martinez and Andres Mendez-Vazquez and Eduardo Rodriguez-Tello

entry.summary: Proposes LTBs-KAN, a linear-time B-splines implementation for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks that reduces computational complexity while maintaining accuracy, addressing the main scalability bottleneck of KANs.

entry.title: Reliability Auditing for Downstream LLM tasks in Psychiatry: LLM-Generated Hospitalization Risk Scores

author.name: Shevya Pandya, Shinjini Bose, Ananya Joshi

entry.summary: Proposes reliability auditing for LLM-generated psychiatric hospitalization risk scores, evaluating how prompt design and medically insignificant inputs affect predictions through structured multi-level assessment.

entry.title: Memanto: Typed Semantic Memory with Information-Theoretic Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agents

author.name: Seyed Moein Abtahi, Rasa Rahnema, Hetkumar Patel, Neel Patel, Majid Fekri, Tara Khani

entry.summary: Introduces Memanto, a typed semantic memory layer for AI agents that challenges the assumption that knowledge graph complexity is needed for high-fidelity memory, using information-theoretic retrieval instead.

entry.title: Wiggle and Go! System Identification for Zero-Shot Dynamic Rope Manipulation

author.name: Arthur Jakobsson, Abhinav Mahajan, Karthik Pullalarevu, Krishna Suresh, Yunchao Yao, Yuemin Mao, Bardienus Duisterhof, Shahram Najam Syed, Jeffrey Ichnowski

entry.summary: Presents 'Wiggle and Go!', a two-stage framework for zero-shot dynamic rope manipulation by robots. Uses system identification from observed rope movement to predict physical parameters, then optimizes manipulation in simulation before real-world execution without iterative attempts.

entry.title: Sum-of-Checks: Structured Reasoning for Surgical Safety with Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Weiqiu You, Cassandra Goldberg, Amin Madani, Daniel A. Hashimoto, Eric Wong

entry.summary: Introduces Sum-of-Checks, a framework that decomposes surgical safety assessment into expert-defined reasoning checks for LVLMs. Applied to Critical View of Safety assessment during laparoscopic cholecystectomy, it produces auditable criterion-level scores from binary check evaluations.

entry.title: Logistic Bandits with $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{dT})$ Regret without Context Diversity Assumptions

author.name: Seoungbin Bae, Dabeen Lee

entry.summary: Proposes SupSplitLog, the first algorithm for K-armed logistic bandits achieving O(√dT) regret without context diversity assumptions. Removes the restriction that context vectors cannot be concentrated in low-dimensional subspaces.

entry.title: ResRank: Unifying Retrieval and Listwise Reranking via End-to-End Joint Training with Residual Passage Compression

author.name: Xiaojie Ke, Shuai Zhang, Liansheng Sun, Yongjin Wang, Hengjun Jiang, Xiangkun Liu, Cunxin Gu, Jian Xu, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Presents ResRank, a unified retrieval-reranking framework that compresses candidate passages into single embeddings via an Encoder-LLM, addressing the 'lost in the middle' phenomenon and inference latency of LLM-based listwise reranking.

entry.title: Towards Temporal Compositional Reasoning in Long-Form Sports Videos

author.name: Siyu Cao, Lu Zhang, Ruizhe Zeng, and Zhi-yong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces SportsTime, a large-scale benchmark for temporal compositional reasoning in long-form sports videos with 14K+ QA pairs and 50K+ temporal evidence annotations. Addresses the gap in long-horizon reasoning requiring temporally dispersed evidence.

entry.title: Algorithmic Feature Highlighting for Human-AI Decision-Making

author.name: Yifan Guo, Jann Spiess

entry.summary: Studies algorithms that highlight a small subset of case-specific features for human decision-makers rather than providing direct recommendations. Models both sophisticated and naive human interpretation of feature selection and analyzes computational complexity.

entry.title: Navigating Large-Scale Document Collections: MuDABench for Multi-Document Analytical QA

author.name: Zhanli Li, Yixuan Cao, Lvzhou Luo, Ping Luo

entry.summary: Introduces MuDABench, a benchmark for analytical QA over large semi-structured document collections with 80,000+ pages and 332 QA instances requiring cross-document quantitative analysis. Constructed using distant supervision from financial databases.

entry.title: STEM: Structure-Tracing Evidence Mining for Knowledge Graphs-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Peng Yu, En Xu, Bin Chen, Haibiao Chen, Yinfei Xu

entry.summary: Proposes STEM, a framework for knowledge graph-based question answering that reframes multi-hop reasoning as schema-guided graph search, addressing semantic mismatch and lack of global structural perspective in existing retrieval methods.

entry.title: ChangeQuery: Advancing Remote Sensing Change Analysis for Natural and Human-Induced Disasters from Visual Detection to Semantic Understanding

author.name: Dongwei Sun, Jing Yao, Kan Wei, Xiangyong Cao, Chen Wu, Zhenghui Zhao, Pedram Ghamisi, Jun Zhou, J\'on Atli Benediktsson

entry.summary: Presents ChangeQuery, a unified multimodal framework for disaster situation awareness that couples pre-event optical with post-event SAR data, addressing limitations of optical-only remote sensing methods for disaster response.

entry.title: FILTR: Extracting Topological Features from Pretrained 3D Models

author.name: Louis Martinez and Maks Ovsjanikov

entry.summary: Introduces FILTR, a learnable framework to predict topological descriptors (persistence diagrams) from frozen 3D point cloud encoders, and DONUT, a synthetic benchmark with controlled topological complexity.

entry.title: Distance-Misaligned Training in Graph Transformers and Adaptive Graph-Aware Control

author.name: Qinhan Hou and Jing Tang

entry.summary: Studies distance-misaligned training in Graph Transformers, showing that mismatch between where label-relevant information lies and where models allocate communication leads to failures. Proposes adaptive graph-aware control.

entry.title: NRGS: Neural Regularization for Robust 3D Semantic Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Zaiyan Yang, Xinpeng Liu, Heng Guo, Jinglei Shi, Zhanyu Ma, Fumio Okura

entry.summary: Proposes NRGS, a neural regularization method for 3D semantic Gaussian Splatting that refines noisy semantic fields caused by multi-view inconsistent 2D features, using variance-aware conditioning.

entry.title: Aggregate vs. Personalized Judges in Business Idea Evaluation: Evidence from Expert Disagreement

author.name: Wataru Hirota, Tomoki Taniguchi, Tomoko Ohkuma, Kosuke Takahashi, Takahiro Omi, Kosuke Arima, Takuto Asakura, Chung-Chi Chen, Tatsuya Ishigaki

entry.summary: Studies whether LLM-based business idea evaluation should model aggregate consensus or individual expert judgments, introducing PBIG-DATA with 3,000 scores across 300 patent-grounded ideas showing substantial expert disagreement.

entry.title: Non-Minimal Sampling and Consensus for Prohibitively Large Datasets

author.name: Seong Hun Lee, Patrick Vandewalle, Javier Civera

entry.summary: Introduces NONSAC, a general framework for robust model estimation from large datasets that repeatedly samples non-minimal subsets with robust estimators, demonstrated on pose estimation, PnP, and point cloud registration.

entry.title: Transferable Physical-World Adversarial Patches Against Pedestrian Detection Models

author.name: Shihui Yan, Ziqi Zhou, Yufei Song, Yifan Hu, Minghui Li, Shengshan Hu

entry.summary: Proposes TriPatch, a method for generating physical adversarial patches against pedestrian detection that combines multi-stage collaborative attacks with robustness enhancement under physical diversity, systematically disrupting the detection pipeline.

entry.title: Cross-Stage Coherence in Hierarchical Driving VQA: Explicit Baselines and Learned Gated Context Projectors

author.name: Gautam Kumar Jain, Carsten Markgraf, Julian St\"ahler

entry.summary: Studies cross-stage context passing in hierarchical driving VQA (Perception→Prediction→Planning), showing that prompt-based conditioning reduces contradictions by 42.6% and gated context projectors provide implicit coherence.

entry.title: Identifying and typifying demographic unfairness in phoneme-level embeddings of self-supervised speech recognition models

author.name: Felix Herron and Solange Rossato and Alexandre Allauzen and Fran\c{c}ois Portet

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for typifying demographic unfairness in ASR phoneme embeddings, distinguishing between random error/high variance and systematic embedding bias, finding that training probes on disadvantaged speaker groups sometimes improves their performance.

entry.title: Structure-Guided Diffusion Model for EEG-Based Visual Cognition Reconstruction

author.name: Yongxiang Lian, Yueyang Cang, Pingge Hu, Yuchen He, Li Shi

entry.summary: Proposes a Structure-Guided Diffusion Model for EEG-based visual reconstruction that incorporates explicit structural information via a structurally supervised VAE combined with a spatiotemporal EEG encoder, evaluated on abstract and natural image datasets.

entry.title: Relaxation-Informed Training of Neural Network Surrogate Models

author.name: Calvin Tsay

entry.summary: Proposes training regularizers for ReLU neural network surrogates that directly target downstream MILP tractability by penalizing big-M constants and unstable neurons, reducing optimization solve time while maintaining prediction quality.

entry.title: Substrate: Formalism

author.name: Vardhan

entry.summary: The third post in a series formalizing the concept of 'substrates' — the low-level computational choices (normalization placement, quantization, memory layout) beneath model architecture that influence safety-relevant properties like refusal behavior and jailbreak robustness. The post introduces a formal mathematical framework for reasoning about these effects, developed as part of the AI Safety Camp MoSSAIC project.

entry.title: Efficient measurement of neutral-atom qubits with matched filters

author.name: Robert M. Kent, Linipun Phuttitarn, Chaithanya Naik Mude, Swamit Tannu, Mark Saffman, Gregory Lafyatis, Daniel J. Gauthier

entry.summary: Presents scalable matched-filter algorithms for neutral-atom qubit readout that reduce measurement errors by up to 43% compared to standard thresholding, using local and array-aware models to handle crosstalk.

entry.title: KIRA: Knowledge-Intensive Image Retrieval and Reasoning Architecture for Specialized Visual Domains

author.name: Parthaw Goswami and Jaynto Goswami Deep

entry.summary: Presents KIRA, a five-stage visual RAG framework for specialized domains with hierarchical semantic chunking, domain-adaptive encoders, multi-hop reasoning, and answer verification grounded in visual evidence.

entry.title: The Biggest Risk of Embodied AI is Governance Lag

author.name: Shaoshan Liu

entry.summary: Argues that the biggest risk of embodied AI is governance lag—the inability of institutions to keep pace with technology deployment across manufacturing, logistics, and infrastructure—identifying observational, institutional, and distributive forms of lag.

entry.title: Soft Anisotropic Diagrams for Differentiable Image Representation

author.name: Laki Iinbor, Zhiyang Dou, Wojciech Matusik

entry.summary: Introduces Soft Anisotropic Diagrams (SAD), a differentiable image representation parameterized by adaptive sites with anisotropic metrics, computed as softmax blends over per-pixel top-K subsets enabling efficient GPU rendering.

entry.title: Foundation models for discovering robust biomarkers of neurological disorders from dynamic functional connectivity

author.name: Deepank Girish, Yi Hao Chan, Sukrit Gupta, Jing Xia, and Jagath C. Rajapakse

entry.summary: Proposes RE-CONFIRM framework for evaluating robustness of biomarkers discovered by brain foundation models from dynamic functional connectivity, finding that standard performance metrics are insufficient for assessing biomarker reliability.

entry.title: H-Sets: Hessian-Guided Discovery of Set-Level Feature Interactions in Image Classifiers

author.name: Ayushi Mehrotra, Dipkamal Bhusal, Michael Clifford, Nidhi Rastogi

entry.summary: Introduces H-Sets, a framework for discovering higher-order feature interactions in image classifiers using Hessian-based detection of interacting pairs followed by interaction-aware attribution satisfying core axioms.

entry.title: Shard the Gradient, Scale the Model: Serverless Federated Aggregation via Gradient Partitioning

author.name: Amine Barrak

entry.summary: Proposes GradsSharding for federated learning on serverless platforms that partitions gradient tensors (not clients) across functions, enabling aggregation of models exceeding per-function memory limits while maintaining bit-identical FedAvg results.

entry.title: CharTide: Data-Centric Chart-to-Code Generation via Tri-Perspective Tuning and Inquiry-Driven Evolution

author.name: Xiangxi Zheng, Kuang He, Jiayi Hu, Ping Yu, Rui Yan, Yuan Yao, Peng Hou, Anxiang Zeng, Alex Jinpeng Wang

entry.summary: Presents CharTide, a data-centric framework for chart-to-code generation that decouples training into visual perception, code logic, and modality fusion streams. Constructs a 2M-sample dataset and enables a 7B model to surpass larger models.

entry.title: An LLM-Driven Closed-Loop Autonomous Learning Framework for Robots Facing Uncovered Tasks in Open Environments

author.name: Hong Su

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-driven closed-loop framework where robots autonomously learn from uncovered tasks by using LLMs to generate solutions that are then stored as reusable local methods. Reduces reliance on repeated LLM interaction for similar future tasks.

entry.title: Preserve Support, Not Correspondence: Dynamic Routing for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhancun Mu, Guangyu Zhao, Yiwu Zhong, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DROL for offline RL, using dynamic routing with top-1 selection from K candidate actions to decouple Q-improvement from data support preservation. Avoids compromise solutions when critic and support objectives disagree.

entry.title: Learning Control Policies to Provably Satisfy Hard Affine Constraints for Black-Box Hybrid Dynamical Systems

author.name: Aayushi Shrivastava, Kartik Nagpal, Sairam Jinkala, Jean-Baptiste Bouvier, and Negar Mehr

entry.summary: Develops RL policies with provable safety for black-box hybrid dynamical systems by constraining the policy to be affine and repulsive near constraint boundaries. Handles unknown nonlinear dynamics with affine reset maps.

entry.title: Towards Safe Mobility: A Unified Transportation Foundation Model enabled by Open-Ended Vision-Language Dataset

author.name: Wenhui Huang and Songyan Zhang and Collister Chua and Yang Liang and Zhiqi Mao and Heng Yang and Chen Lv

entry.summary: Introduces the Land Transportation Dataset (LTD), a large-scale vision-language dataset for open-ended reasoning about urban traffic safety from roadside cameras. Proposes a unified transportation foundation model for city-scale traffic analysis beyond autonomous driving.

entry.title: HGQ-LUT: Fast LUT-Aware Training and Efficient Architectures for DNN Inference

author.name: Chang Sun, Zhiqiang Que, Bakhtiar Zadeh, Qibin Liu, Kevin H. Alvarez, Wayne Luk, Maria Spiropulu

entry.summary: Presents HGQ-LUT, a new lookup-table-aware training approach for FPGA-based neural network inference that achieves 100x training speedup while maintaining state-of-the-art hardware efficiency.

entry.title: Revisiting Geometric Obfuscation with Dual Convergent Lines for Privacy-Preserving Image Queries in Visual Localization

author.name: Jeonggon Kim, Heejoon Moon and Je Hyeong Hong

entry.summary: Introduces Dual Convergent Lines (DCL), a novel keypoint obfuscation method for privacy-preserving visual localization that resists recent privacy attacks by preventing reconstruction of original keypoint locations.

entry.title: Controllable Spoken Dialogue Generation: An LLM-Driven Grading System for K-12 Non-Native English Learners

author.name: Haidong Yuan, Haokun Zhao, Wanshi Xu, Songjun Cao, Qingyu Zhou, Long Ma, Hongjie Fan

entry.summary: Introduces a proficiency-aligned framework for K-12 English learners using LLMs, with a novel DDPO (Diversity Driven Policy Optimization) algorithm based on GRPO for multi-turn dialogue that preserves diversity while controlling lexical complexity.

entry.title: Are Natural-Domain Foundation Models Effective for Accelerated Cardiac MRI Reconstruction?

author.name: Anam Hashmi, Mayug Maniparambil, Julia Dietlmeier, Kathleen M. Curran, Noel E. O'Connor

entry.summary: Investigates whether natural-domain foundation models (CLIP, DINOv2) can serve as effective priors for accelerated cardiac MRI reconstruction, proposing an unrolled framework incorporating frozen visual encoders. Finds task-specific models still outperform but foundation models show promise.

entry.title: Operational Feature Fingerprints of Graph Datasets via a White-Box Signal-Subspace Probe

author.name: Yuchen Xiong, Swee Keong Yeap, Zhen Hong Ban

entry.summary: WG-SRC is a white-box graph signal-subspace probe that replaces learned GNN message passing with a fixed, named graph-signal dictionary for node classification diagnosis, revealing what feature-level mechanisms datasets require.

entry.title: How Supply Chain Dependencies Complicate Bias Measurement and Accountability Attribution in AI Hiring Applications

author.name: Gauri Sharma and Maryam Molamohammadi

entry.summary: Analyzes how AI hiring system supply chains (data vendors, model developers, platform providers, deployers) fragment responsibility and complicate bias measurement and accountability, with implications for EU AI Act and other regulations.

entry.title: Conformalized Super Learner

author.name: Zhanli Wu, Fabrizio Leisen, Miguel-Angel Luque-Fernandez, F. Javier Rubio

entry.summary: Combines conformal prediction with Super Learner ensemble methods to produce prediction intervals with finite-sample coverage guarantees, avoiding reliance on asymptotics or computationally intensive bootstrapping.

entry.title: Explanation of Dynamic Physical Field Predictions using WassersteinGrad: Application to Autoregressive Weather Forecasting

author.name: Younes Essafouri, Laure Raynaud, Luciano Drozda, Laurent Risser

entry.summary: Introduces WassersteinGrad, adapting gradient-based feature attribution methods for autoregressive predictions on dynamic physical fields like weather forecasting, using Wasserstein distance-based robustification.

entry.title: An Artifact-based Agent Framework for Adaptive and Reproducible Medical Image Processing

author.name: Lianrui Zuo, Yihao Liu, Gaurav Rudravaram, Karthik Ramadass, Aravind R. Krishnan, Michael D. Phillips, Yelena G. Bodien, Mayur B. Patel, Paula Trujillo, Yency Forero Martinez, Stephen A. Deppen, Eric L. Grogan, Fabien Maldonado, Kevin McGann, Hudson M. Holmes, Laurie E. Cutting, Yuankai Huo, Bennett A. Landman

entry.summary: Presents an artifact-based agent framework for medical image processing that formalizes intermediate outputs through contracts, enabling adaptive workflow configuration and full reproducibility tracking for clinical deployment.

entry.title: Multi-Task Optimization over Networks of Tasks

author.name: Julian Hatzky, Thomas Bartz-Beielstein, A. E. Eiben, Anil Yaman

entry.summary: Introduces MONET, a multi-task optimization algorithm that models the task space as a graph, enabling topology-aware knowledge transfer between tasks through social learning on networks.

entry.title: EgoMAGIC- An Egocentric Video Field Medicine Dataset for Training Perception Algorithms

author.name: Brian VanVoorst, Nicholas Walczak, Christopher Gilleo, Charles Meissner, Fabio Felix, Iran Roman, Bea Steers, Claudio Silva, Yuhan Shen, Zijia Lu, Shih-Po Lee, Ehsan Elhamifar

entry.summary: Introduces EgoMAGIC, an egocentric medical activity dataset with 3,355 videos of 50 medical tasks from DARPA's PTG program, including an action detection challenge for augmented reality medical assistance.

entry.title: Lightweight Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Model-Based Modeling for Scalable Patient-Trial Matching

author.name: Xiaodi Li, Yang Xiao, Munhwan Lee, Konstantinos Leventakos, Young J. Juhn, David Jones, Terence T. Sio, Wei Liu, Maria Vassilaki, and Nansu Zong

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight RAG+LLM framework for patient-trial matching that retrieves relevant EHR segments before LLM reasoning, reducing computational cost compared to full-document processing while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: Optimal Question Selection from a Large Question Bank for Clinical Field Recovery in Conversational Psychiatric Intake

author.name: Guan Gui, Peter Zandi, Jacob Taylor, and Ananya Joshi

entry.summary: Formulates psychiatric intake as an optimal question-selection problem, introducing a benchmark with 655 clinician-authored questions and synthetic patient vignettes to evaluate conversational AI for clinical information gathering.

entry.title: TRACE: Topology-aware Reconstruction of Accidents in CARLA for AV Evaluation

author.name: Nahian Salsabil, Sebastian Elbaum

entry.summary: Introduces TRACE, a pipeline automating reconstruction of NHTSA crash reports into CARLA simulations using OpenStreetMap data and LLMs to infer initial vehicle states, creating a benchmark of 52 diverse accident scenarios.

entry.title: Knowledge-driven Augmentation and Retrieval for Integrative Temporal Adaptation

author.name: Weisi Liu, Guangzeng Han, Xiaolei Huang

entry.summary: Develops KARITA, a framework for temporal adaptation of NLP models that captures semantic and knowledge shifts over time using knowledge-driven augmentation and retrieval. Evaluated on clinical, legal, and scientific classification tasks, demonstrating robustness to temporal distribution shifts.

entry.title: ReCast: Recasting Learning Signals for Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation

author.name: Peiyan Zhang, Hanmo Liu, Chengxuan Tong, Yuxia Wu, Wei Guo, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ReCast, a framework that fixes learning signals in RL-based generative recommendation by repairing all-zero reward groups and using boundary-focused contrastive updates. Achieves up to 36.6% improvement over OpenOneRec-RL.

entry.title: EvFlow-GS: Event Enhanced Motion Deblurring with Optical Flow for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Feiyu An, Yufei Deng, Zihui Zhang, Rong Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes EvFlow-GS, combining event cameras and optical flow to optimize 3D Gaussian Splatting from motion-blurred images. Uses a learnable double integral for event processing and joint optimization of camera poses and 3DGS.

entry.title: ArchSym: Detecting 3D-Grounded Architectural Symmetries in the Wild

author.name: Hanyu Chen, Ruojin Cai, Steve Marschner, Noah Snavely

entry.summary: Presents the first framework for detecting 3D-grounded reflectional symmetries from single in-the-wild RGB images of architectural landmarks. Introduces scalable data annotation and addresses monocular scale ambiguity for full 3D plane localization.

entry.title: Bridging the Long-Tail Gap: Robust Retrieval-Augmented Relation Completion via Multi-Stage Paraphrase Infusion

author.name: Fahmida Alam, Mihai Surdeanu, Ellen Riloff

entry.summary: Proposes RC-RAG, a multi-stage paraphrase-guided framework for relation completion that integrates paraphrases into retrieval, summarization, and generation stages. Improves RAG performance on long-tail relations without model fine-tuning.

entry.title: BLAST: Benchmarking LLMs with ASP-based Structured Testing

author.name: Manuel Alejandro Borroto Santana, Erica Coppolillo, Francesco Calimeri, Giuseppe Manco, Simona Perri and Francesco Ricca

entry.summary: Introduces BLAST, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Answer Set Programming (ASP) code generation, with novel semantic metrics and evaluation of eight state-of-the-art LLMs on ten graph problems.

entry.title: One Shot Learning for Edge Detection on Point Clouds

author.name: Zhikun Tu, Yuhe Zhang, Yiou Jia, Kang Li, and Daniel Cohen-Or

entry.summary: Presents a one-shot learning method for edge detection on point clouds that learns the specific data distribution of a target scanner, achieving better results than networks trained on general distributions.

entry.title: CNSL-bench: Benchmarking the Sign Language Understanding Capabilities of MLLMs on Chinese National Sign Language

author.name: Rui Zhao, Xuewen Zhong, Xiaoyun Zheng, Jinsong Su and Yidong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces CNSL-bench, the first comprehensive Chinese National Sign Language benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs, grounded in the official standardized sign language dictionary with multimodal coverage.

entry.title: MTT-Bench: Predicting Social Dominance in Mice via Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yunquan Chen, Haoyu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces MTT-Bench for evaluating multimodal LLMs on predicting social dominance in mice from behavioral video, showing fine-tuned MLLMs can achieve high agreement with tube test rankings.

entry.title: Distilling Vision Transformers for Distortion-Robust Representation Learning

author.name: Konstantinos Alexis, Giorgos Giannopoulos, Dimitrios Gunopulos

entry.summary: Proposes an asymmetric knowledge distillation framework where a teacher ViT processes clean images and a student processes distorted versions, enabling learning of distortion-robust representations. The multi-level distillation aligns global embeddings, patch-level features, and other representations across clean/distorted pairs.

entry.title: Using Embedding Models to Improve Probabilistic Race Prediction

author.name: Noan Dasanaike and Kosuke Imai

entry.summary: Proposes eBISG, using pre-trained text embeddings to improve Bayesian race prediction for individuals with uncommon surnames not covered by Census data, addressing a limitation affecting ~10% of the US population.

entry.title: ATRS: Adaptive Trajectory Re-splitting via a Shared Neural Policy for Parallel Optimization

author.name: Jiajun Yu, Guodong Liu, Li Wang, Pengxiang Zhou, Wentao Liu, Yin He, Chao Xu, Fei Gao, Yanjun Cao

entry.summary: ATRS embeds a shared deep RL policy into parallel ADMM optimization for trajectory planning, adaptively re-splitting stagnating trajectory segments to improve convergence in highly constrained motion planning problems.

entry.title: The paper that killed deep learning theory

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: A retrospective analysis of Zhang et al. (2016) 'Understanding deep learning requires rethinking generalization,' which demonstrated that deep networks can memorize random labels, thereby invalidating classical statistical learning theory bounds for explaining deep learning's generalization. The post explains why this result was so devastating for classical deep learning theory and surveys the aftermath.

entry.title: Extremal Contours: Gradient-driven contours for compact visual attribution

author.name: Reza Karimzadeh, Albert Alonso, Frans Zdyb, Julius B. Kirkegaard and Bulat Ibragimov

entry.summary: Presents Extremal Contours, a training-free explanation method that replaces dense perturbation masks with smooth star-convex contours parameterized by Fourier series, optimized via classifier gradients for compact visual attribution.

entry.title: QDTraj: Exploration of Diverse Trajectory Primitives for Articulated Objects Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Mathilde Kappel, Mahdi Khoramshahi, Louis Annabi, Faiz Ben Amar, St\'ephane Doncieux

entry.summary: Presents QDTraj, a method for generating diverse robot trajectory primitives for manipulating articulated objects, emphasizing the importance of having multiple solutions for the same task to enable optimal real-world execution.

entry.title: Pack only the essentials: Adaptive dictionary learning for kernel ridge regression

author.name: Daniele Calandriello, Alessandro Lazaric, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive dictionary learning for kernel ridge regression that incrementally updates ridge leverage scores to achieve Nyström approximations with space complexity proportional to effective dimension rather than full matrix size.

entry.title: FedSPDnet: Geometry-Aware Federated Deep Learning with SPDnet

author.name: Thibault Pautrel, Florent Bouchard, Ammar Mian, Guillaume Ginolhac

entry.summary: Introduces federated learning frameworks for SPDnet models on symmetric positive definite matrices, using geometry-preserving aggregation strategies (ProjAvg and RLAvg) on the Stiefel manifold for EEG signal processing.

entry.title: Explanation through Reward Model Reconciliation using POMDP Tree Search

author.name: Benjamin D. Kraske, Anshu Saksena, Anna L. Buczak, Zachary N. Sunberg

entry.summary: Proposes reconciling differences between an AI planning algorithm's reward model and a human user's implicit reward model by leveraging action discrepancies in POMDP tree search to estimate user objectives.

entry.title: Focus Session: Hardware and Software Techniques for Accelerating Multimodal Foundation Models

author.name: Muhammad Shafique, Abdul Basit, Muhammad Abdullah Hanif, Alberto Marchisio, Rachmad Vidya Wicaksana Putra, Minghao Shao

entry.summary: Presents a multi-layered methodology combining hardware-software co-design for accelerating multimodal foundation models, including mixed-precision quantization, structural pruning, speculative decoding, and model cascading.

entry.title: Performance Anomaly Detection in Athletics: A Benchmarking System with Visual Analytics

author.name: Blessed Madukoma, Prasenjit Mitra

entry.summary: Develops a system processing 1.6M athletics performances using eight detection methods to identify performance anomalies potentially indicative of doping, validated against confirmed anti-doping violations.

entry.title: MambaCSP: Hybrid-Attention State Space Models for Hardware-Efficient Channel State Prediction

author.name: Aladin Djuhera, Haris Gacanin, Holger Boche

entry.summary: Proposes MambaCSP, a hybrid-attention state space model for channel state prediction in wireless systems that achieves linear-time complexity while maintaining prediction accuracy comparable to transformer-based approaches.

entry.title: A general optimization solver based on OP-to-MaxSAT reduction

author.name: Yuxin Zhao, Han Huang, Zhifeng Hao

entry.summary: Proposes GORED, a general optimization solver that reduces multiple types of optimization problems to MaxSAT instances, validated on 136 instances across 11 problem types.

entry.title: Robust Localization for Autonomous Vehicles in Highway Scenes

author.name: Daqian Cheng, Xuchu Ding, Yujia Wu, Xiang Zhang, Lei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a robust localization system for autonomous vehicles on highways using dual-likelihood LiDAR processing that decouples 3D geometry from 2D road texture, with Control-EKF reducing latency for closed-loop behavior.

entry.title: Call-Chain-Aware LLM-Based Test Generation for Java Projects

author.name: Guancheng Wang and Qinghua Xu and Lionel C. Briand and Zhaoqiang Guo and Kui Liu

entry.summary: Presents CAT, a call-chain-aware LLM-based test generation approach that incorporates dependency contexts through static analysis into prompts for generating project-level Java unit tests.

entry.title: Ethics Testing: Proactive Identification of Generative AI System Harms

author.name: Shin Hwei Tan, Haibo Wang, Heng Li

entry.summary: Introduces 'ethics testing' as a systematic approach to generate tests for identifying software harms in content produced by generative AI systems. The paper proposes a novel concept distinct from existing testing approaches, aiming to proactively detect harmful outputs. This addresses an important gap in GAI quality assurance but appears to be a conceptual/early-stage contribution.

entry.title: How Many Visual Levers Drive Urban Perception? Interventional Counterfactuals via Multiple Localised Edits

author.name: Jason Tang, Stephen Law

entry.summary: Proposes a lever-based interventional counterfactual framework for understanding which localized visual changes in street-view images would shift human perception of safety. Uses prompt-conditioned image editing with validity checks for realism and plausibility in a pilot study across 50 scenes from 5 cities.

entry.title: PrivSTRUCT: Untangling Data Purpose Compliance of Privacy Policies in Google Play Store

author.name: Bhanuka Silva, Anirban Mahanti, Aruna Seneviratne, Suranga Senevirante

entry.summary: Introduces PrivSTRUCT, a framework that preserves structural hierarchy in privacy policy analysis, extracting 2x more data item-purpose pairs than state-of-the-art. Applied to 3,756 Android apps, revealing widespread compliance gaps between declared data practices and actual purposes.

entry.title: SAMIDARE: Advanced Tracking-by-Segmentation for Dense Scenarios

author.name: Shozaburo Hirano, Norimichi Ukita

entry.summary: Proposes SAMIDARE for multi-object tracking in dense sports scenes, enhancing SAM2MOT with density-aware mask regeneration, selective memory updates, and state-aware association. Achieves SOTA on SportsMOT with +2.5 HOTA and +4.2 IDF1 improvements.

entry.title: Sharpness-Aware Poisoning: Enhancing Transferability of Injective Attacks on Recommender Systems

author.name: Junsong Xie, Yonghui Yang, Pengyang Shao, Le Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Sharpness-Aware Poisoning to enhance the transferability of adversarial attacks on recommender systems across different victim model architectures. Uses sharpness-aware optimization to find worst-case victim models in surrogate neighborhoods.

entry.title: Uni-Encoder Meets Multi-Encoders: Representation Before Fusion for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing Modalities

author.name: Peibo Song, Xiaotian Xue, Jinshuo Zhang, Zihao Wang, Jinhua Liu, Shujun Fu, Fangxun Bao, Si Yong Yeo

entry.summary: Proposes UniME, a two-stage method for brain tumor segmentation with missing MRI modalities. Stage 1 pretrains a ViT encoder with masked image modeling; Stage 2 adds modality-specific CNN encoders for high-resolution features.

entry.title: From Global to Local: Rethinking CLIP Feature Aggregation for Person Re-Identification

author.name: Aotian Zheng, Winston Sun, Bahaa Alattar, Vitaly Ablavsky, Jenq-Neng Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes SAGA-ReID for CLIP-based person re-identification, reconstructing identity representations by aligning patch tokens with anchor vectors in CLIP's text embedding space rather than relying on a single CLS token. Handles occlusion and cross-camera variation.

entry.title: Breaking Watermarks in the Frequency Domain: A Modulated Diffusion Attack Framework

author.name: Chunpeng Wang, Binyan Qu, Xiaoyu Wang, Zhiqiu Xia, Shanshan Zhang, Yunan Liu, Qi Li

entry.summary: Proposes FMDiffWA, a frequency-domain modulated diffusion framework for attacking digital image watermarks while preserving image quality. Selectively modulates watermark-related frequency components during both forward and reverse diffusion processes.

entry.title: False Feasibility in Variable Impedance MPC for Legged Locomotion

author.name: Vishal Ramesh

entry.summary: Identifies a formulation error in variable impedance MPC for legged locomotion where treating stiffness as instantaneous overestimates the feasible set. Proves analytical conditions under which no admissible stiffness command can realize the predicted behavior.

entry.title: A Probabilistic Framework for Hierarchical Goal Recognition

author.name: Chenyuan Zhang, Katherine Ip, Hamid Rezatofighi, Buser Say, Mor Vered

entry.summary: Introduces the first planning-based probabilistic framework for hierarchical goal recognition over Hierarchical Task Networks (HTNs). Combines hierarchical task structure with probabilistic inference via a three-stage generative model for likelihood estimation.

entry.title: Semantic Error Correction and Decoding for Short Block Channel Codes

author.name: Jiafu Hao, Chentao Yue, Wanchun Liu, Yonghui Li, Branka Vucetic

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic-enhanced receiver framework that uses language models to correct errors in short block codes transmitted over noisy wireless channels. Introduces semantic list decoding and a confidence-guided HARQ mechanism replacing CRC-based error detection.

entry.title: A Brain-Inspired Deep Separation Network for Single Channel Raman Spectra Unmixing

author.name: Gaoruishu Long, Jinchao Liu, Bo Liu, Jie Liu, Xiaolin Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a brain-inspired deep learning approach for unmixing single-channel Raman spectra into individual components, addressing a longstanding challenge in spectroscopy where existing methods require multiple mixed spectra.

entry.title: Dynamically Acquiring Text Content to Enable the Classification of Lesser-known Entities for Real-world Tasks

author.name: Fahmida Alam, Ellen Riloff

entry.summary: Presents a framework for classifying lesser-known entities by dynamically acquiring descriptive text from web and LLM sources, requiring only entity names and labels as training data.

entry.title: Revisiting Neural Activation Coverage for Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Benedikt Franke, Nils F\"orster, Frank K\"oster, Asja Fischer, Markus Lange, Arne Raulf

entry.summary: Extends neural activation coverage (NAC) from OOD detection to uncertainty estimation for regression in already-trained neural networks, showing NAC scores are more meaningful than Monte-Carlo Dropout.

entry.title: Selective Contrastive Learning For Gloss Free Sign Language Translation

author.name: Changhao Lai, Rui Zhao, Xuewen Zhong, Jinsong Su and Yidong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes selective contrastive learning for gloss-free sign language translation, addressing noisy alignment supervision from random in-batch contrast by tracking negative similarity trajectories and selecting informative negatives.

entry.title: Adaptive vs. Static Robot-to-Human Handover: A Study on Orientation and Approach Direction

author.name: Federico Biagi, Dario Onfiani, Simone Silenzi, Cristina Iani, Luigi Biagiotti

entry.summary: Presents an adaptive robot-to-human handover framework that dynamically adjusts object delivery pose based on the user's hand pose and intended task, with user study comparing against static baseline.

entry.title: Region Matters: Efficient and Reliable Region-Aware Visual Place Recognition

author.name: Shunpeng Chen, Yukun Song, Changwei Wang, Rongtao Xu, Kexue Fu, Longxiang Gao, Li Guo, Ruisheng Wang, Shibiao Xu

entry.summary: Introduces FoL++, a visual place recognition method combining reliability estimation for robust discriminative region modeling with adaptive re-ranking for efficient candidate scheduling.

entry.title: All Eyes on the Workflow: Automated and Efficient Event Discovery from Video Streams

author.name: Marco Pegoraro, Jonas Seng, Dustin Heller, Wil M.P. van der Aalst, Kristian Kersting

entry.summary: Presents SnapLog, an approach to extract event data from video by converting frames to embeddings, performing temporal segmentation via frame-wise similarity, and few-shot classification for event labeling.

entry.title: Decoding High-Dimensional Finger Motion from EMG Using Riemannian Features and RNNs

author.name: Martin Colot, C\'edric Simar, Guy Cheron, Ana Maria Cebolla Alvarez, Gianluca Bontempi

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end framework for continuous EMG-to-finger-kinematics regression using consumer-grade hardware, combining Riemannian features with RNNs and an 8-channel EMG armband.

entry.title: Railway Artificial Intelligence Learning Benchmark (RAIL-BENCH): A Benchmark Suite for Perception in the Railway Domain

author.name: Annika B\"atz, Pavel Klasek, Seo-Young Ham, Philipp Neumaier, Martin K\"oppel, and Martin Lauer

entry.summary: Presents RAIL-BENCH, the first perception benchmark suite for the railway domain covering five challenges: rail track detection, object detection, vegetation segmentation, multi-object tracking, and visual odometry.

entry.title: On the Properties of Feature Attribution for Supervised Contrastive Learning

author.name: Leonardo Arrighi, Julia Eva Belloni, Aur\'elie Gallet, Ivan Gentile, Matteo Lippi, Marco Zullich

entry.summary: Investigates feature attribution methods (like SHAP, integrated gradients) when applied to models trained with supervised contrastive learning (SCL) rather than cross-entropy, finding differences in explanation behavior relevant to safety-critical applications.

entry.title: ArmSSL: Adversarial Robust Black-Box Watermarking for Self-Supervised Learning Pre-trained Encoders

author.name: Yongqi Jiang, Yansong Gao, Boyu Kuang, Chunyi Zhou, Anmin Fu, Liquan Chen

entry.summary: ArmSSL proposes a watermarking framework for self-supervised learning encoders that provides black-box ownership verification and is robust against adversarial watermark detection/removal, using paired discrepancy enlargement for feature-space orthogonality.

entry.title: EV-CLIP: Efficient Visual Prompt Adaptation for CLIP in Few-shot Action Recognition under Visual Challenges

author.name: Hyo Jin Jon, Longbin Jin, Eun Yi Kim

entry.summary: EV-CLIP adapts CLIP for few-shot video action recognition with visual prompts (mask prompts and spatial prompts) that address spatial perception challenges like low-light and egocentric viewpoints, areas overlooked by temporal-modeling-focused approaches.

entry.title: Detecting Concept Drift in Evolving Malware Families Using Rule-Based Classifier Representations

author.name: Tom\'a\v{s} Kaln\'y, Martin Jure\v{c}ek and Mark Stamp

entry.summary: Proposes structural concept drift detection in malware classification using decision tree ruleset comparisons across temporal windows on the EMBER2024 dataset, finding fixed two-month windowing with feature-level Pearson correlation is most reliable.

entry.title: An Undecidability Proof for the Plan Existence Problem

author.name: Antonis Achilleos

entry.summary: Proves that the plan existence problem in epistemic logic is undecidable even when action preconditions have modal depth at most 1 and there are no postconditions, resolving a previously open question.

entry.title: SNGR: Selective Non-Gaussian Refinement for Ambiguous SLAM Factor Graphs

author.name: Anushka Kulkarni, Sarthak Dubey

entry.summary: Presents SNGR, a SLAM framework augmenting iSAM2 with targeted non-Gaussian refinement using nested sampling only in regions where Gaussian approximations fail, detected via condition number of covariance matrices.

entry.title: Insect-inspired modular architectures as inductive biases for reinforcement learning

author.name: Anne E. Staples

entry.summary: Studies insect-inspired modular RL architectures that decompose control into interacting modules (sensory, heading, memory, command, motor) with learned arbitration, showing benefits on a sparse-reward navigation task.

entry.title: Adversarial Malware Generation in Linux ELF Binaries via Semantic-Preserving Transformations

author.name: Luk\'a\v{s} Hrdonka and Martin Jure\v{c}ek

entry.summary: Develops an adversarial malware generator for Linux ELF binaries achieving 67.74% evasion rate against MalConv through semantic-preserving transformations, addressing the understudied Linux malware adversarial space.

entry.title: GCImOpt: Learning efficient goal-conditioned policies by imitating optimal trajectories

author.name: Jon Goikoetxea, Jes\'us F. Palaci\'an

entry.summary: GCImOpt learns goal-conditioned policies from trajectory optimization-generated datasets, using data augmentation that treats intermediate states as goals to increase training data by an order of magnitude.

entry.title: Mixed Membership sub-Gaussian Models

author.name: Huan Qing

entry.summary: Proposes mixed membership sub-Gaussian models extending Gaussian mixtures to allow observations to belong to multiple components with partial membership, with theoretical guarantees and applications to networks and genetics.

entry.title: Forecasting Solar Energy Using a Single Image

author.name: Jeremy Klotz and Shree K. Nayar

entry.summary: Uses a single image at a solar panel's location to forecast irradiance at any future time by extracting camera orientation, visible sky portion, and temporal reflections from nearby buildings.

entry.title: When Quotes Crumble: Detecting Transient Mechanical Liquidity Erosion in Limit Order Books

author.name: Haohan Xu, Jason Bohne, Pawel Polak, Yurij Baransky, Ajay Alva, Violetta Fedotova, Gary Kazantsev, David Rosenberg

entry.summary: Studies detection of transient liquidity erosion ('crumbling quotes') in limit order books using agent-based simulation for ground truth and neural models achieving 36% AUC improvement for calibrated crumbling probabilities.

entry.title: Anatomy-Aware Unsupervised Detection and Localization of Retinal Abnormalities in Optical Coherence Tomography

author.name: Tania Haghighi, Sina Gholami, Hamed Tabkhi, Minhaj Nur Alam

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised anomaly detection framework for retinal OCT imaging that learns normative distributions of healthy anatomy without lesion annotations. Uses discrete latent models with retinal layer-aware features for improved clinical robustness.

entry.title: Unlocking Optical Prior: Spectrum-Guided Knowledge Transfer for SAR Generalized Category Discovery

author.name: Jingyuan Xia and Ruikang Hu and Ye Li and Zhixiong Yang and Xu Lan and Zhejun Lu

entry.summary: Introduces Modal Discrepancy Curve (MDC) and MCPT framework for transferring optical image priors from large vision models to SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) domain for generalized category discovery. Uses frequency-domain descriptors to model cross-modal discrepancy.

entry.title: Protect the Brain When Treating the Heart: A Convolutional Neural Network for Detecting Emboli

author.name: Andrea Angino, Ken Trotti, Diego Ulisse Pizzagalli, Rolf Krause, Tiziano Torre and Stefanos Demertzis

entry.summary: Proposes a 2.5D U-Net architecture for detecting gaseous microemboli in cardiac ultrasound during surgical interventions. Achieves real-time detection with robustness against background, facilitating integration into surgical monitoring protocols.

entry.title: ReLeVAnT: Relevance Lexical Vectors for Accurate Legal Text Classification

author.name: Ishaan Gakhar and Harsh Nandwani

entry.summary: Proposes ReLeVAnT, a lightweight legal document classification framework using n-gram processing and contrastive score matching with a shallow neural network, avoiding dependence on LLMs or structured metadata.

entry.title: ICPR 2026 Competition on Low-Resolution License Plate Recognition

author.name: Rayson Laroca, Valfride Nascimento, Donggun Kim, Sanghyeok Chung, Subin Bae, Uihwan Seo, Seungsang Oh, Chi M. Phung, Minh G. Vo, Xingsong Ye, Yongkun Du, Yuchen Su, Zhineng Chen, Sunhee Heo, Hyangwoo Lee, Kihyun Na, Khanh V. Vu Nguyen, Sang T. Pham, Duc N. N. Phung, Trong P. Le, Vy N. Vo Tran, David Menotti

entry.summary: Reports results from the ICPR 2026 Competition on Low-Resolution License Plate Recognition, the first competition dedicated to LRLPR using real low-quality surveillance data, with 269 teams from 41 countries.

entry.title: Hierarchical Probabilistic Principal Component Analysis of Longitudinal Data

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Ameer Qaqish, D.Y. Lin, Didong Li

entry.summary: Introduces hierarchical probabilistic PCA (HPPCA) for longitudinal data that separates between-subject and within-subject temporal variation using Gaussian process latent factors, with an EM algorithm handling missing data.

entry.title: Concave Statistical Utility Maximization Bandits via Influence-Function Gradients

author.name: Mat\'ias Carrasco, Alejandro Cholaquidis

entry.summary: Studies multi-armed bandits where the objective is a statistical functional of the reward distribution rather than expected reward, using influence-function calculus to derive gradient estimators for an entropic mirror-ascent algorithm.

entry.title: CLVAE: A Variational Autoencoder for Long-Term Customer Revenue Forecasting

author.name: Jeffrey N\"af, Riana Valera Mbelson, Markus Meierer

entry.summary: Proposes a VAE-based model for long-term customer revenue forecasting that preserves probabilistic customer base model likelihoods while replacing parametric mixing distributions with learned latent representations.

entry.title: Vision-Based Risk Aware Emergency Landing for UAVs in Complex Urban Environments

author.name: Julio de la Torre-Vanegas, Miguel Soriano-Garcia, Israel Becerra, Diego Mercado-Ravell

entry.summary: Proposes a vision-based risk-aware emergency landing system for UAVs that uses semantic segmentation to continuously evaluate hazards and identify safe landing zones in complex urban environments.

entry.title: 3W Dataset 2.0.0: a realistic and public dataset with rare undesirable real events in oil wells

author.name: Ricardo Emanuel Vaz Vargas, Afr\^anio Jos\'e de Melo Junior, Celso Jos\'e Munaro, Cl\'audio Benevenuto de Campos Lima, Eduardo Toledo de Lima Junior, Felipe Muntzberg Barrocas, Fl\'avio Miguel Varej\~ao, Guilherme Fidelis Peixer, Igor de Melo Nery Oliveira, Jader Riso Barbosa Jr., Jaime Andr\'es Lozano Cadena, Jean Carlos Dias de Ara\'ujo, Jo\~ao Neuenschwander Escosteguy Carneiro, Lucas Gouveia Omena Lopes, Lucas Pereira de Gouveia, Mateus de Araujo Fernandes, Matheus Lima Scramignon, Patrick Marques Ciarelli, Rodrigo Castello Branco, Rog\'erio Leite Alves Pinto

entry.summary: Describes version 2.0 of the 3W Dataset from Petrobras containing multivariate time series from oil wells labeled with rare undesirable events, serving as a benchmark for anomaly detection in industrial settings.

entry.title: Conditional anomaly detection using soft harmonic functions: An application to clinical alerting

author.name: Michal Valko, Hamed Valizadegan, Branislav Kveton, Gregory F. Cooper, Milos Hauskrecht

entry.summary: Develops a non-parametric conditional anomaly detection method based on soft harmonic functions for detecting unusual clinical events like omission of important lab tests in electronic health records.

entry.title: Model Predictive Control of Hybrid Dynamical Systems

author.name: Ricardo G. Sanfelice and Berk Altin

entry.summary: Formulates model predictive control for hybrid dynamical systems modeled as hybrid equations, providing sufficient conditions for asymptotic stability using prediction horizons inspired by hybrid time domains.

entry.title: Null-Space Flow Matching for MIMO Channel Estimation in Latency-Constrained Systems

author.name: Junjie Zhao, Guangming Liang, Dongzhu Liu, Xiaonan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes null-space flow matching for MIMO channel estimation that decomposes the problem into directly recoverable range-space and iteratively refined null-space components, reducing inference latency.

entry.title: Multimodal Diffusion to Mutually Enhance Polarized Light and Low Resolution EBSD Data

author.name: Harry Dong, Timofey Efimov, Megna Shah, Jeff Simmons, Sean Donegan, Marc De Graef, Yuejie Chi

entry.summary: Uses an unconditional multimodal diffusion model to mutually enhance polarized light and EBSD microscopy data, accelerating 3D materials characterization. Trained on synthetic data, it generalizes to real noisy, corrupted, and misregistered data.

entry.title: AI-Driven Performance-to-Design Generation and Optimization of Marine Propellers

author.name: Leah Chen, Keni Chih-Hua Wu, Boon Tat Chia, Xiuqing Xing, Jian Cheng Wong

entry.summary: Develops a physics-based data generation pipeline and generative AI framework for marine propeller design, including a database of 20,000+ propeller geometries with performance simulations. Features conditional generation, neural surrogate evaluation, and multi-objective optimization.

entry.title: TTS-PRISM: A Perceptual Reasoning and Interpretable Speech Model for Fine-Grained Diagnosis

author.name: Xi Wang, Jie Wang, Xingchen Song, Baijun Song, Jingran Xie, Jiahe Shao, Zijian Lin, Di Wu, Meng Meng, Jian Luan, Zhiyong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes TTS-PRISM, a 12-dimensional diagnostic framework for evaluating Mandarin text-to-speech quality. Uses schema-driven instruction tuning with adversarial perturbations and expert anchors for fine-grained TTS diagnosis.

entry.title: Tell Me Why: Designing an Explainable LLM-based Dialogue System for Student Problem Behavior Diagnosis

author.name: Zhilin Fan, Deliang Wang, Penghe Chen, Yu Lu

entry.summary: Designs an explainable LLM-based dialogue system for diagnosing student problem behaviors, using hierarchical attribution to identify dialogue evidence for recommendations and generate natural language explanations. Evaluated with 22 pre-service teachers.

entry.title: HFS-TriNet: A Three-Branch Collaborative Feature Learning Network for Prostate Cancer Classification from TRUS Videos

author.name: Xu Lu, Qianhong Peng, Qihao Zhou, Shaopeng Liu, Xiuqin Ye, Chuan Yang, Yuan Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes HFS-TriNet, a three-branch network for prostate cancer classification from TRUS videos with heuristic frame selection, addressing challenges of information redundancy, class similarity, and low signal-to-noise ratio.

entry.title: How Hard is it to Decide if a Fact is Relevant to a Query?

author.name: Meghyn Bienvenu, Diego Figueira, Pierre Lafourcade

entry.summary: Studies the computational complexity of deciding whether a database fact is relevant to a conjunctive query, identifying self-joins as the key source of hardness and proving tractability without self-joins.

entry.title: Point & Grasp: Flexible Selection of Out-of-Reach Objects Through Probabilistic Cue Integration

author.name: Xuejing Luo, Hee-Seung Moon, Christian Holz, Antti Oulasvirta

entry.summary: Introduces Point&Grasp, a probabilistic cue integration framework for selecting out-of-reach objects in mixed reality by combining pointing direction and grasp gestures with Bayesian inference.

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Geometry Optimization and Physics-Aware Learning for Calibration-Free Magnetic Localization

author.name: Wenxuan Xie, Yuelin Zhang, Qingpeng Ding, Jianghua Chen, Jiewen Tan, Jiwei Shan and Shing Shin Cheng

entry.summary: Presents a framework combining Fisher Information Matrix-based sensor geometry optimization with physics-aware deep learning for calibration-free magnetic localization of permanent magnets in medical applications.

entry.title: An Integrated Framework for Explainable, Fair, and Observable Hospital Readmission Prediction: Development and Validation on MIMIC-IV

author.name: Isaac Tosin Adisa

entry.summary: Presents an integrated framework for hospital readmission prediction combining explainability (SHAP), fairness evaluation across 16 demographic subgroups, and deployment monitoring, validated on MIMIC-IV with 415K admissions. XGBoost achieved AUC-ROC 0.696.

entry.title: Dharma, Data and Deception: An LLM-Powered Rhetorical Analysis of Cow-Urine Health Claims on YouTube

author.name: Sheza Munir, Ratna Kandala, Anamta Khan, Deepti, Joyojeet Pal

entry.summary: Uses multiple LLMs (GPT-4, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, etc.) to analyze rhetorical strategies in YouTube content promoting or debunking cow urine health claims, applying a 14-category taxonomy of persuasive tactics.

entry.title: A Non-Invasive Alternative to RFID: Self-Sufficient 3D Identification of Group-Housed Livestock

author.name: Shiva Paudel, TsungCheng Tsai, Dongyi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TARA, a non-invasive 3D point cloud-based livestock identification system using semi-supervised learning with temporal adaptive recalibration, replacing invasive RFID tags for group-housed farm animals.

entry.title: Pliable rejection sampling

author.name: Akram Erraqabi, Michal Valko, Alexandra Carpentier, Odalric-Ambrym Maillard

entry.summary: Presents pliable rejection sampling (PRS) that learns the sampling proposal using a kernel estimator, providing guarantees on accepted sample counts while maintaining i.i.d. samples from the target distribution.

entry.title: L-System Genetic Encoding for Scalable Neural Network Evolution: A Comparison with Direct Matrix Encoding

author.name: Alexander Stuy, Nodin Weddington

entry.summary: Introduces an L-System based genetic encoding for neural networks showing 2.74x performance advantage over direct matrix encoding with 8.5-fold improvement in consistency for evolved Hebbian networks.

entry.title: Learning Coverage- and Power-Optimal Transmitter Placement from Building Maps: A Comparative Study of Direct and Indirect Neural Approaches

author.name: \c{C}a\u{g}kan Yapar

entry.summary: Studies neural approaches for optimal wireless transmitter placement, introducing a dataset of 167K urban scenarios and finding that coverage-optimal and power-optimal placements have an asymmetric trade-off.

entry.title: Generating Synthetic Malware Samples Using Generative AI

author.name: Tiffany Bao, Kylie Trousil, Quang Duy Tran, Fabio Di Troia, Younghee Park

entry.summary: Proposes using generative AI (NLP techniques on opcode sequences) to synthesize malware samples for augmenting imbalanced training datasets, improving malware classification performance.

entry.title: An End-to-End Ukrainian RAG for Local Deployment. Optimized Hybrid Search and Lightweight Generation

author.name: Mykola Trokhymovych, Yana Oliinyk, Nazarii Nyzhnyk

entry.summary: Presents an efficient Ukrainian-language RAG system for document QA that achieved 2nd place in the UNLP 2026 Shared Task. Features a two-stage retrieval pipeline and a fine-tuned Ukrainian LM compressed for lightweight local deployment on resource-constrained hardware.

entry.title: Learning Reactive Human Motion Generation from Paired Interaction Data Using Transformer-Based Models

author.name: Masato Soga, Ryuki Takebayashi

entry.summary: Investigates transformer-based models for generating reactive human motion from paired interaction data, specifically from boxing match videos. Compares three transformer architectures for action-reaction motion generation.

entry.title: FixV2W: Correcting Invalid CVE-CWE Mappings with Knowledge Graph Embeddings

author.name: Sevval Simsek, Varsha Athreya, David Starobinski

entry.summary: Introduces FixV2W, using knowledge graph embeddings and longitudinal trends to improve CVE-to-CWE mappings in the National Vulnerability Database. Targets vulnerabilities linked to Prohibited or Discouraged categories.

entry.title: V-STC: A Time-Efficient Multi-Vehicle Coordinated Trajectory Planning Approach

author.name: Pengfei Liu, Jialing Zhou, Yuezu Lv, Guanghui Wen, and Tingwen Huang

entry.summary: Presents V-STC, a variable-time-step spatio-temporal corridor approach for multi-vehicle trajectory planning that optimizes both spatial and temporal dimensions for collision-free coordination. Reduces overall temporal occupancy while maintaining safety.

entry.title: A Co-Evolutionary Theory of Human-AI Coexistence: Mutualism, Governance, and Dynamics in Complex Societies

author.name: Somyajit Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes a co-evolutionary theory of human-AI coexistence based on conditional mutualism under governance rather than master-tool obedience. Synthesizes work across AI, evolutionary biology, and institutional design.

entry.title: Fast Neural-Network Approximation of Active Target Search Under Uncertainty

author.name: Bilal Yousuf, Zsofia Lendek, Lucian Busoniu

entry.summary: Uses a CNN to approximate active target search decisions for faster online computation, replacing costly optimization with direct inference. Achieves comparable detection rates to exact planners with 50x computational speedup.

entry.title: Beyond Land Surface Temperature: Explainable Spatial Machine Learning Reveals Urban Morphology Effects on Human-Centric Heat Stress

author.name: Yuan Wang, Shengao Yi, Xiaojiang Li, Pengyuan Liu, Zhiwei Yang, Ronita Bardhan, Rudi Stouffs

entry.summary: Uses explainable spatial ML to compare land surface temperature (LST) with physiologically relevant heat stress metrics (UTCI) in Singapore, revealing how urban morphology affects human-centric heat exposure differently than LST suggests.

entry.title: Different Strokes for Different Folks: Writer Identification for Historical Arabic Manuscripts

author.name: Hamza A. Abushahla, Ariel Justine N. Panopio, Layth Al-Khairulla, Mohamed I. AlHajri

entry.summary: Provides first writer identification baselines for historical Arabic manuscripts from the Muharaf dataset under line-level and page-disjoint protocols, expanding writer labels from 28% to 87% coverage.

entry.title: Quality-Driven Selective Mutation for Deep Learning

author.name: Zaheed Ahmed, Emmanuel Charleson Dapaah, Philip Makedonski, Jens Grabowski

entry.summary: Presents a probabilistic framework for quantifying deep learning mutant quality along resistance and realism axes, enabling selective mutation testing that reduces cost while maintaining quality for DL testing and debugging.

entry.title: Iterative Model-Learning Scheme via Gaussian Processes for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control of (Semi-)Batch Processes

author.name: Tai Xuan Tan, Alexander Mitsos, Eike Cramer

entry.summary: Proposes iterative model-learning NMPC using Gaussian Processes for batch processes, initializing from a single trajectory and iteratively improving with GP uncertainty for chance-constrained safe operation.

entry.title: Contrast-Space Projection for Network Meta-Analysis: An Exact and Invariant Study-Based Decomposition of Direct and Indirect Contributions

author.name: Chong Wang and Yanqi Zhang and Zhezhen Jin and Annette O'Connor

entry.summary: Develops a contrast-space projection formulation for network meta-analysis that provides exact, invariant decompositions of direct and indirect evidence contributions, addressing a reproducibility gap in multi-arm trials with within-study correlations.

entry.title: Multi-output Extreme Spatial Model for Complex Aircraft Production Systems

author.name: Cheolhei Lee, Xing Wang, Xiaowei Yue, Jianguo Wu

entry.summary: Develops a multi-output extreme spatial model for aircraft production systems that models correlated extreme events from heavy-tailed distributions, addressing the gap between individual extreme event modeling and complex system correlations.

entry.title: Natural Language Interfaces for Spatial and Temporal Databases: A Comprehensive Overview of Methods, Taxonomy, and Future Directions

author.name: Samya Acharja and Kanchan Chowdhury

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of natural language interfaces for spatial and temporal databases, covering methods, taxonomy, and future directions for bridging geospatial query languages and non-expert users.

entry.title: FLARE-BO: Fused Luminance and Adaptive Retinex Enhancement via Bayesian Optimisation for Low-Light Robotic Vision

author.name: Nathan Shankar, Pawel Ladosz and Hujun Yin

entry.summary: Proposes FLARE-BO, a training-free image enhancement framework for low-light robotic vision that uses Bayesian optimization with Retinex decomposition and adaptive denoising. Extends prior work from 3 to more parameters while adding illumination decomposition and white balance correction. Targets practical autonomous robot perception under poor lighting.

entry.title: Robust Camera-to-Mocap Calibration and Verification for Large-Scale Multi-Camera Data Capture

author.name: Tianyi Liu, Christopher Twigg, Patrick Grady, Kevin Harris, Shangchen Han, Kun He

entry.summary: Presents a robust camera-to-mocap calibration and verification system for large-scale multi-camera setups, addressing challenges with fisheye cameras, board-to-marker variation, and session-to-session drift. Jointly estimates camera extrinsics and intrinsics for reliable ground-truth capture in AR/VR and robotics.

entry.title: Energy-Efficient Multi-Robot Coverage Path Planning of Non-Convex Regions of Interests

author.name: Sourav Raxit, Jose Fuentes, Paulo Padrao, Abdullah Al Redwan Newaz, Md Tamjidul Hoque, Mark Kulp, Leonardo Bobadilla

entry.summary: Presents an energy-efficient multi-robot coverage path planning framework for non-convex regions with obstacles and no-fly zones. Features globally-informed swath generation, safety buffer computation, and efficient mTSP solving for workload balancing.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM-Based Goal Extraction in Requirements Engineering: Prompting Strategies and Their Limitations

author.name: Anna Arnaudo, Riccardo Coppola, Maurizio Morisio, Flavio Giobergia, Andrea Bioddo, Angelo Bongiorno, Luca Dadone

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM-based goal extraction for requirements engineering using a chain of LLMs with engineered prompts across actor identification and goal extraction phases. Investigates impact of in-context learning variants and generation-critic feedback loops.
